jobs.title: Helsefagarbeider
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

Hos hjemmetjenesten Mørkved er det nå ledig to stillinger som helsefagarbeider i 100% stilling. Stillingene er ledig omgående. 

Vårt team består av engasjerte og dyktige sykepleiere, helsefagarbeidere og pleiemedarbeidere, som alle jobber mot at brukerne våre skal få et godt tjenestetilbud og at de har det bra i sine hjem. Vi har også tett samarbeid med kreftsykepleier, ernæringsfysiolog, hukommelsesteam og fastleger, for å finne gode løsninger for pasientoppfølgingen. 

Vi trives på jobb og har stort fokus på kunnskapsdeling og samarbeid med hverandre. Hos oss er det også høy takhøyde, rom for å prøve og feile, godt humør, og mye humor som gjelder. Vi ønsker gjerne nye kollegaer velkommen til vår arbeidsplass.

I vår sone er det egne nattevakter, så turnus hos oss vil bestå av kun dag og aftenvakter, både i ukedagene og i helgene. 

Hjemmetjenesten Mørkved har base på Mørkved, og området vårt dekker fra tunnelåpningen på Hunstad og ut til Tverlandsbrua. Vi dekker også rundt Soløyvannet og har et område på Alstad. 

Hos hjemmetjenesten Mørkved fokuserer vi på å fremme livskvalitet og mestring til hjemmeboende brukere slik at det skal være mulig for de å bo hjemme så lenge som mulig. Hverdagen i hjemmesykepleien er variert, spennende og lærerik. Vi tilbyr brukerne tjenester som matlaging, medisinering, stell, sårstell og hjelp til forflytning. 

Vi har brukere i alle aldre og med ulike utfordringer i sine hverdager, så hos oss får man muligheten til å jobbe både med faglig utfordrende oppgaver, så vel som enkle hverdagsoppgaver. 


Kvalifikasjoner og personlige egenskaper

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Norsk autorisasjon som helsefagarbeider
  • God norsk skriftlig- og muntlig fremstillingsevne
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Grunnleggende IKT-ferdigheter

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Du har gode relasjonelle evner og et grunnleggende engasjement for andre mennesker. 
  • Du er positiv, løsningsorientert, har humor og trives både i selvstendig arbeid og sammen med dine kollegaer. 
  • Du liker å veilede og dele av din kompetanse.
  • Du har fokus på tett oppfølging av den enkelte og tenker helhetlig.
  • Du liker ansvar og utfordringer, og jobber systematisk selv i et hektisk miljø.

Det vil i tilsettingen bli lagt stor vekt på motivasjon for stillingen og personlig egnethet


Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil være:
  • Du bistår brukerne i eget hjem i samarbeid med både bruker og pårørende.
  • Du kartlegger behovet til brukerne.
  • Du dokumentasjon i journalsystemet Aidn.
  • Du utøver primærarbeid og har oppfølging av egne brukere.
  • Du medvirker til god samhandling med kollegaer og andre tjenester.
  • Du bidrar til å sikre god kvalitet i den direkte tjenesteytingen. 

Vi kan tilby deg
  • Todelt turnus
  • Faglig engasjerte medarbeidere
  • Godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Mulighet til å bruke din kompetanse i et variert og spennende fagmiljø  
  • Opplæring tilpasset ditt utgangspunkt, med mentorordning
  • Kompetanseheving
  • Arbeid hver 4 helg med langvakter  
  • Lønn i henhold til gjeldende tariffavtale.
  • Gratis parkering
  • Årlig fagdag – pasientsikkerhetsdagene

Annet

Aktuelle søkere vil bli invitert til intervju, helst fysisk oppmøte.

Dokumentasjon på utdanning og praksis legges ved søknaden. 

Får du tilbud om stillingen må gyldig politiattest leveres til leder/tjenestested. jf. Kommunal helse- og omsorgstjenestelov § 5-4 og  Helsepersonelloven § 20 a.  (skal ikke vedlegges søknaden).

Søkere må benytte elektronisk søknadsskjema.

Arbeidsplassene i Bodø kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn.  

Bodø kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det.  

Fast ansatte i Bodø kommune med fortrinnsrett som overtallig, avklart omplasseringskandidat på bakgrunn av helse eller som ønsker å øke sin stillingsandel oppfordres til å søke.

Ditt navn kan bli offentliggjort, selv om du ber om å ikke bli oppført på søkerlisten. Dette blir du i så fall varslet om.

For alle stillinger gjelder de regler som går fram av lover, reglement og gjeldende tariffavtale.

Ved første gangs ansettelse i kommunen gjelder en prøvetid på inntil 6 måneder.

Søknad, CV og vedlegg sendes via lenke på denne siden. Har du spørsmål om elektronisk utfylling av CV kan Jobbnorge kontaktes på tlf. 75 54 22 20.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bodø er den ultimate kombinasjonen av kultur og natur. Vi er lokalisert midt mellom storslåtte naturperler i regionen rundt. Vi er uredde, har trua, er gode på samhandling og utvikler nye og smarte løsninger. 

Våre medarbeidere får det til å skje. En jobb i kommunen er en jobb med mening, hvor det du gjør betyr noe for innbyggerne - og gjør Bodø til et godt sted å leve.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us:

At SurplusMap, we are revolutionizing green infrastructure and sustainable mobility through data-driven, AI-powered technology. Our platform is at the forefront of EV charging infrastructure development, geospatial data analysis, and energy forecasting, with ongoing projects supported by leading European tech organizations such as ESA, EIT Urban Mobility, and backed by investors like Equinor-Techstars, Simula, and Bentley Systems.

Join us in accelerating the green transition across Europe as we scale our platform to optimize sustainable mobility and energy solutions.

The Role:

As a Data Engineer at SurplusMap, you will play a pivotal role in supporting our data pipelines and infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with our engineering and data science teams to help maintain efficient and scalable data architectures. Working alongside our Senior team, you will gain hands-on experience with large datasets within , ETL processes, and cutting-edge AI tools to power the green energy transition.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone eager to grow their technical skills and contribute to impactful projects aimed at electrifying the transportation industry and achieving cleaner cities.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate with our engineering and data science teams to design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, including ETL processes.
  • Implement and optimize data storage solutions using Google Cloud products like BigQuery.
  • Work with DBT and Dataform to build robust data transformation workflows.
  • Assist in managing cloud infrastructure with Terraform (nice to have).
  • Ensure data integrity and security across our platform by following best practices in data engineering.
  • Support AI-powered models for EV charger utilization, energy load forecasting, and geospatial analysis.
  • Participate in the design and development of scalable data architectures, contributing to projects aimed at optimizing sustainable mobility solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on projects that integrate machine learning models for energy and infrastructure predictions.
Desired Skills and Qualifications:
  • Can-do mindset, practical and hands-on with excellent communication skills and results-oriented.  
  • Strong proficiency in Google Cloud products (especially BigQuery).
  • Hands-on experience with SQL for querying large datasets.
  • Familiarity with DBT, Dataform, or similar tools for data transformations.
  • Basic knowledge of Python for scripting and automation.
  • Exposure to Terraform for infrastructure-as-code is a plus.
  • Understanding of data pipeline design, optimization, and ETL processes.
  • Interest in AI, geospatial data, and green energy technologies (experience with GIS tools or similar is a bonus).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate with diverse teams.
  • Preferred 2+ years of experience in relevant positions
What We Offer:
  • Work on cutting-edge projects in the EV charging infrastructure and green energy space.
  • Opportunity to collaborate with world-class partners like the European Space Agency and EIT Urban Mobility.
  • A vibrant, innovative startup environment with flexible working hours at our office in StartupLab in Oslo.
  • Be part of a mission-driven team dedicated to bold innovation, sustainability, and creating positive environmental impact.
Preferred Location:

We prefer candidates based in Oslo, but we are open to remote positions for the right candidate.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Introduction to SurplusMap SurplusMap is on a mission to revolutionize the way we develop and optimize EV charging infrastructure. By leveraging advanced geospatial tools and machine learning models, we empower energy companies, local utilities, and charge point operators to make informed decisions about site selection and utilization prediction. This ensures the efficient and effective deployment of charging stations, addressing a critical need in the rapidly growing electric vehicle market. Our secret advantage is our ability to draw on Norway's leadership in EV infrastructure, combined with our collaborations with top-tier partners like Google and Bentley Systems, to deliver cutting-edge solutions. The challenge we face is significant: the current pace of infrastructure development is insufficient to meet the future demands of the booming EV market. The market is highly fragmented, causing inconvenience for EV users and difficulties for energy companies and local utilities trying to optimize their investments. For instance, the EU mandates the installation of 6,000 new charging points per week by 2030, a target that is far from being met with the current rate of deployment. This gap presents a substantial opportunity for innovative solutions like SurplusMap to make a real difference. At SurplusMap, we focus on ensuring our customers invest wisely. Our sophisticated, map-based software integrates geospatial data and machine learning algorithms to pinpoint optimal sites for new charging stations. This means our clients can invest in the right locations, install the ideal number of chargers, and maintain high utilization rates over time. By doing so, we help them maximize their investments and build a robust EV infrastructure network that meets the demands of the future. We are driven by a vision of cleaner, more sustainable cities. Electric vehicles are crucial in reducing air pollution and creating healthier urban environments. However, the key to this transition lies in the efficient deployment of charging infrastructure that provides greater flexibility to the energy grid, allowing for more renewable energy sources to be integrated. At SurplusMap, we are passionate about facilitating this energy transition. By optimizing EV charging infrastructure, we help accelerate the shift to cleaner energy, positively impacting both the environment and the communities we live in. Join us in our mission to create a greener, more sustainable future through innovative technology and strategic planning. Together, we can drive the change needed to make our cities cleaner and our energy systems more resilient.

jobs.title: Ekte trygg og leken assistent søkes til livsnyting!

jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Fast
⏰ Arbeidstid: Dagtid 09.00 til 16.00 og kveld 16.00 til 22.00


Hei!

Jeg er en kvinne på 25 år som bor i egen leilighet i Ila. Jeg er engasjert og kreativ, og liker å skrive, dyrke, skape og kjenne meg levende. Jeg lever for de små tingene - yoghurt med sitronsmak, 🍋 føttene i fjorden og fuglesang i monitor. Selv om det er mest rolige dager, drømmer jeg om discokule og ABBA på kjøkkenet på en tirsdag og uendelig med energi til å danse. Du er med på å ligge i gresset og høre på bekken midt på dagen, eller lage tidenes spadag hjemme. Du er generelt ikke redd for å bli med og ha det gøy.

Jeg kommer med en hjelpemiddelpark, glimt i øyet (som oftest), to kosete katter, mange tanker og varierende funksjon.

Jeg funker best med deg som er ærlig, ekte, konkret og god. Det er et pluss om du kan sminke litt kult. Du kan danse med meg på kjøkkengulvet, skravle og tulle, men også være stille når det trengs. Du møter nye situasjoner med nysgjerrighet, uten å miste hodet (eller meg). 😅

Du har en god følelse for dagsform og problemløsing, og er trygg og stabil. Det er viktig at du kan bistå meg å holde struktur i hverdagen.

Jeg leter etter assistenter som kan steppe inn i oppgavene jeg ikke kan gjøre selv akkurat nå - en kollega i prosjekt liv, som vil gjøre det aller beste ut av dagen sammen med meg. Du synes ikke funksjonshemming er noe å skamme seg over, og heier genuint på et samfunn med hele mennesker.

Er dette deg, så gleder jeg meg til å lese søknaden din og eventuelt bli kjent med deg.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

· Husarbeid

· Innkjøp og ærend

· Tilberedning av måltid og oppfølging under måltid om nødvendig

· Tilrettelegging for daglig hygiene (hårvask, ansikt pleie og påkledning

· Ekstra stell ved behov

· Tilrettelegging av hobbyaktiviteter hjemme, kontor, helsetiltak og livsnyting.

· Bistå og legge til rette for sosiale aktiviteter utenfor huset

· Håndtering av hjelpemidler og være tilgjengelig for støtte når det er behov

· Mulighet til å være med på korte reiser

Stilling og arbeidstid:

Jeg søker nå etter en fast assistent opptil 30 timer i uka.

Tilkallingsvikarer

Arbeidstid er primært på dagtid mellom 09.00 til 16.00 og kveldstid 16.00 til 22.00, hverdag og helg. Åpen for tilpasning av arbeidstid etter avtale.

Oppgi i søknaden hvilken stilling du søker på og eventuelt oppgi ønsket timer i uka du kan jobbe.

Egenskaper og kvalifikasjoner:

· Personlig egnethet og kjemi vektlegges

· Trygg og stabil

· Strukturert og nøyaktig

· Ærlig

· Førerkort klasse B, fordel om du har egen bil.

· Gyldig politiattest

· Ikke allergisk mot katt

· Du må beherske flytende skriftlig og muntlig norsk

· Støtte til planlegging, organisering og struktur i hverdagen

Vi kaller inn til intervju fortløpende og ansetter så snart vi har funnet de rette kandidatene. Av sakens natur oppfordrer vi damer til å søke.

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Wenche Winsnes på epost: wenche.winsnes@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Falkor

We build industrial intelligence software for heavy-asset sectors. As a KONGSBERG company backed by over 200 years of heritage, Falkor helps the energy, chemicals, utilities and other industrial sectors operate with absolute clarity, confidence, and control.

Our AI-enabled platform connects people, systems, and workflows—expanding human capability by turning complex data into real-time, actionable decisions. We help leading organizations improve safety, efficiency and performance while redefining how heavy assets are designed and operated.

About the role

As part of this exciting journey, we're looking for a Content Marketing Manager to lead Falkor's global content strategy and build a world-class content function.

This is more than a traditional content marketing role. You'll shape how Falkor tells its story across products, industries and markets, helping customers understand the value of Industrial Intelligence while enabling Sales, supporting Product Marketing and strengthening our position as an industry leader.

Working closely with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Communications and Product Management, you'll transform complex industrial technology into compelling stories that educate, inspire and generate commercial impact.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop Falkor's global content marketing strategy and editorial calendar.

  • Lead our thought leadership programme across Industrial Intelligence, Digital Twins and AI.

  • Create and oversee compelling content including customer stories, articles, webinars, videos and campaign assets.

  • Lead Falkor's Content & Creative function, working with external agencies overseeing video production and visual design.

  • Partner with Product Marketing to bring product launches and messaging to life.

  • Work with Demand Generation to create content that drives pipeline and customer engagement.

  • Collaborate with Communications to strengthen executive thought leadership and corporate storytelling.

  • Use AI-powered tools to improve the quality, speed and scalability of content production.

  • Measure content performance and continuously optimise based on insights.

We're looking for someone who

  • Is an exceptional storyteller with a passion for making complex topics simple and engaging.

  • Thinks strategically but enjoys bringing ideas to life.

  • Has experience leading content programmes within B2B technology or SaaS.

  • Understands how content supports every stage of the customer journey.

  • Enjoys collaborating across Product, Sales, Marketing and Communications.

  • Is curious about AI, emerging technologies and the future of industrial operations.

Why Falkor?

You'll join a global marketing team at an exciting point in our journey as we establish Falkor as a leading Industrial Intelligence company. You'll have the opportunity to build a modern Content & Creative function from the ground up, influence how one of the industry's most innovative technology companies tells its story, and work alongside experts in Product, Sales and Communications to shape the future of industrial work.

We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and able to do their best work

Agency notice

Falkor occasionally partners with selected recruitment agencies for specific hiring requirements. We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions and will not be responsible for associated fees unless terms have been agreed in advance through our Procurement team.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Kongsberg Digital, our mission is to transform the world’s most complex and asset-intensive industries through world-leading, AI-powered digital twin technology. As a pioneer in industrial digitalization, we provide a comprehensive suite of software solutions that empower organizations to manage the full lifecycle of their assets—more efficiently, safely, and sustainably than ever before. The industry is on the cusp of a digital revolution—and we’re leading the charge. From early adoption of AI to building trusted partnerships with some of the world’s largest industrial players, we are redefining how work gets done. With domain expertise baked into every line of code and a high-calibre team united by a clear mission, we’re not just keeping pace with change—we’re setting the standard. As we expand rapidly across the Middle East and Africa, deepen our end-to-end offerings, and push the boundaries of AI, now is the perfect time to join a company that’s growing fast, thinking bold, and delivering real impact.

jobs.title: ML Engineer – Computer Vision: Build smarter, safer care technology
jobs.description:
Technology is changing what good care can look like.

Used well, technology can help care professionals identify risks earlier, respond faster and provide care that is better adapted to each individual. It can improve collaboration between colleagues, create greater continuity in everyday work and give care teams more time to focus on the people who need them.

Sensio is a leading European care technology company. Through our software platform Sensio 365, our nurse call solution, and our ‘hero-product’ the RoomMate AI multisensor, we help care providers deliver safer, more personalized and more efficient care. RoomMate is developed and manufactured in Norway, and it is probably the most widely deployed sensor of its kind across elderly care anywhere in the world.

With the backing of Nordic Capital, a leading European healthcare and healthtech investor, we are investing actively in product development and expanding the impact of our technology across international markets.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer

This role sits at the core of Sensio’s sensor-driven care technology, and is placed within our new AI team. You will work with machine learning models that run on embedded devices, close to the hardware, in products that need to perform reliably in real care environments.

Sensio’s technology uses advanced sensors, algorithms and embedded systems to support digital supervision and detect potentially dangerous situations.

Sensio’s technology generates a growing range of real-time signals, such as falls, noise and activity in a resident’s room. Other products and integrations contribute alarm data, events data and data from care environments both inside and outside of Sensio’s own ecosystem.

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will work mainly on training and evaluating Computer vision models. The models will make the best possible use of the hardware available, balancing performance, precision, robustness, memory, power consumption and deployment constraints.

We are looking for someone who understands the full journey from data and training to validation, deployment, hardware performance and continuous improvement.

You will join a strong product and engineering environment where hardware, software, data and machine learning work closely together. Your work can directly affect the safety of residents, the working day of healthcare professionals and the future of care technology.

Your day-to-day

You will be an instrumental part of the team developing, improving and deploying machine learning models for Sensio’s sensor-driven care technology. Your daily work will include:

  • Training, validating and improving computer vision models

  • Optimizing models for embedded devices and resource-constrained hardware, including performance, memory use and power consumption

  • Working with sensor data, including depth, time-of-flight or similar data sources, to improve model precision and robustness

  • Exporting, testing and preparing models for deployment

  • Building systems for continuous improvement, experiment tracking, model evaluation and feedback loops

  • Collaborating closely with embedded, software, product and data science colleagues to ensure that models work reliably in real-world care environments

This is what we’re looking for

We are looking for a machine learning engineer with strong experience in computer vision and model development for embedded or resource-constrained environments. This is a senior role that requires strong technical depth and the ability to work independently with complex machine learning problems, whether that expertise comes from industry, research or a combination of both. If you’re the right candidate for the job, you probably have:

  • A master’s degree or PhD in machine learning, computer science, robotics, signal processing or a related field

  • Solid experience with computer vision

  • Experience developing, training, validating and optimizing ML models for embedded devices or resource-constrained hardware

  • Strong Python skills and experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch

  • Experience working close to hardware, preferrably with sensors, depth cameras, time-of-flight data, robotics, drones, automotive systems or similar

  • Understanding of inference on edge hardware

This job does not require that your background is within care or healthcare technology, but you do need to understand what it means to build models that have to work reliably outside of a controlled lab environment.

Bonus points if you have experience with one or more of the following:

  • Time-of-flight cameras, depth sensors, spectrum data or sensor fusion

  • Embedded Linux, C++ or working closely with firmware or embedded software teams

  • Model profiling, memory optimization or low-power ML deployment

  • Hardware-in-the-loop testing, automated validation or continuous model evaluation

  • MLOps, experiment tracking, dataset versioning or model lifecycle tools such as MLflow

  • Safety-critical, privacy-sensitive or regulated products where reliability matters

At Sensio, the way you work is just as important as your technical background. We are looking for someone who is independent, curious and quality-conscious. Someone who can go deep technically but also collaborates well with people across disciplines. Someone who asks good questions, takes ownership and wants to build systems that improve over time.

What Sensio can offer

At Sensio, you get to work on technology with a clear purpose and a very real user need. RoomMate is not built for a slide deck, a demo room or a theoretical future. It is built for real care environments, with real people, alarms, staff shortages and real-life consequences for those who receive care, and those who provide it.

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Sensio, your work will help make sensor-driven care technology more precise, reliable and useful. Better models can mean better detection, fewer unnecessary interruptions, faster response and more confidence for the care teams using the technology every day.

This is the kind of machine learning where good engineering becomes more than good engineering. It becomes safety, dignity and more time for care.

What we can offer:

  • A central role in building and shaping Sensio’s AI capabilities, which will have a real-life effect on the future of care technology

  • The opportunity to build technology that supports healthcare professionals, residents, patients and next-of-kin

  • A Norwegian product and technology environment with international ambitions

  • A strong, cross-functional team working across hardware, software, product and design

  • Room to take ownership, influence technical direction and grow professionally

This is a role for someone who wants the complexity of machine learning, the constraints of embedded technology and the meaning of working on products that matter in everyday life.

If you want to build models that leave the lab and help shape the future of care technology, we would like to hear from you.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Sensio, we’re on a mission to accelerate the digital transformation of care. With roots in the Nordic start-up scene, we’ve grown into a fast-scaling caretech company backed by Nordic Capital, with more than 230 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK – and now expanding into Germany. Our technology is already installed in thousands of care homes and hospitals, helping staff prevent falls, save lives, and free up time for what really matters: people. We build everything from advanced safety sensors and cloud platforms to apps and data tools – all developed in-house by our 80+ product and tech specialists. What makes Sensio unique? - Impact with scale – our solutions improve everyday life for tens of thousands of residents and caregivers, and we’re just getting started. - A true growth journey – from Nordic frontrunner to European scale-up, we’re building the leading caretech platform of tomorrow. - Innovation at heart – our R&D teams shape the future of care technology with cutting-edge hardware, AI, and software. - People-first culture – we believe the best products come from teams that feel at home, have freedom to experiment, and share knowledge across borders. If you want to be part of a meaningful growth story – where tech meets one of society’s biggest challenges – join us. Let’s create more time for care.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Solutions Engineer at Eniris, you work closely with energy providers to design and build smart solutions for dynamic energy markets. You tackle algorithmic and architectural challenges related to energy optimisation, trading, and the control of physical energy assets.

By helping companies adapt to a volatile energy landscape, your work contributes directly to accelerating the energy transition.

Your responsibilities

- Translating functional and market-specific requirements into technical solution designs, algorithms, and scalable architectures.

- Working closely with Energy Suppliers around Europe to design and improve algorithms related to energy optimisation, flexibility, forecasting, and control of physical energy assets.

- Understanding the basic principles of energy systems, electricity markets, and the physical impact of software decisions on customer installations.

- Writing high-quality code that meets our standards, follows scrum methodology, and complies with modern development practices.

- Identifying, analysing, and resolving bugs efficiently while continuously improving system performance and reliability.

- Collaborating with colleagues across software, product, and energy-domain teams, while also being able to work independently.

- Relevant work experience, including internships.

- Experience in developing multi-tier, asynchronous and distributed systems.

- Familiarity with tools and technologies such as Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, and cloud-based environments.

- Basic understanding of energy systems or a strong interest in learning about dynamic energy markets.

- A proactive, problem-solving mindset and the ability to work both independently and in a team.

- A passion for working in a multinational, customer-driven environment.

jobs.title: Technical Service & Development Specialist
jobs.description:
EOC Group is growing its hotmelt adhesives business (Exomelt), as part of a portfolio of startups and new ventures. We are looking for a hands-on, dynamic Technical Service & Development Specialist to be the technical face of hotmelts to our customers, translating their applications, processes and specifications into the right hotmelt solution, and driving technical business development on the ground.

You will need a thorough, practical understanding of hot melt adhesives and some formulation know-how of your own, but you won't be doing deep chemistry alone. You can lean on a team of formulation and chemistry specialists to turn your technical offers into robust products. This is a customer-facing, solution-oriented role for someone who is as comfortable on a customer's production line as in a technical discussion.

What will you do?

  • You understand customers' applications, processes and specifications in depth, and translate them into the right hotmelt solution and a compelling technical offer.
  • You drive technical business development, identifying and pursuing opportunities with new and existing customers in a hands-on, dynamic way.
  • Once a solution is proposed, you support customers with in-line application advice, helping them run and troubleshoot hotmelt products on their equipment.
  • You act as the technical liaison between customers and EOC's formulation and chemistry specialists, briefing the team on customer requirements and translating technical results back to customers.
  • You provide training to agents and distributors who are intensively used to market our products.
  • You track technical market trends and innovations in hotmelt adhesives, and bring relevant insights back into EOC's product and technology roadmap.
  • You represent EOC and the Hotmelts business at industry conferences and trade shows, building EOC's technical reputation and network in the hotmelt adhesives market.

Who are you?

  • You bring a thorough understanding of hotmelt adhesives (EVA, APAO, rubber-based, polyolefin, or similar hotmelt technologies) and their end-use applications.
  • You have working formulation know-how, enough to have credible technical conversations and shape a technical offer, while relying on specialists for detailed formulation work.
  • You hold a chemistry degree or equivalent technical qualification (preferred).
  • You are hands-on and dynamic, with a genuine drive for technical business development, comfortable owning a customer relationship from technical scoping through to in-line support.
  • You communicate and build relationships strongly across customers, internal specialists, and management.
  • You are willing and able to travel approximately 50% of the time, mainly shorter trips to customer sites, conferences and trade shows, not extended multi-week travel.
  • You have a self-starting mindset suited to a startup environment, comfortable with ambiguity and building processes as the business scales.

You are fluent in English and German; additional European languages are an asset given EOC's customer base.

  • Keeping the warehouse organised and safe

After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

Be sure to apply if you:

  • Have experience in warehouse work or logistics
  • Can operate an electrical pallet truck (EPT) with ease
  • Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
  • Specifically want to work in night shift
  • Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

!! If you don't meet every requirement but have some warehouse experience and a strong work ethic, you can still apply !!

  • Have a valid Belgian address

jobs.title: Client Administration Officer
jobs.description:
A well-established and growing wealth management and investment advisory firm is looking for a Client Administration Officer to join its Brussels office.

This position is ideal for an experienced administrative professional who enjoys working in a client-focused environment, combining executive support, client administration, and financial follow-up.

You will work closely with one or several Client Relationship Managers and play a key role in ensuring excellent service delivery to clients.

Your responsibilities as Client Administration Officer

As a Client Administration Officer, you will provide comprehensive administrative support while ensuring a high level of service to both clients and internal stakeholders.

Administrative & Executive Support

  • Managing complex agendas and coordinating meetings
  • Screening and handling calls, emails, and correspondence
  • Welcoming clients and visitors
  • Organizing meeting rooms and coordinating logistics
  • Preparing presentations and administrative documentation
  • Managing and maintaining client files and archives
  • Ensuring smooth communication between clients, advisors, and internal teams
  • Maintaining and updating client information in internal databases

Client & Financial Administration

  • Processing and monitoring financial transactions and investment orders
  • Preparing reports, dashboards, and administrative analyses
  • Ensuring accurate and compliant client documentation
  • Supporting advisors in the day-to-day management of client relationships

Your profile as Client Administration Officer

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar administrative support role
  • Experience within a professional services environment (financial services, consulting, legal, wealth management, etc.) is a strong asset
  • Excellent knowledge of Dutch, with a good command of French and English
  • Strong administrative and organizational skills
  • Affinity with numbers and financial environments
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Service-oriented, proactive, and solution-driven mindset
  • High level of discretion and professionalism
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
  • Experience with CRM systems or databases is an asset

Navision, order processing and follow-up form the core of the role – but the position is clearly broader than traditional order administration.

As Administrative Officer – Technical Sales Support & Logistics, you are a key link between customers, suppliers and your colleagues. As you gain experience, you can also become more involved in logistics follow-up and the administrative support of technical projects.

  • Process and follow up customer orders in Microsoft Dynamics Navision.
  • Prepare quotations, order confirmations and purchase orders.
  • Place orders with suppliers and actively follow up delivery dates.
  • Support customers with questions about parts, spare parts and service.
  • Request prices and quotations from suppliers.
  • Follow up transport, deliveries, incoming goods and stock information.
  • Work closely with sales, project managers, engineers and technicians.
  • Occasionally provide practical support with a delivery or in the warehouse.

The practical logistics component is limited – around 5 to 10% of the role – but it reflects the way Buhlmann works: colleagues do not constantly draw a line around where one job description ends and another begins.

Once you know the organisation well, your responsibilities can expand towards project support, for example project files in SharePoint, material orders, delivery follow-up and administrative preparation for invoicing.

Above all, we are looking for someone who is administratively strong, takes responsibility and shows initiative.

You preferably have relevant experience in order administration, purchasing, sales support, customer service, logistics administration or a technical sales support role. You do not need to be a technical specialist, but an interest in a technical environment is important.

  • Experience with an ERP system; knowledge of Navision is a strong advantage. SAP or a comparable system also provides a good basis.
  • You work accurately and in a structured way and can keep several files, deliveries and deadlines under control at the same time.
  • You take initiative: if a supplier needs to be chased or a file needs further investigation, you do not simply wait.

  • You are fluent in Dutch and can communicate professionally in English. French is a clear advantage; German is a welcome extra.

Sensio is a leading European care technology company. Through our software platform Sensio 365, our nurse call solution, and our ‘hero-product’ the RoomMate AI multisensor, we help care providers deliver safer, more personalized and more efficient care. We’re looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer

This role is dedicated to the continued development of RoomMate.

Developed and manufactured in Norway, RoomMate is a privacy-first safety sensor designed for digital supervision in care environments. By combining advanced sensing, image processing and algorithms, RoomMate helps care teams identify falls and other potentially dangerous situations.

As an embedded software engineer, you will work on the embedded software that makes RoomMate reliable in real-world care environments. You will work closely with hardware, product and engineering colleagues to improve the product’s performance, precision and robustness, and to develop new functionality as RoomMate continues to evolve.

This is a role for someone who wants to understand the product, the people who use it, the technical constraints and the real-world consequences of the decisions being made, not just receive a ticket, write the code and move on.

You will join a strong product and engineering environment where hardware and software are developed in-house. Your work can directly contribute to safer care, a better working day for care professionals and the continued development of care technology across Europe.

The role can be based at Sensio’s offices in Sandvika or Oslo, with occasional travel between the two locations. You will report to the RoomMate Dev Lead.

Your day-to-day

You will be part of the team developing and improving the embedded software behind RoomMate. Your daily work will include:

  • Developing and maintaining embedded software in C++ on Linux

  • Working closely with colleagues across hardware, product, design and engineering to shape the next generation of RoomMate

  • Taking ownership of complex technical challenges, from problem definition to working solutions

  • Contributing to product discovery and technical decision-making

  • Improving the quality, reliability, performance and maintainability of a product used in real care environments

  • Supporting a strong engineering culture through knowledge-sharing, technical discussions and mentoring

This is what we’re looking for

We are looking for an experienced embedded software engineer who combines strong technical depth with product understanding and ownership. If you’re the right candidate for the job, you probably are:

  • Very experienced with C++ and embedded software development in Linux environments, preferably using Yocto

  • Experienced within Hardware in the Loop testing

  • Someone with good judgement when balancing technical quality, product needs and practical constraints

  • A team player - you thrive in a team environment, sharing knowledge and growing together.

  • A product-oriented thinker - you think beyond code and understand how technology impacts the end user

  • Fluent in English

Bonus points if you have experience with one of the following

  • Communication technologies such as TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, mobile networks or Bluetooth

  • Hardware development or close collaboration with hardware teams

  • CI/CD pipelines and testing in embedded environments

  • Signal processing, machine learning or AI-related functionality

  • Products where reliability, privacy, safety or regulatory considerations matter

At Sensio, the way you work is just as important as your technical background. It is important that you are someone who takes initiative, ask good questions, share knowledge and care about the product beyond the codebase.

What Sensio can offer

At Sensio, you will work on technology with a strong purpose and a genuine user need. RoomMate is developed for real care environments, where reliability, precision and thoughtful engineering directly affect both the people receiving care and the professionals supporting them.

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will contribute to a product that can help prevent dangerous situations, support more personalized care and give care teams better insight in their daily work. This is where strong engineering becomes more than technical quality: it contributes to safety, dignity and more time for care.

  • The opportunity to build technology that supports care professionals, residents and their next of kin

  • A Norwegian product and technology environment with an established European presence

  • A strong, cross-functional team working across hardware, software, product and design

  • The opportunity to take ownership, influence technical direction and grow professionally

This is a role for someone who wants the technical complexity of embedded software, the ownership that comes with product development and the opportunity to build technology that matters. If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you!

At Sensio, we’re on a mission to accelerate the digital transformation of care. We’re looking for a data engineer

This role sits in our data platform team and will work across our product, engineering and AI teams. Your responsibility will be to turn data from sensors, applications, and external systems into structured, reliable datasets that can be used across Sensio’s products.

In Sensio 365, we have a large and growing range of real-time signals. For example, our RoomMate sensor can register activity patterns, movement, presence, and noise in a resident’s room. Additionally, other Sensio devices, third party devices, and system integrations all contribute alarm and event data.

When all this data is processed, structured and combined over time, they can provide much more value for our customers than they do as individual datapoints. This is what enables products such as Sensio Insight to identify patterns, present meaningful information and help care providers better understand resident activity and what enable continuous improvement of the functionality and accuracy of our AI-sensor Roommate.

As a data engineer, you will build the processors, datasets and platform services that make this possible. You may receive data through an API, a Kafka message or an existing dataset, and your job will be to determine how it should be interpreted, transformed and stored so that it becomes reliable and useful downstream.

At Sensio, you shouldn’t expect to always receive your tasks as fully defined technical specifications. You will work in collaboration with product managers, machine learning engineers and other developers to understand the problem, define the right data structure and decide which processing is required.

This is a role for someone who is more interested in understanding the problem than reaching for a predetermined solution. You will help build a platform that supports an increasing number of sensors, data formats and use cases as our ecosystem continues to grow.

We are looking for someone who understands that good data engineering is what allows teams to build better models, better products and better decisions.

This role will be placed at Sensio’s office in Oslo. You will report to the Dev Lead for Data Platform.

You will contribute to the continued development of Sensio’s data platform and the data services that support products such as RoomMate, Sensio Insight and Sensio 365 more broadly. Your daily work will include:

  • Receiving data from APIs, Kafka and existing datasets

  • Turning sensor, alarm and activity data into reliable, structured datasets

  • Working with PostgreSQL and large data volumes

  • Collaborating closely with product managers, ML engineers and developers to define the right solutions

  • Improving platform reliability, scalability and secure data handling

This is what we’re looking for

We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer with strong technical judgement, high standards for data reliability and an understanding of how data supports modern product and ML development. If you’re the right candidate for the job, you probably have:

  • Strong experience with data engineering, backend development or data-heavy platform services

  • Strong C# and .NET skills

  • Experience with PostgreSQL and working with large data volumes

  • Strong understanding of data modelling, data structures and dataset design

  • Experience with data integrations, APIs, Kafka or other event-driven architectures

  • Familiarity with common data and machine learning tools such as Spark, MLflow and PyTorch

Your job is to make sure the data is reliable, structured, accessible, traceable and handled responsibly, so that the teams building models and products can move faster and make better decisions.

Bonus points if you have experience with one or more of the following:

  • FastAPI, dbt, Alembic or similar tools for building and maintaining data services

  • Multi-modal data, sensor data, image data, telemetry or data from edge devices

  • Kubernetes or cloud-based platform environments

  • Sensor data, IoT or real-time systems

  • Products where reliability, privacy, safety or regulatory considerations matter

This is the kind of data engineering where good infrastructure becomes more than good infrastructure. It becomes safety, dignity and more time for care.

  • The opportunity to work with multi-modal data, sensors, ML workflows and real-world products

  • The opportunity to build technology that supports healthcare professionals, residents, patients and next-of-kin

  • A Norwegian product and technology environment with an established European presence

  • A strong, cross-functional team working across hardware, software, product and design

  • Room to take ownership, influence technical direction and grow professionally

This is a role for someone who wants the complexity of data engineering, the responsibility of building trusted infrastructure and the meaning of working on technology that matters in everyday life.

If you want to build the data foundation behind smarter, safer and more useful care technology, we would like to hear from you.

As an AI lead you will scale Sensios work on AI across edge and server. A key part of the work is embedded AI on the RoomMate device: making models work locally, on sensors and devices with real hardware constraints. It is a unique challenge to make AI work reliably on a device on the wall, with limited memory, different hardware capabilities, privacy requirements and real-time use cases.

This is a role with Technical responsibility for the development, deployment, and continuous improvement of Sensio’s AI and machine learning solutions, both on embedded hardware and in server-based services.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role with formal people responsibility. You will set technical direction, make architecture and prioritisation decisions, develop the team and remain sufficiently close to the technology to challenge designs, review evidence and guide difficult technical trade-offs.

Your role will be to scale our foundation, set direction, build capability and make sure Sensio’s AI work becomes scalable, responsible and useful in real care environments – and deeply integrated across our total offering.

While customer-facing AI products will remain the clear priority, you will also work with Internal IT, infrastructure and HR leadership to accelerate the adoption of AI across Sensio. This includes helping redesign processes, tools and ways of working to enable a broader transformation of the company’s operating model.

Your day-to-day

You will lead Sensio’s AI transformation and take responsibility for direction, quality and progress across AI initiatives. You’ll report directly to Sensio’s CPTO, and collaborate closely with Dev Leads and enterprise IT. Your daily work will include:

  • Leading and developing a team working across ML, AI transition and software/hardware implementation

  • Setting technical direction for AI across data, model development, MLOps, validation, deployment and performance tracking

  • Driving embedded AI initiatives, including models that need to run locally on resource-constrained sensors and devices

  • Working closely with data, annotation, ML, embedded, product and engineering teams to build reliable AI workflows from data to hardware

  • Improving robustness, explainability, privacy and scalability across Sensio’s AI systems

  • Helping establish internal principles, standards and ways of working for responsible and effective use of AI

This is what we’re looking for

We are looking for a technically strong AI Lead with deep machine learning competence, strong academic grounding and the ability to lead both people and transformation. If you’re the right candidate for the job, you probably have:

  • Strong experience with machine learning, computer vision or embedded AI, preferably from products that operate in real-world environments

  • Advanced academic training in machine learning, computer science, robotics, signal processing, applied mathematics or a related discipline, normally at master’s or PhD level, or equivalent depth demonstrated through relevant industrial research and development

  • Experience across several parts of the ML lifecycle, such as data preparation, model development, validation, deployment, MLOps and performance monitoring

  • Understanding of edge AI, hardware constraints, model optimization, quantization or deployment to resource-constrained devices

  • The ability to lead strong technical people, create direction, handle complexity and build confidence in a fast-moving environment

You do not need to have done everything Sensio is trying to build. Very few people have. But you do need to understand the full technical landscape well enough to make good decisions, ask the right questions and lead specialists across the pipeline.

Bonus points if you have experience with one or more of the following:

  • Time-of-flight sensors, IR sensors, depth data, computer vision, sensor fusion or signal-based AI

  • Embedded Linux, C++, Pytorch or similar frameworks and tools

  • Fleet-wide deployment, model monitoring, continuous model evaluation or industrial scalability of AI systems

  • Privacy-preserving AI, anonymization, GDPR, access control, security or explainability

You will work with a wide range of sensor data, image data, audio, video, telemetry, annotations, embedded machine learning, agents, internal AI tools and AI-enabled product functionality. Few environments can offer the same combination of real-time data, meaningful use cases, hardware constraints and societal importance.

  • Room to shape AI principles, technical direction, team capability and ways of working

jobs.description:
About Falkor

We build industrial intelligence software for heavy-asset sectors. As a KONGSBERG company backed by over 200 years of heritage, Falkor helps the energy, chemicals, utilities and other industrial sectors operate with absolute clarity, confidence, and control.

About the position

We're looking for an experienced Brand Specialist to execute on existing brand strategy across all channels.

This role expertly oversees and applies the brand’s approved assets and guidelines to ensure flawless, consistent implementation. This role requires deep hands-on design experience in production, workflows, vendor coordination, digital channels, and quality control, but also speed and flexibility in hands-on production of varied collateral.

What you'll do

  • Produce marketing, communication, or other relevant collateral according to brand guidelines

  • Maintain brand consistency across all touchpoints

  • Manage the production workflow for all marketing collateral, coordinating vendors and internal teams

  • Overview and maintain asset management

  • Educate and advocate for brand values

  • Maintain fast turn-around times while ensuring high-quality output

Ownership

  • Be accountable for the quality and timely delivery of branded collateral

  • Implement design best practices across team members, vendors, and consultants

  • Ensure design outcomes meet brand guidelines and quality standards

  • Take responsibility for personal growth, goal setting, and skill development

Talent

  • Continuously improve production-grade personal design skills and stay current with industry trends, standards, and the latest production tools

  • Show curiosity and adaptability, learning new production techniques and workflow optimisation

  • Foster a collaborative work environment with open communication and strong team spirit across business lines

What we're looking for

  • Master's degree in a relevant field or equivalent relevant professional experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on design experience with a proven track record of delivering brand collateral

  • Strong verbal and written English

  • Broad proficiency in design methods and execution, with a particular focus on branding for both static and motion assets, digital channels, and product implications

  • Portfolio that demonstrates a relevant range of design skills and experience in brand design delivered for global digital products

  • Experience adapting brand systems for global audiences, as well as designing for accessibility

  • Proven ability to work with cross‑disciplinary stakeholders (product, engineering, marketing, legal) and to manage vendor relationships, ensuring assets are produced on schedule and to specification

  • Strong proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (still and motion), Frontify, etc.

Why join Falkor?

You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate.

At Falkor, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work on meaningful challenges with real-world impact

  • Collaborate with talented colleagues across technology and industry domains

  • Learn from experts in software, engineering, operations, and digital transformation

  • Grow your career in a business that is expanding globally

  • Help shape technology that expands human capability in complex industries

We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and able to do their best work.

Ready to apply?

If you're excited about solving complex challenges and making an impact through technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your resume and your portfolio

(Please submit your portfolio via the Additional Files in the application section)

Timelines

The hiring process is due to kick-off in August. Please expect a delay in response until then.

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join the Infrastructure team within our Platform product area. You will play a key role in designing, building, and operating a modern, cloud-native, AI-ready platform that supports data-intensive and AI-enabled services in production.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with high autonomy and ownership. You will work closely with product, data, and software engineering teams to ensure the platform is reliable, scalable, secure, and easy to operate over time. The role is intended for engineers who are motivated by long-term platform evolution and have a strong background in software development to build internal platforms, tools, and services that improve developer productivity and operational efficiency.

You will help design and build the systems, services, and developer platforms that form the foundation of our technology ecosystem and enable future AI-driven innovation.

• Design, build, and operate cloud-native infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and other cloud platforms

• Own platform reliability, performance, security, and cost efficiency

• Share responsibility for platform stability and operational health, contributing to prevention, analysis, and continuous improvement

• Maintain clear, practical technical documentation and operational runbooks

• Apply security-by-design principles at platform level, including IAM, RBAC, network policies, and workload isolation

Software Engineering

Kubernetes and Container Platforms

• Manage container orchestration using Kubernetes, including deployment, scaling, and network configuration

• Package and deploy workloads using Helm

• Troubleshoot platform-level issues related to containers and orchestration

• Support data-intensive platform components and stateful services at infrastructure level

Monitoring, Observability and Operations

• Implement and maintain monitoring and observability using Azure Monitor, Mimir, Grafana, Tempo, or similar tools

• Build and evolve logging and telemetry pipelines to improve operational insight

CI/CD and Automation

• Integrate platform capabilities with CI/CD and GitOps workflows

• Strong experience operating cloud-native platforms in production

• Solid hands-on expertise with Kubernetes and Azure

• Strong software development experience with at least one modern programming language (Python, Go, Java, C#, TypeScript, etc.)

• Experience designing, developing, and maintaining production software systems

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code tooling

• Good understanding of platform operations, automation, and observability

• Ability to write maintainable automation scripts (PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar)

• Strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative mindset

• Fluency in English, written and spoken

Desirable Experience

• Experience supporting AI or ML workloads in production

• Exposure to GitOps, service mesh (e.g. Istio), or hybrid infrastructure

Work model: Hybrid (minimum 3 days per week in the office at Fornebu)

Why join Falkor?

You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate.

  • Work on meaningful challenges with real-world impact

  • Collaborate with talented colleagues across technology and industry domains

  • Help shape technology that expands human capability in complex industries

We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and able to do their best work.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Monil is building world-leading technology for virtual fencing and livestock monitoring. In just three years, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of thousands collars in active use across multiple markets. We are now entering a new phase of international growth — and the scalability and reliability of our backend platform will be critical to our success.

Our technology is trusted by forward-thinking farmers, research institutions, and agricultural organizations across several countries. Every day, thousands of animals rely on our systems running smoothly.

Our devices collect large amounts of real-time data from animals in the field. We process, analyze, and transform this data into actionable insights that improve animal welfare, farming efficiency, and sustainability. Behind this is a modern, cloud-based backend platform built for performance, resilience, and scale.

We're now looking for a Site Reliability Engineer who wants to help us build a reliable platform, scaling across the globe.

What we're looking for

  • Strong experience with AWS and Kubernetes

  • Experience with building and maintaining CD pipelines and deployment strategies

  • Experience running and maintaining PostgreSQL databases

  • Experience with networks

  • Experience with monitoring and alerting using tools such as Prometheus and OpenTelemetry

Bonus points for

  • Fluency in Norwegian (preferred, but we make exceptions for the exceptional)

  • Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment

Our Tech Stack

  • Heavy use of Kubernetes (EKS)

  • Large PostgreSQL databases

  • Terraform, ArgoCD, LinkerD, Alloy, Tempo and more

What We Offer

Join a high-growth startup entering an exciting international scale-up phase. You won’t just write code, you’ll own features and initiatives, influence technical decisions, and help build the foundation of a growing company. Nevertheless your work will create meaningful impact by improving animal welfare, farming efficiency, and global sustainability. You’ll collaborate with a highly interdisciplinary team across hardware, embedded systems, backend, and frontend. We offer a competitive salary, including an option program.

Requirements

Candidates must have the right to work in Norway or within the EU/EEA, as we are unable to support relocation or visa sponsorship from outside this area.

If you're excited about building technology that makes a real-world difference, we’d love to hear from you.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Accelerate the worlds transition to sustainable agriculture by automating animal care. We design and build high-tech smart collars that benefits both farmer, animal and environment: - The farmer saves time and money on building fences and animal feed - The animals spend less time inside and more time grazing on open pastures - The smart collars enable grazing techniques that boost soil health and reduce the need for artificial fertilizer

jobs.description:
Your mission at Voi 

For the position as a Fleet Specialist, you'll have the possibility of working in two different areas, depending on workload and suitability. We have our mechanical team, where you will be responsible for the maintenance and repair of our vehicles. This means keeping our scooters in top shape and provide strong support to our team on the ground. We also have our In field team, where you'll be utilising our vans to perform different tasks in the Oslo area, making sure our operations runs as efficiently as possible. Here are some exciting tasks awaiting you as a Fleet Specialist:

  • Ensuring the logistics of collecting and providing Voi scooters.⚙️

  • Searching for and collecting damaged scooters. 🛴

  • Battery replacement.🔋

  • Performing quick on-site repairs of the scooters.🔧

  • Diagnosing and repairing broken vehicles.🔧

  • Recycling and dismantling vehicles that cannot be repaired. ♻️

  • Assisting with the acceptance, packaging, and provision of new vehicles and batteries arriving at the warehouse. 🔍

  • Supporting our on-site team as needed, whether it's identifying damaged vehicles, clearing parking spaces, or setting up fallen vehicles.🤝

What you'll need to embark

We're looking for a highly motivated and responsible team player who can handle tasks and solve problems independently. With a proactive approach, you should be skilled in finding innovative solutions and achieving set objectives. In addition, the right candidate should have:

  • A valid drivers license for Norway preferred

  • Fluent english, both verbal and written

  • Previous experience with tools or mechanical practices

  • General familiarity with digital tools and applications

  • Local knowledge of Oslo and experience driving in the city

  • The ability to remain calm in stressful situations (such as difficult parking or traffic)

Job conditions 

  • Working hours: Part time 80% - Rotating shifts

  • Contract type: Fixed term

  • Start date: ASAP

NOTE: our Talent Acquisition is based in UK, you will receive a phone call from a UK number (+44)

Why Voi?

Working at Voi is more than just a job; it's a personal Voiage where you'll grow as a professional and be part of a diverse team and culture that's committed to making a positive impact on society. In addition to this, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Join Europe's leading micromobility company and one of the fastest-growing scale-ups

  • Make a direct impact on our ongoing success and contribute to the development of the micromobility industry in Oslo.

  • Collaborate with inspiring, motivated, and diverse colleagues who share a common goal

  • Be a part of the micromobility revolution and help create sustainable cities that are clean, quiet, and free from pollution

Are you ready to embark on the Voiage with us?

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Voi is one of the fastest-growing mobility companies in the world. Born in Sweden, we drive innovation through our state-of-the-art hardware and software solutions, shaping the future of sustainable transportation and urban development. Experience the convenience of getting from point A to point B with our shared electric vehicles, while reducing air and noise pollution and easing traffic congestion across Europe.

jobs.title: Helsefagarbeider - 2 stk 100% vikariat, med mulighet for fast, i felles nattjeneste
jobs.description:
Ønsker du en spennende og meningsfull jobb hvor du får bruke din kompetanse på tvers av ulike tjenesteområder? Ved Felles natt, som er en del av Hjemmetjenesten sone Farsund, har vi nå ledig 2 x 100 % vikariat med mulighet for fast ansettelse.

Felles natt yter tjenester til brukere i hjemmetjenesten, institusjon og omsorgsboliger, og er en viktig del av kommunens samlede helse- og omsorgstjenester. Hos oss får du en variert arbeidshverdag med faglige utfordringer, tett samarbeid med dyktige kollegaer og mulighet til å gjøre en forskjell for mennesker som trenger det mest.

Stillingene innebærer arbeid hver 2. eller 3. helg etter avtale. Det er ønskelig med snarlig tiltredelse, men oppstart kan avtales nærmere.
Som ansatt ved Felles natt må du påregne å arbeide ved ulike avdelinger innen enheten. Dette gir gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og et bredt innblikk i kommunens helse- og omsorgstjenester.

Ved intern rekruttering i enheten kan andre stillinger bli ledige. Søkere kan derfor, etter en konkret vurdering, bli tilbudt andre stillinger ved enheten.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Gi helhetlig og omsorgsfull pleie, behandling og oppfølging til brukere med ulike behov
  • Observere, vurdere og følge opp endringer i brukernes helsetilstand, og bidra til trygge og forsvarlige tjenester gjennom natten
  • Utføre prosedyrer og oppgaver knyttet til behandling, pleie og omsorg i tråd med gjeldende rutiner og faglige retningslinjer
  • Bidra til å ivareta trygghet, verdighet, lindring, livskvalitet og mestring hos den enkelte bruker
  • Benytte teknologi som en naturlig og integrert del av tjenesteutøvelsen
  • Delta i målrettet miljøarbeid og bidra til å fremme brukernes ressurser og selvstendighet
  • Samarbeide med brukere, pårørende, kollegaer og øvrige samarbeidspartnere for å sikre helhetlige og koordinerte tjenester
  • Bidra til et godt fagmiljø, kvalitetsutvikling og et positivt arbeidsmiljø
  • Arbeide på tvers av hjemmetjeneste, institusjon og omsorgsboliger etter behov
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Autorisasjon som helsefagarbeider. Søkere med påbegynt helsefagutdanning eller annen relevant helse- og sosialfaglig bakgrunn oppfordres også til å søke
  • Relevant arbeidserfaring fra helse- og omsorgstjenesten er ønskelig
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Grunnleggende digital kompetanse og evne til å benytte velferdsteknologiske løsninger i tjenesten
  • Førerkort klasse B er en fordel
Personlige egenskaper
  • Har fokus på hva som er viktig for den enkelte bruker, og bidrar til at brukere og pårørende opplever trygghet, omsorg, kvalitet og gode tjenester
  • Motiverer brukere og kollegaer til å ha fokus på mestring, ressurser og muligheter
  • Trives med å arbeide både selvstendig og i samarbeid med andre
  • Har evne til å håndtere utfordrende situasjoner og gjøre gode faglige vurderinger når det kreves
  • Er fleksibel, initiativrik og løsningsorientert
  • Har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner
  • Er strukturert og opptatt av god dokumentasjon og informasjonsdeling
  • Er positiv til utvikling og tar i bruk teknologi som en naturlig del av tjenesteutøvelsen

jobs.title: Gode hjemmetjenester ledes av flinke folk! Er du vår nye avdelingsleder?
jobs.description:
Avdelingsleder hjemmesykepleien

 

Vil du lede et engasjert team som gjør en forskjell for mennesker i eget hjem?

Om oss

Hjemmesykepleien er fordelt i to soner. Vi tilbyr helhetlige og trygge tjenester til innbyggere som har behov for oppfølging og pleie i eget hjem. Vi jobber for å skape en meningsfull hverdag, legger vekt på tverrfaglig samarbeid og har fokus på faglig utvikling og kvalitet i tjenestene våre. Hjemmebaserte tjenester er i utvikling og nå søker vi en engasjert og strukturert avdelingsleder som kan være med å videreutvikle vårt gode arbeidsmiljø og styrke tilbudet til brukerne. Avdelingsleder får kombinere menneskekunnskap med faglig utvikling og strategisk arbeid. Stillingen ligger i virksomhet for hjemmebaserte tjenester og rapporterer til virksomhetsleder.

 

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Personal- og fagansvar for per nå 23 årsverk
  • Medansvar for økonomi
  • Lede og utvikle avdelingens ansatte gjennom tydelig kommunikasjon, oppfølging og veiledning
  • Sikre god kvalitet og forsvarlige tjenester til brukerne
  • Legge til rette for kompetanseutvikling og et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Samarbeide tett med øvrige ledere i hjemmetjenesten og øvrige samarbeidspartnere
  • Bidra til effektiv ressursstyring og utvikling av tjenestetilbudet i tråd med kommunens mål

Krav til stillingen

  • Autorisasjon som sykepleier
  • Erfaring fra hjemmesykepleie eller annen relevant helsetjeneste
  • Ledererfaring fra helse og omsorgtjenester
  • Påbegynt eller fullført lederutdanning
  • God kjennskap til lovverk og forskrifter innen helse- og omsorgssektoren
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter og erfaring med bruk av EPJ og velferdsteknologi
  • Evne til å lede, motivere og skape et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig

Personlige egenskaper

  • Du er strukturert, løsningsorientert og har høy gjennomføringsevne
  • Du har gode kommunikasjonsevner og trives med å jobbe med mennesker
  • Du er fleksibel, engasjert og har et ønske om å bidra til utvikling
  • Du takler høyt tempo og endringer på en god måte
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt

Vi tilbyr

  • En spennende og variert lederstilling med mulighet for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Trivelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø
  • En hjemmesykepleie det satses på – hvor kommunen ser viktigheten av stabil drift og faglig utvikling
  • Spennende og utfordrende samarbeid på tvers av avdelinger og fagområder
  • Mulighet til å bidra i utviklingen av framtidens hjemmetjenester med fokus på velferdsteknologi og kvalitet.
  • Lønn etter kompetanse og gjeldene lov- og avtaleverk
  • I denne stillingen har du rett på en av Norges sikreste pensjonsordninger: offentlig tjenestepensjon. Der de fleste tjenestepensjoner kun utbetales i 10 år, er offentlig tjenestepensjon en utbetaling som varer fra den dagen du slutter å jobbe og livet ut. Pensjonen inkluderer også uføre - og etterlattepensjon hvis noe uventet skulle skje. I Kragerø kommune blir alle ansatte medlem av KLP/SPK med 2 % av lønnen. Vil du vite mer om pensjnsordningen ? https://www.klp.no/pensjon/offentlig-tjenestepensjon-kort-fortalt
  • Tilsetting finner for øvrig sted på de betingelser som gjelder i Kragerø kommune, derav  6. mnd prøvetid.

 

Vi ønsker et arbeidsmiljø preget av mangfold, og at våre ansatte skal gjenspeile befolkningen forøvrig.  Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, eller minoritetsbakgrunn.  

Etter søknadsfristens utløp, vil det bli satt opp en offentlig søkerliste inneholdende navn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bosteds- eller arbeidskommune for hver søker. Det kan gjøres unntak fra innsyn for opplysninger om en søker dersom vedkommende selv ber om det. Opplysninger om en søker kan bli offentlige selv om søkeren har anmodet om ikke å bli ført opp på søkerlisten. Dersom anmodningen ikke blir tatt til følge vil søkeren bli varslet om dette. Vil du vite mer om pensjonsordningen? https://www.klp.no/pensjon/offentlig-tjenestepensjon-kort-fortalt

I Kragerø kommune blir alle ansatte medlem av KLP/SPK med 2 % av lønnen. Tilsetting finner for øvrig sted på de betingelser som gjelder i Kragerø kommune, derav 6. mnd prøvetid.
