Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kragerø er en kjent sommerby som ligger vakkert til ved kysten med et mylder av øyer og skjær – Perlen blant kystbyene. Naturen, skjærgården, kunst og kultur sammen med fargerik småbyidyll legger til rette for gode opplevelser og et berikende friluftsliv til alle årstider. Kragerø kommune har ca. 10500 innbyggere og et variert nærings- og kulturliv. Kommunen har full barnehagedekning, et desentralisert grunnskoletilbud og videregående skole med et variert tilbud. Innenfor en reisetid på en time når du en rekke større byer i regionen og sentrale kommunikasjonsknutepunkter. Aktive innbyggere, lag og foreninger, næringslivet og kommunen arbeider sammen til felles innsats og bidrar til at Kragerø er et godt sted å bo, besøke og drive næring i.

jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.description:
Building the future of architectural visualization

Our mission is to help architects bring their vision to life. We’re building a web-based application for architects that speed up their design workflows and makes high-quality visualization accessible to a wider audience.

We have experienced rapid growth in recent months and we are hiring to further scale the company. We have customers in over 120 different countries, including leading offices such as Nordic, Leo A Daly, and S+A, who collectively have generated over 6 million visualizations on our platform since the company was established in 2023.

We’ve raised over €3 million from leading Nordic investors to date, helping us build toward our mission. We’re now looking for talented individuals who want to challenge the status quo and reinvent how architects and industry professionals communicate their designs.

 

What you will do

As a product-led growth company, growth is central to helping the right users discover, adopt, and succeed with Visoid.

As one of the first members of our new Growth team, you will work closely with the Growth Manager, Product, and Commercial team. Your role is to turn growth ideas into working solutions across the full user journey from acquisition and onboarding to conversion, retention, and referral.

If you enjoy shipping quickly, working with data, and using engineering to create measurable user and business impact, we would love to hear from you.

As the Growth Engineer at Visoid, you will:

  • Build across the funnel: Improve acquisition, signup, onboarding, activation, conversion, retention, and referral.

  • Run experiments: Work with the Growth Manager to design, build, launch, and evaluate frequent growth experiments.

  • Improve the product experience: Identify friction points and build solutions that help users reach value faster.

  • Build growth infrastructure: Implement tracking, analytics, attribution, feature flags, and experimentation tools.

  • Create growth experiences: Develop landing pages, onboarding flows, referral programs, invitation flows, and in-product loops.

  • Build integrations and automations: Connect analytics, CRM, payment, marketing, and communication tools.

  • Use AI to move faster: Use AI-assisted and agentic tools to prototype, build, and test efficiently.

  • Ship with ownership: Take ideas from problem definition to production and iteration.

     

Who you are

We are seeking a creative individual with a commercial mindset who is as obsessed with our users as we are. You should be a self-motivated team player committed to delivering real value and solving genuine user problems.

We think you will thrive in Visoid if:

  • You have an ability to communicate with users and apply insights into concrete product improvements.

  • You have a startup mindset and can independently prioritize the most valuable tasks when resources are limited.

  • You are self-driven with a “doer” mentality focused on moving fast and getting the job done.

  • You are eager to learn and acquire new skills.

 

Minimum Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, software engineering, or a related field

  • At least 3 years of professional experience working full-time in software, product, or growth engineering.

  • Experience building and shipping user-facing web applications.

  • Strong frontend skills and experience with APIs, backend services, and databases.

  • Experience with analytics, event tracking, integrations, or experimentation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience using agentic development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or similar.

  • Founder mentality. You are building a function, not inheriting one.

 

Optional qualifications

  • Experience in a SaaS startup, scale-up, or product-led growth team.

  • Built onboarding, referral, invitation, monetization, or experimentation flows.

  • Worked with tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or PostHog.

  • Shipped experiments that significantly improved activation, conversion, retention, or revenue.

     

We are looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The optional qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

We prioritize candidates that are either are already located in Oslo, or who have an existing right to work in Norway and are willing to relocate to Oslo.

 

Perks and benefits

We strive to offer competitive benefits for our employees. Here's what you can expect from us:

  • 4% pension contribution

  • Flexible work hours

  • Flexible home-office arrangement

  • 5 weeks vacation

  • Choice of computer equipment and mobile device

  • Gym membership

  • Cantina with subsidized lunch

  • Monthly social and educational events

     

We are located at StartupLab, the leading co-working space for startups in Norway.

 

Compensation and equity

We offer a competitive salary, adjusted for early-stage growth companies.

As an early hire you have the unique opportunity to secure a significant equity stake in the company. You will be directly invested in our success and share the rewards as we grow. Your contributions will not only shape the future of the company but also provide you with substantial financial upside if we achieve our goals.

 

About the team

As a company, we foster a team-focused culture that values ambition, collaboration and honesty. We want to assemble a team of innovative technologists and product enthusiasts who are passionate about building a great product for our users.

With the company numbering 12 employees, and already representing 10 different nationalities, we are no doubt a diverse group of people. Most of us are located in-person at the Oslo office in Norway.

 

Working at Visoid

We believe in a high-performance culture driven by speed, user impact, and continuous improvement through direct, respectful feedback. We favor rapid iteration and a "move fast and learn" approach over perfection. If you thrive in a dynamic environment, want to directly impact the product, and aren't afraid to challenge the status quo, you'll fit right in.

Beyond the work, we value a positive, inclusive atmosphere. To stay motivated, creative, and connected, we host monthly team social events where we try out new activities and simply enjoy spending time together.

 

Why Norway?

Norway combines a thriving tech industry with high living standards, and strong social benefits. Since English is widely spoken, international talent can easily settle in and feel at home.

Oslo itself is uniquely positioned: local public transport can take you to both the sea and the mountains in under 30 minutes. Whether you’re an outdoor enthusiast, an urban explorer, or a foodie looking to enjoy the city's rich restaurant and museum scene, Oslo truly has something for everyone.

jobs.title: Power System Delivery Engineer - Kognitwin Grid
jobs.description:
About Falkor

We build industrial intelligence software for heavy-asset sectors. As a KONGSBERG company backed by over 200 years of heritage, Falkor helps the energy, chemicals, utilities and other industrial sectors operate with absolute clarity, confidence, and control.

Our AI-enabled platform connects people, systems, and workflows—expanding human capability by turning complex data into real-time, actionable decisions.

We help leading organisations improve safety, efficiency and performance while redefining how heavy assets are designed and operated.

About the Position

We're looking for an experienced Power System Delivery Engineer to join our Power & Utilities team and play a key role in scaling Kognitwin Grid. Kognitwin Grid helps transmission and distribution utilities better understand, model and operate increasingly complex energy networks. As electrification accelerates and grid operators face new challenges, digital technologies are becoming critical to enabling smarter planning and operational decision-making.

This role sits at the intersection of power systems engineering, customer delivery and digital transformation. You will lead customer projects from proof-of-concept through operational deployment, working closely with utilities, engineers, data specialists and product teams to ensure our solutions deliver meaningful value for customers.

This is an opportunity to combine deep domain expertise with project leadership while helping shape the future of grid digitalisation.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead Customer Delivery

  • Lead delivery of Kognitwin Grid projects from project initiation through operational rollout.

  • Manage scope, schedules, risks, stakeholders and project governance activities.

  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across software engineering, data engineering and power systems experts.

  • Ensure successful execution of customer commitments and business outcomes.

Provide Power Systems Expertise

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor for transmission and distribution utility customers.

  • Apply expertise in grid planning and operations including load flow analysis, contingency analysis, hosting capacity studies and network modelling.

  • Validate and assure quality of grid models built from customer source systems.

  • Support customers in applying digital technologies to operational and planning challenges.

Understand Customer Challenges

  • Work closely with engineering, planning and operational teams to understand customer use cases and business needs.

  • Facilitate workshops and requirements-gathering sessions.

  • Translate customer challenges into practical technical solutions.

  • Build trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders.

Collaborate Across Product and Engineering Teams

  • Work with product and engineering teams to ensure customer requirements are understood and effectively addressed.

  • Provide customer feedback and market insights that help improve the product.

  • Support identification and evaluation of new use cases and future opportunities.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of customer delivery approaches.

What We Are Looking For

Must-Have Experience

  • MSc or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems or a related discipline.

  • Experience working within power system planning, operations or grid engineering.

  • Experience working with utilities, TSOs, DSOs, consultancies or energy technology providers.

  • Knowledge of power system modelling and simulation tools such as PowerFactory, PSS®E, PandaPower, PSCAD or equivalent.

  • Experience leading technical projects involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Fluent English language skills.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • Experience supporting grid digitalisation, advanced analytics or operational technology initiatives.

  • Experience working with digital twin platforms, grid software solutions or ADMS/DERMS technologies.

  • Exposure to product organisations, requirements management or software delivery environments.

  • Familiarity with Azure, APIs or modern data integration approaches.

  • Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or equivalent).

  • Additional European language capability, including Norwegian.

Why Join Falkor?

You'll be joining a company helping to redefine how utilities and industrial organisations operate through industrial intelligence.

At Falkor, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Help accelerate the energy transition through digital innovation.

  • Work with some of the world's leading utilities and power system operators.

  • Solve complex technical challenges with real-world impact.

  • Collaborate with experts across engineering, software, product and industry domains.

  • Influence the future direction of a growing product offering.

  • Develop your expertise within a company that combines industrial heritage with advanced digital technology.

What We Offer

  • A key role within a high-growth business area.

  • Exposure to leading utilities and critical energy infrastructure.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

  • Flexible working arrangements.

  • Professional development and learning opportunities.

  • An inclusive and collaborative international environment.

  • The opportunity to help shape the future of grid digitalisation.

Ready to Apply?

If you're excited about combining power systems expertise, customer engagement and digital innovation to help modernise the electricity grid, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply with your CV and tell us about a project where you helped solve a complex grid planning, operational or digital transformation challenge.

Agency Notice

Falkor occasionally partners with selected recruitment agencies for specific hiring requirements. We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions and will not be responsible for associated fees unless terms have been agreed in advance through our Procurement team.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Kongsberg Digital, our mission is to transform the world’s most complex and asset-intensive industries through world-leading, AI-powered digital twin technology. As a pioneer in industrial digitalization, we provide a comprehensive suite of software solutions that empower organizations to manage the full lifecycle of their assets—more efficiently, safely, and sustainably than ever before. The industry is on the cusp of a digital revolution—and we’re leading the charge. From early adoption of AI to building trusted partnerships with some of the world’s largest industrial players, we are redefining how work gets done. With domain expertise baked into every line of code and a high-calibre team united by a clear mission, we’re not just keeping pace with change—we’re setting the standard. As we expand rapidly across the Middle East and Africa, deepen our end-to-end offerings, and push the boundaries of AI, now is the perfect time to join a company that’s growing fast, thinking bold, and delivering real impact.

jobs.title: AI Engineer Intern, GenAI Internal Automation (GAIA)
jobs.description:
About the team

At Equativ, we're on a mission to develop advertising technologies that empower our customers to reach their digital business goals. The impact of Generative AI on the industry is projected to be major, and Equativ has been undergoing a significant transformation to embed this technology at the core of our value proposition.

The GenAI team is a new, strategic unit (6–8 people) responsible for the design, development, and deployment of Equativ's entire GenAI stack. You will be joining a team of 3 developers and 2 product managers. It is split into two complementary pillars:

  • Core Platform — designing and building a reusable, industrialized Agentic Platform (MaaS, AaaS, Model/Agent as a Service) to accelerate agent development across the company.

  • Business Feature — the team you will be joining. We develop and deploy mission-critical AI agents that automate workflows for non-technical internal teams (operations, ad quality, marketplace, finance support, etc.). Our backlog targets people who today rely on manual processes and ad-hoc tooling, your work will give them autonomous, measurable, production-grade AI assistants.

This team is part of the R&D department (200+ engineers across Paris, Nantes, Limoges, Krakow, Berlin and North America), all working in an Agile environment.


What you will do

  • Create reusable components and libraries (Python + n8n) for the Business Feature Team, leveraging existing workflows and agents to accelerate future development.

  • Perform maintenance (TMA) on existing workflows and agents, focusing on resolving issues and improving performance.

  • Partner directly with non-technical stakeholders, sit with operations teams, understand their pain points, translate workflows into agentic solutions, and explain your design choices.

  • Collaborate with the team on Python development, contributing to the production codebase by applying software engineering principles (unit tests, CI/CD, Git, code review) and helping implement AIOps/AgentOps best practices.


About you

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or similar technical fields.

  • Experience with Python, and using Git for collaboration. You are comfortable working in group projects and collaborating within a team, with a strong desire to learn AIOps/MLOps best practices in a professional environment.

  • Proven experience building production-ready agent workflows with Google ADK (strongly preferred), Langchain, or LangGraph.

  • Practical experience with cloud platforms (Vertex AI, Kubernetes or equivalents) for deploying scalable GenAI services.

  • You can sit down with a non-technical stakeholder, draw out their workflow, and come back with a working agent.

  • Versatile, autonomous, and proactive, you love taking initiatives and driving your projects, with a strong desire to grow while being mentored by our solid team of developers and product managers.

  • Fluent technical English (written and verbal) mandatory.


Practical

  • Status: Internship

  • Location: Paris

  • Working language: English

Equativ, a leading independent ad platform, brings scale and simplicity to digital advertising.
 
Following its recent merger with Sharethrough and the acquisition of Kamino Retail, advertisers, media owners, and technology partners rely on Equativ’s advanced SSP, curation, and retail media services and technology to achieve maximum business outcomes.
 
With a focus on privacy-first programmatic video, CTV, and data-driven solutions, Equativ enables clients to activate across the digital ecosystem while protecting consumer privacy.
 
The company’s global expertise is also backed by a team of over 750 employees across 19 countries.
 
As a proud recipient of the HappyIndex@Work label, Equativ is committed to providing a dynamic, flexible workplace where employees thrive, grow, and excel in both their professional and personal lives.
Come and lead the charge with us in building a transparent ecosystem based on quality!

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description:
📍 Remote, based in Poland

About Us

At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Scandinavian EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19 countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.

We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth.

The Opportunity

Your purpose in this role is simple: help us grow by proactively identifying and approaching talented people who aren't actively looking, but would be a great fit if approached the right way. Our ability to hire the best people, fast, directly determines how quickly we can scale.

This role is mainly focused on proactive sourcing and candidate screening, with the possibility to also handle a few roles full-cycle (360), from brief through to offer and close. The hires will mainly be across Commercial and Operational teams, with possibility of some Tech and Product roles as well. We're looking for someone who can map our markets, build lasting candidate relationships, and give hiring managers a steady stream of great people to talk to — not a slow trickle of applicants.

What You'll Do

Proactive sourcing

  • Map our markets and proactively reach out to passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, job boards, and your network

  • Build talent pools for recurring or future hard-to-fill roles, and screen candidates for fit before progressing them

  • Keep our pipeline data in shape, track TA KPIs, and flag risks early

Full-cycle recruitment

  • Own a smaller share of roles end-to-end — from brief, through interviews, to offer and close

Alongside this, you'll partner with hiring managers to understand what they need and advise on candidate market insight, keep candidates engaged throughout the process, and craft and post job ads on relevant job boards.

What You Bring

  • 2–3 years in talent acquisition, recruitment, or proactive sourcing, with a genuine track record of engaging passive candidates

  • Experience across more than one European market

  • Fluent with LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and ATS tools, and curious about using AI to work smarter

  • Confident stakeholder management

  • Excellent written and spoken English is required; working proficiency in German is an advantage

  • You are organised, persistent, and self-driven, able to juggle multiple roles and markets without dropping speed or quality, and comfortable with the healthy "chaos" of a scaling company

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

Our Culture — Why You'll Love It Here

We're a Scandinavian company with a high-performance, caring culture. We set the bar high, and we back each other to get there.

  • Purpose with scale: You won't just be sourcing for any company — your work directly fuels a mission that keeps thousands of children connected, learning, and included

  • Big impact, real ownership: This is a scale-up, not a corporate machine. We start from a place of trust, so you'll have real ownership of your work from day one, with support from a highly experienced team

  • A genuine growth story: We're one of the few full-stack EdTech companies growing at our rate of profitability, and we've still only scratched the surface of the market. There is plenty of opportunity to grow alongside us, not just fill a seat

  • Highly collaborative and supportive: Regular in-person team meetings, an annual company trip, and people across departments happy to help you grow

  • Structured onboarding to get you up to speed quickly

How to Apply

Please click APPLY and upload your CV in English, and record a short video in English outlining your motivation and letting your personality shine through.

Location & Salary

📍 Remote, based in Poland.

We're unable to sponsor visas or work permits. Candidates must already have the legal right to work in Poland (e.g., EU/EEA citizenship, permanent residency, or an existing valid work permit).

jobs.title: Head of Sales (Nordics)
jobs.description:
About Us

At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Norwegian EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19 countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.

We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth.

The Opportunity - Head of Sales, Nordics

The Nordics are where it started, and it still contains some of our strongest markets. We’ve achieved good market penetration across the region so far, but there's still a huge opportunity to expand.

We're looking for a sales leader based in Oslo to take over a small existing team and drive performance further. Currently, Account Managers on your team cover Norway, Sweden and Denmark - close to the schools and municipalities they serve. Your role is to bring them together as one team, sharpen how they sell, and turn strong regional demand into predictable, growing revenue.

You will report directly to our London-based CCO, Sanjeev, who previously led Vodafone business units across Africa and Europe. Being based in our Oslo HQ, you will also work closely with the wider executive team, including our CEO, Morten, a former McKinsey Partner.

What You'll Do — Scope & Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the team: Coach your Account Managers through deal reviews, pipeline check-ins and real-time support on live opportunities. You'll build the kind of environment where people are pushed to get better and know it's in service of their own growth, not just the number.

  • Own the regional strategy: Use market and pipeline data to decide where to focus - which segments, which territories, which accounts are worth the push. Norway, Sweden and Denmark aren't the same market; treat them that way.

  • Keep the numbers honest: Pipeline hygiene, accurate forecasting, clean data in HubSpot. Leadership makes decisions based on what you and your team report - it needs to hold up.

  • Help your team win the big deals: Multi-stakeholder sales into municipalities and education authorities take time and the right approach. You'll help AMs map the decision path and move from single-unit sales to framework agreements.

  • Connect the dots internally: Work closely with Marketing, Product and Customer Success so the whole go-to-market motion stays aligned - not just your slice of it.

  • Represent us externally: Show up at industry events and policy conversations across the region as a credible voice for what we do.

What You Bring — Experience & Capabilities

  • A track record leading B2B sales teams - ideally selling complex solutions into education or public sector, where deals take multiple stakeholders and patience.

  • You lead by coaching, not just managing. You know how to read what motivates different people and push each of them toward their own best, not a one-size-fits-all approach.

  • A structured approach to selling. You've used frameworks like MEDDPICC, SPIN or Challenger to pressure-test deals and keep timelines under control, and you expect your team to do the same.

  • Comfort with data and CRM (HubSpot experience is a plus) - you can turn numbers into coaching conversations and forecasts people can actually trust.

  • Professional fluency in Norwegian and English; Swedish or Danish is a plus but not essential.

What We Offer

  • Huge market opportunity: The Nordics are our home market and where it all started - with some of the best awareness and coverage. Yet there is still massive opportunity for account expansion and market penetration.

  • Proven product-market fit: Our solution is unique, backed by strong evidence of impact, and is highly cost effective against alternative solutions. This all shows in our very low churn - the solution works and customers love it.

  • A team and a playbook that already work: You're not starting from zero - you're taking something proven and making it better. You'll have the room to adjust the approach where it makes sense.

  • Significant financial upside. We offer an attractive uncapped commission model beyond OTE. Because the market need is high, and our solution is proven, the earning potential here is significant.

  • High-calibre commercial colleagues: You will join a commercial leadership team of experienced sales leaders from global tech companies like Vodafone and Salesforce, alongside peers steeped in EdTech experience.

  • A working environment people rate highly: our engagement metrics run above benchmark. Structured onboarding with a buddy program, an annual company trip, and a genuinely collaborative culture across departments.

  • Enhanced parental and sick leave.

  • Flexible working around core hours (10:00-15:00) and remote working option.

  • Central office space in Oslo.

  • 27 vacation days.

  • Travel insurance for employees and immediate family members.

  • Mobile phone and Internet subscription.

Location

This role is based in our Oslo HQ office, with regular travel across Norway, Sweden and Denmark to support your team in the field.

We believe in-person leadership matters, so we work a flexible hybrid model built around real collaboration.

How to Apply

Please click Apply and upload your CV in English.

If you’d like, you can also include a short video (in English) as part of your application – this is optional, but it gives us a chance to see a bit more of who you are beyond your CV. Let your personality and passion shine!

If you're looking for a leadership role where the demand is already proven and the job is to build on that - not create it from scratch - we'd love to hear from you.

🎥 You can watch how AV1 transforms inclusion in education here: vimeo.com/1098745115

🌍 You can explore our mission and impact stories at noisolation.com

Our AI-enabled platform connects people, systems, and workflows—expanding human capability by turning complex data into real-time, actionable decisions. We help leading organizations improve safety, efficiency and performance while redefining how heavy assets are designed and operated.

Team

The traditional market area is Oil & Gas but we see an increasing use of our technology in the Net Zero domain e.g. Carbon Capture and Storage. We are also integrating with our industrial worksurface called Kognitwin which is taking traditional on-premise simulators into the Cloud.

Responsibilities

The Growth Manager will be responsible for growing the Energy Simulation business in EMEA. This is a mature business but the focus will be to secure new logos for Falkor and to upsell and cross sell to existing customers. Key areas of responsibility include:

  • Pro-actively seek new opportunities for Energy Simulation.

  • Establish and maintain a good understanding of customer challenges and how Falkor can be positioned to meet these challenges

  • Maximise and secure Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in a timely manner

  • Identify upselling opportunities to existing customers and simulator deliveries

  • Collaborate with Falkor Surface Growth to identify opportunities to deploy Falkor Surface Simulation

  • Work closely with our Product and Marketing team to position Energy Simulation and build value propositions

  • Lead bid processes for our Energy Simulation offering and support larger deals where Energy Simulation is a component of Falkor Surface

  • Accurately manage leads, opportunities and recurring revenue in CRM

  • Identify, and propose any improvements related to procedures, working methods and tools.

  • Performance of all work according to the working methods set out in the Falkor Business Management System (BMS)

  • Comply with all standards established within Kongsberg Gruppen (KOG)/Falkor

Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor or Master’s degree in relevant technical fields

  • Fluent in English

  • Strong sales experience and domain knowledge from the Energy industry; preferably Process Simulation or Flow Assurance

  • Self-driven person with positive attitude and good cooperative skills

  • Communicate clearly and concisely with diverse audiences, in both oral and written contexts, and giving and receiving feedback.

  • Leadership and interpersonal skills, communication, negotiation, conflict resolution, persuasion etc.

Why join Falkor?

You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate.

At Falkor, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work on meaningful challenges with real-world impact

  • Collaborate with talented colleagues across technology and industry domains

  • Learn from experts in software, engineering, operations, and digital transformation

We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and able to do their best work.

Ready to apply?

If you're excited about solving complex challenges and making an impact through technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your resume.

Falkor occasionally partners with selected recruitment agencies for specific hiring requirements. We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions and will not be responsible for associated fees unless terms have been agreed in advance through our Procurement team.

As a pioneer in industrial digitalization, we provide a comprehensive suite of software solutions that empower organizations to manage the full lifecycle of their assets—more efficiently, safely, and sustainably than ever before. The industry is on the cusp of a digital revolution—and we’re leading the charge. From early adoption of AI to building trusted partnerships with some of the world’s largest industrial players, we are redefining how work gets done. With domain expertise baked into every line of code and a high-calibre team united by a clear mission, we’re not just keeping pace with change—we’re setting the standard. As we expand rapidly across the Middle East and Africa, deepen our end-to-end offerings, and push the boundaries of AI, now is the perfect time to join a company that’s growing fast, thinking bold, and delivering real impact.

jobs.title: CEO
jobs.description:
CEO, Seidr Technologies

Seidr builds software that turns months of manual site selection for energy-intensive industrial projects into hours of automated analysis. This is solving a significant bottleneck in a rapidly growing market. We have a signed, paying pilot customer and a growing pipeline across Power-to-X and data center developers in the Nordics and Germany. Read more about what we do on our company profile.


The role

We're looking for a CEO to lead Seidr forward and be the face of the company to investors, customers and partners. You'll own recruiting and team-building together with our venture studio REspire and our CTO Aman, and take on the full range of responsibilities that come with leading an early-stage startup.

Aman leads product and engineering, and we'll be growing the tech team further over time. Your main day-to-day focus will be commercial: direct, outbound sales to developers of energy-intensive projects, alongside shaping the business model and pricing as we move from pilot to scale.


What we're looking for

Above all, someone who wants to build a startup and understands what that actually takes: grit, resourcefulness, and the ability to move fast with limited resources. Previous startup experience is a strong signal of this, but not the only way to show it.

You should have solid experience in business development and B2B sales. Experience from data center development, or development of other power-intensive industry (Power-to-X, renewables, heavy industry), is a strong plus.


Location & setup

We'd prefer someone based in Norway who can work from our office in Asker, but we're open to strong candidates based elsewhere. We're also open to starting part-time and ramping up as the company grows.


A note on stage and risk

This is a pre-seed startup, not a conventional job. Until we close funding, which you'll be directly involved in raising, there is no fixed salary. We're open to pragmatic solutions along the way, such as a part-time period, but you should go into this with your eyes open and a genuine appetite for that kind of risk.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Seidr builds software that turns months of manual site selection and early-phase engineering work into hours of automated analysis, for developers of energy-intensive industrial projects: Power-to-X, data centers, and other power-hungry industries across Europe. Today, finding and qualifying a site for one of these projects takes 6-18 months and can cost millions, because the work is done manually, spreadsheet by spreadsheet, consultant by consultant, one candidate site at a time. Critical blockers, such as insufficient grid capacity or zoning conflicts, often surface only after months of work, when changing course is expensive. Seidr automates this. Our platform screens candidate sites in parallel against dozens of criteria, including grid capacity, current and future zoning, and environmental risk, and returns a ranked, decision-ready shortlist in hours instead of months. The underlying logic is built on real industrial project experience, not generic AI. We already have a signed, paying pilot customer and a growing pipeline of Power-to-X and data center developers across the Nordics and Germany. Backed by a venture studio, we are now looking for a CEO to take Seidr from pilot to scale, and to grow the platform from site selection into the full early-phase planning stack for energy-intensive projects.

jobs.title: AI Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Scandinavian EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19 countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.

We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth.

The Opportunity — AI Integration Engineer

This is a new role at No Isolation, and you'd be the first person in it.

You'll sit inside Engineering but work mostly embedded inside selected internal business units, in contrast to the rest of Engineering. You’ll work with Sales, Customer Success, Finance and Operations. You’ll connect the tools they depend on and implement AI tools and automation flows to positively impact our revenue first and foremost, but also generally enhance internal effectiveness.

In practice: you set the bar for how much internal AI and Automation can change the company from the inside in 2026 and beyond, and you co-own the stack you put in place. You will have a lot of direct contact with the teams you're building for, and a lot of say in how the technical side gets structured to enable you, while having the support of experienced software engineers when needed.

What You'll Do — Scope & Responsibilities

  • Systems integration: Drive automation of key business areas and connect our business tools across Data, IAM, CRM, ERP (Odoo) and Finance through APIs, webhooks and events, so data stays in sync across systems.

  • Internal automation capability: Build and maintain workflows in Windmill and/or n8n; migrate us off legacy SaaS and iPaaS tools as you go. Aim to articulate as many problems as possible as deterministic automations that keep data and AI cost low.

  • Internal AI capability: Contribute to shared infrastructure for using AI internally alongside our cloud/platform engineers: assistants, retrieval over internal knowledge, summarisation, classification, routing, etc. Turn ad hoc AI experiments into tools people can actually rely on, with eval sets in place to catch regressions.

  • Data & internal foundations: Centralise data into sources the business can trust, reconcile figures across systems so numbers match wherever they appear, and provide internal tools and lightly-built apps.

  • Guardrails & cost control: Define the standards for how integrations and AI get built here. Keep the set of automation platforms small and deliberate (e.g. Windmill, n8n and some custom). Track AI spend and return on investment so we can monitor alignment between the two.

  • Partnership: Work directly with the teams you're building for: understand the actual problem, ship a working increment near-instantly, then iterate and negotiate toward durability. You're measured on time saved, additional revenue generated, budget synergies realised, not on the tools you ship. Share knowledge and lift others through e.g. workshops and townhalls.

What You Bring — Experience & Capabilities

  • Talent for working directly with non-technical stakeholders and turning a fuzzy request into a concrete system. This is a first-of-its-kind role here, so you're setting direction rather than following an existing playbook.

  • Experience connecting systems through APIs, webhooks and events: ERPs (Odoo v18 and beyond is a plus), CRMs, or Finance systems. At ease with various application protocols (REST), auth flows (OAuth/SSO) and the rough edges of third-party SaaS APIs.

  • Hands-on with a code-first orchestration platform: Windmill, Temporal, Airflow, n8n or similar.

  • A builder who finishes: Proficient in at least one general-purpose language (Python, TypeScript, Go), and comfortable taking something from rough prototype (built by you or non-technical people) to engineering standard.

  • Comfortable using and configuring self-hosted tooling (containers, secrets, backups, upgrades) to some extent, as opposed to fully leaning on managed SaaS

  • Practical experience with LLMs and agents: context engineering, RAG, evals, tool/function calling. You should have a good sense of where AI helps and where it adds fragility.

  • Data sense: savvy with SQL and common data stores; able to model, reconcile and centralize data; some exposure to classical machine learning can be an advantage.

  • Security-conscious by default: least-privilege access, careful handling of secrets, aware of GDPR, SOC and ISO requirements.

  • STEM degree (BSc/MSc) or equivalent practical experience in integration, AI & automation, or internal tooling.

  • Experience at product or scale-up companies is an advantage.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • First-of-its-kind role: you will tackle opportunities unexplored so far at the company

  • Purpose with scale: The systems you build free up time that goes straight back into helping educators support thousands of children connected, learning, and included every single day.

  • Work with exceptional leaders: You'll report to our Director of Engineering, Jerome, with plenty of room to shape a high-trust, learning-driven engineering culture.

  • Growth through ownership: A lean environment with the freedom to propose what you think is best for our very company.

  • Stability with a lean size: We are profitable and growing rapidly, while keeping at a size where the ideal candidate will have high impact.

  • Flexible working around core hours (10:00–15:00), with a hybrid work schedule.

  • 27 vacation days.

  • Travel and accident insurance for you and your immediate family.

  • Enhanced parental and sick leave.

  • Mobile phone and internet subscription reimbursement.

  • Regular company socials and an annual trip away together.

Our Tech Stack

Think internal tools, fleets of connected robots, and the systems that keep Sales, Finance and Customer Success running. You'll work with:

  • Orchestration & automation: Windmill, n8n

  • Languages: Go, Python, TypeScript

  • Systems: Odoo, HubSpot, and the wider CRM/finance/IAM stack

  • AI: LLMs and agents, RAG/retrieval, MCP, evaluation tooling

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, containers

  • Data: SQL, MySQL, ClickHouse

  • Development: GitLab, Claude Code and handful of other solutions being evaluated

Location

This role is based in Oslo with hybrid flexibility at our headquarters (up to 2 days remote work per week).

We welcome all qualified applicants. Due to current visa/work-permit processes, we can progress candidates already in Norway or relocating with no need for additional work permit (such as the EU/EEA citizens). (This note is about work authorization only; no sensitive personal data is required).

How to Apply

If you like building things that make everyone else's work easier, are passionate about AI, and want that to matter for something bigger, we'd love to hear from you.

Please click Apply and upload your CV in English.

If you'd like, you can also include a short video as part of your application — this is optional, but it gives us a chance to see a bit more of who you are beyond your CV.

🎥 You may watch how AV1 transforms inclusion in education here: vimeo.com/1098745115

🌍 You may explore our mission and impact stories at noisolation.com

We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. School absence is the biggest challenge facing education. Our AV1 robots connect absent students, ensure learning and belonging, and support reintegration back to the classroom. Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students. No Isolation works across Europe, with 45 employees across Europe and in offices in Oslo, Munich and London. Join us in our growth journey!

jobs.title: Part-time Driver

jobs.description:
We’re looking for Part-Time Drivers to join Oda!

At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store, and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective grocery system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and every opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistics challenges, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Report directly to our Driver Operating Managers and Team Leaders at your site as an essential part of our dedicated delivery team.

  • Be a Customer Hero: You’ll be on the road bringing groceries and smiles directly to our customers, ensuring a top-notch "Oda experience" at every doorstep.

  • Keep the wheels turning: You’ll handle loading and unloading with speed and care, ensuring every box arrives in perfect condition.

  • Own your ride: You’ll take pride in your van, keeping it clean, presentable, and ready for the road.

  • Pay it forward: You’ll help onboard and train new colleagues, sharing your best tips and tricks from the road.

  • Make us better: We value your brain as much as your driving! You’ll contribute your ideas to help us improve our routines and ways of working.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • A valid driving license (Class B). You’ve had your license for at least 2 years and feel confident and safe behind the wheel.

  • Good communication skills: Comfortable in speaking and writing English. If you also know Norwegian or another Nordic language, that’s a big plus!

What would be nice to have 💡

  • Enjoy being active and thrive in a physically demanding job

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team

  • A strong work ethic and a "can-do" mindset

  • Service-minded and always looking for the best solutions

  • A genuine desire to make our customers happy

  • Responsible and always prioritize safety in traffic


What we offer 🚀

  • A chance to make a real impact as a Part-Time Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love-while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop-less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A chance to shape the future of grocery shopping while building a company that’s here to stay.


Practical information

  • Application deadline: Apply before 23. september 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once the right candidates are found. We encourage you to apply as early as possible

  • Start date: As soon as possible

  • Position: Part-time 20%, Saturday and Sunday, every other weekend.

  • We hire for both morning and evening shifts. Please specify which shift you are interested in when applying.

  • Working hours:

    • Morning shift: 05:45-13:45 or 06.00-14:00

    • Evening shift: 13:00-21:00

  • Location: Drammensveien 189, 3420 Lierskogen


A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.

We can’t wait to hear from you🧡


To ensure a fair and efficient process for everyone, we use Hubert, our virtual assistant, to help us with the first selection🤖 Keep an eye on your inbox – shortly after applying, you’ll receive an email with an invite to a chat-based interview. Just make sure your email address is correct so the invite finds its way to you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

jobs.title: Counter Staff, Oslo Gardermoen
jobs.description:
Counter Staff – Oslo Gardermoen (PIE VAT)

Location: Oslo Airport Gardermoen, Norway (on-site)

Employment type: Part-time

Reports to: Counter Manager

Company: PIE Systems


About PIE Systems

PIE Systems is a fast-growing fintech company transforming the $70B+ tax-free shopping industry. Our digital VAT refund platform replaces outdated, paper-based processes with a seamless and automated experience for both tourists and merchants.

Founded in Copenhagen, PIE operates across Europe and Japan with a global team. Oslo Airport Gardermoen is a key location in our continued European expansion.


The Role

As Counter Staff, you will be the face of PIE VAT at Oslo Airport, assisting international travellers with VAT refund processing and ensuring a smooth, efficient, and friendly customer experience.

You will work closely with the Counter Manager and team to support daily operations, handle customer interactions, and maintain high service and compliance standards in a fast-paced airport environment.


Key Responsibilities

Customer Service & Counter Operations

  • Assist travellers with VAT refund processing, ensuring accuracy and compliance.

  • Verify documentation and support basic inspection of goods when required.

  • Deliver a professional, efficient, and friendly customer experience.

  • Answer customer questions and guide them through the refund process.

  • Handle basic inquiries via email or support tools when needed.

Operational Support

  • Support daily counter operations to ensure smooth workflow and minimal wait times.

  • Follow established procedures and service standards set by the Counter Manager.

  • Help maintain a clean, organised, and fully operational counter environment.

  • Assist during peak hours to manage high customer volumes effectively.

Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Counter Manager and team to ensure consistent service delivery.

  • Provide feedback on customer interactions and potential process improvements.

  • Participate in training and onboarding programs.


What We’re Looking For

Experience

  • Experience in a customer-facing role (retail, hospitality, travel, or similar).

  • Experience working with international customers is a plus.

  • Experience in airport, retail, or VAT/tax-free services is an advantage.

Skills & Mindset

  • Strong customer service and communication skills.

  • Detail-oriented and able to follow processes accurately.

  • Friendly, approachable, and service-minded.

  • Able to work in a fast-paced, high-traffic environment.

  • Reliable, flexible, and a strong team player.

  • Comfortable using digital tools and systems.

jobs.title: Fullstack-utvikler / AI-utvikler – arbeidstrening eller praksis i B2B/industri-startup
jobs.description:
Company: RoboConnect

Location: Molde, Norway

Work type: Full-time or part-time

Role type: Internship / student / junior developer / work training

Salary: Unpaid in the initial phase

Long-term possibility: Paid role may become possible if RoboConnect secures revenue, funding or a suitable commercial basis

Short description

RoboConnect is building an AI-supported B2B platform that helps industrial companies clarify automation needs before they invest in robotics, automation or system integration.

We are looking for a locally based fullstack developer who wants hands-on startup experience and can contribute to the development of RoboConnect’s platform, AI Advisor and internal tools. This is not a co-founder role and not an ordinary paid position at this stage, but it may become a paid role later if the collaboration works well and the company develops commercially.

About RoboConnect

Many industrial companies know they need to automate, but struggle to define what should be automated, what information is missing, whether the process is ready for investment, and which suppliers they should involve.

RoboConnect helps companies move from an unclear automation need to a structured and decision-relevant basis for internal decisions and supplier dialogue. The platform combines industrial automation insight, structured project data, AI-supported needs clarification, project preparation and matching with relevant automation partners.

The first focus area is welding automation and high-mix, low-volume manufacturing. We are currently preparing customer pilots and further development of the MVP.

Why we need a developer in-house

RoboConnect is moving from concept and market validation into product development, pilots and technical iteration. We need stronger internal technical capacity, especially around the AI Advisor, frontend, backend, API integrations, data structure and user flows.

The current platform and AI work involves several moving parts, including customer registration, project forms, dashboards, structured project data, AI-assisted needs clarification, report generation and matching logic.

We are therefore looking for a developer who can work closely with the founder and contribute practically to building, improving and testing the product.

A local candidate in Molde or nearby is strongly preferred, because close collaboration, product discussions and faster iteration will be important. Some remote work may be possible, but we would like in-person collaboration several days per week.

What you will work on

You will contribute to practical product development for RoboConnect, including:

  • frontend development and user interface improvements

  • backend development and API integrations

  • AI Advisor / chatbot functionality for needs clarification

  • structured data capture from customer conversations or forms

  • database structure and data handling

  • dashboards for customers, suppliers and admin users

  • GitHub workflow, documentation and testing

  • improving user flows from registration to project clarification

  • preparing technical demos for pilots and customer feedback

The first tasks will be scoped clearly. The goal is not to build everything at once, but to make focused improvements that can be tested with real users.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone with some practical development experience who wants to build real software in an early-stage startup.

You should have experience with, or strong interest in:

  • fullstack development

  • frontend and backend development

  • JavaScript / TypeScript

  • React / Next.js

  • APIs

  • databases

  • GitHub

  • AI tools, LLMs or chatbot development

  • structured problem solving

  • building usable products, not only experimenting with technology

Experience with Tailwind, Supabase, Convex, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Vercel, OpenAI, Anthropic or similar tools is an advantage, but not required if you learn quickly.

You do not need to be senior, but you should have built something before and be able to work independently on defined tasks.

You must be comfortable with

  • working in a very early-stage startup

  • incomplete systems and changing priorities

  • documenting your work clearly

  • committing code regularly to RoboConnect’s GitHub repository

  • working with agreed scope and delivery expectations

  • discussing technical choices openly

  • asking questions when something is unclear

  • receiving feedback and improving the solution iteratively

You must not commit API keys, passwords or secrets to GitHub. Production data and production credentials will not be shared during an initial trial period.

Language and location

Norwegian language skills are strongly preferred, because RoboConnect works with Norwegian industrial companies and customer needs must be understood clearly.

Candidates who speak English may also be considered if they are willing to learn Norwegian and can collaborate effectively in Norway.

The ideal candidate is located in Molde or within commuting distance. Candidates who can be physically present in Molde several days per week will be prioritized.

Practical setup

This is initially intended as an unpaid work-training, internship or experience-based role, depending on the candidate’s situation.

It may be especially relevant for someone who:

  • wants more practical experience in fullstack development

  • wants to build real startup/product experience

  • has completed studies, courses or self-learning but needs real project experience

  • is registered with NAV and may be eligible for work training or similar arrangements

  • wants to build a portfolio with meaningful product work

  • is interested in AI, automation, industrial technology or B2B platforms

RoboConnect will not present this as an ordinary paid employment relationship unless a separate paid agreement is made.

If the collaboration works well and RoboConnect secures revenue, funding or another commercial basis, a paid role may become possible later.

What you can gain

You will get hands-on experience with:

  • building a real B2B SaaS/AI platform

  • AI-supported product development

  • industrial automation use cases

  • customer needs clarification

  • startup product development

  • fullstack development in practice

  • GitHub, documentation, testing and deployment workflow

  • working close to the founder and team in an early-stage company

This is a good opportunity for someone who wants more than a theoretical project and wants to join in build something that may be used by real industrial companies.

About the founder

RoboConnect was founded by Elisabet Witsø. The company is based in Molde and connected to the industrial and automation ecosystem in Norway.

RoboConnect is still in an early phase, but has completed market validation, interviewed industrial companies and automation partners, completed MVP, and is preparing the next step toward pilots and commercial testing.

How to apply

Please apply through The Hub and answer the short application questions. Please also include your CV and GitHub profile.

The questions are intended to give us a better understanding of your motivation, availability, language skills, practical situation and how you work as a developer.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

1. Short description RoboConnect is developing an independent, AI-supported platform that helps industrial companies turn tacit and fragmented process knowledge into a clear, decision-relevant automation case — before supplier dialogue begins. 2. The problem Many industrial companies know they need to automate, but struggle to define what should be automated, what is causing the problem and whether the process is ready for investment. The people closest to production often understand the process well, but this knowledge may be spread across operators, engineers and management, poorly documented or mixed with assumptions and missing data. The customer may therefore approach the market with an unclear problem description and incomplete information. System integrators then have to reconstruct the customer’s process understanding and collect missing data before a meaningful solution dialogue can begin. This creates uncertainty, longer clarification phases, weak or difficult-to-compare proposals and projects that stall early. The core problem is not a lack of technology or suppliers. It is that the knowledge needed to make a good early automation decision is often tacit, fragmented and difficult to transfer. 3. The solution RoboConnect starts by understanding the customer’s process, challenges and actual needs. The RoboConnect AI Advisor conducts a guided professional conversation that helps the company describe how production works today, what it wants to improve, which constraints matter and what information is still missing. The AI Advisor brings together information from different parts of the organisation, separates facts from assumptions and uncertainty, identifies knowledge gaps and risks, and turns unclear issues into practical next actions. The result is a shared and structured automation basis that can be developed into a supplier-ready project brief. Relevant projects can then be connected with suitable system integrators, technology suppliers and R&D environments. This gives the customer greater decision confidence and solution providers a better starting point. RoboConnect is not building a generic chatbot. The platform combines a domain-specific workflow, structured project data and knowledge from industrial cases, expert interviews and feedback from customers and automation partners. Over time, this strengthens clarification, project maturation and matching. The first focused area is welding automation and high-mix, low-volume manufacturing. The longer-term ambition is to expand across other automation categories and build a Nordic platform for early-stage automation clarification and matching. 4. Business model and commercial opportunity RoboConnect creates value on both sides of the market. Industrial companies receive a clearer and safer starting point, while automation partners gain access to better-qualified customer opportunities. The current model is based mainly on supplier-side revenue through fees for qualified matches and successful projects. Future revenue streams may include paid AI-assisted readiness reports, supplier subscriptions, premium access and category-specific products. The model is now being validated through pilots and early customer projects. Norway is the validation market, with Sweden as the first intended scale-up market. 5. Why I started RoboConnect The motivation came from repeated conversations with industrial companies, automation experts and system integrators. I saw that many projects became uncertain long before technology was selected. Companies needed a more independent and structured way to understand their own situation before entering a supplier-led process. With a background in research, data analysis and complex problem structuring, combined with further training in programming, databases and AI, I founded RoboConnect to bridge the gap between industrial process knowledge and automation delivery.

jobs.title: Part-time Driver Larvik
jobs.employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD OSLO DISTRIBUSJON
jobs.description:
Join us as a driver on weekends in Larvik!

At Oda, we come to work every day to create affordable grocery services that make the logistics of living surprisingly easy for our customers in Norway and Sweden. That’s what gets us fired up. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system. With our wide selection and competitive prices, we deliver to the doorsteps of thousands of Scandinavian homes every week.

As a driver with us, you play an essential role in representing Oda to our customers. You will be part of our dedicated team of drivers and report to the Delivery Operating Manager and the Delivery Team Leaders on-site. You’ll deliver groceries and packages to our customers in the area. We believe you'll enjoy working as a driver at Oda if you can manage your time effectively, work independently and as part of a team, and approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. It would also be best if you enjoy being active, as this job involves a lot of physical activity, not just driving.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Delivering food and packages to our customers.

  • Maintain efficiency and quality by loading and unloading goods, handling customers, and following routines and processes.

  • Ensuring Customer service at the highest level.

  • Be responsible for simple maintenance of the car fleet, such as changing light bulbs, topping up liquids, and keeping the cars clean and presentable at all times.

  • Training new drivers on the road.

  • Contributing to the improvement of driver routines and processes.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Driving license (Class B) with a minimum of 2 years' driving experience.

  • Speaking English is required, and familiarity with Norwegian or another Nordic language is a plus.


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Are active and like it, as this is a physically demanding job

  • Like working independently and with a team

  • Have a good work ethic

  • Are service-oriented and solution-oriented.

  • Have a genuine desire to succeed and make customers happy

  • Responsible and prioritizes safe behaviour in traffic


What we offer 🚀

This is your chance to make a real impact as a Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love—while shaking up the grocery industry. You’ll experience:

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop—less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.


Practical informationℹ️

  • Application deadline: Apply before 30.09. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once we find the right candidates, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.

  • Starting date: As soon as possible

  • Location: Rødbølveien 16, 3270 Larvik

  • Working hours: Part-time 20% position with work every other weekend, Saturday 05:30-13:30 and Sunday 13:30-21:30


At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

As part of our work to ensure a fair and open-minded recruitment process, we have chosen to collaborate with Hubert.ai, a virtual recruitment assistant that helps with the selection process. As soon as you submit an application for this position, you will be invited via email to a chat-based interview. Therefore, be careful to enter your correct email address so that the invitation reaches the right person🤖

We can’t wait to hear from you🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist, London
jobs.description:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Role

This role owns talent acquisition across EMEA end to end, covering GTM and Engineering hiring in the UK, Germany, France, Spain, Italy and the Nordics, with APAC to follow as we expand. It is the first permanent in-house recruiting hire in the region, replacing a contractor model that gave us capacity but no continuity. You will partner daily with hiring managers across EMEA, with HR Operations and onboarding in the US and Europe, and with EMEA sales and engineering leadership.

We're excited about you because you're the kind of person who...

gets energised rather than deterred by pitching a company nobody has heard of yet. You form a view, push back on a brief that will not work, and keep going when response rates are low, without needing a process to be finished before you can work inside it.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own a portfolio of 8 to 12 live roles across EMEA end to end, spanning GTM (Account Directors, Account Executives, SDRs, Customer Success) and Engineering, from intake through to offer and handover.

  • Run intake meetings that turn a vague hiring manager wish list into a defined, sourceable brief, and push back when the brief and the market do not match.

  • Source directly and relentlessly. Most of our best hires will not apply to us, and there is no brand pull to fall back on.

  • Build and hold the market maps, talent pools and competitor intelligence for the countries we hire in, so knowledge compounds inside Hiya rather than leaving with a contract.

  • Pitch Hiya credibly to senior candidates in markets where we have no name recognition, and turn scepticism into genuine interest.

  • Use AI tooling across the whole workflow, from sourcing and research through screening, outreach and reporting, and keep improving how you do it as the tools change.

  • Partner with HR Operations and onboarding across the US and Europe, setting candidate expectations early on the realities of multi-country employment including EOR, so offers do not fall over at contract stage.

What We Are Looking For
