jobs.description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $400M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor.

We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Talent Lead at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team. As Talent Lead at AIOS, your fundamental role is to supercharge our talent (recruiting) function, ensuring that a lack of key hires never blocks growth. You’ll help define what a killer sourcing process looks like while leveraging frontier tooling to increase your throughput and velocity as you recruit best-in-class operators.

You’ll work across a variety of roles: traditional direct-to-consumer Growth roles (Performance Marketing), technical roles (AI + SWE Engineering & Product), and clinical roles — flexing deftly between more junior roles all the way up to the most senior roles in the org.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice — as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday. You’ll have flex in your calendar for kids if you have them — many of our team have kids so we’re kid-friendly.

This is an individual-contributor role — no direct reports, full-cycle sourcing/screening/closing, hands dirty in the trenches. You’ll report directly to Cierra Olsen (Head of Talent).

You’ll also work closely with the rest of the Talent Team: Zoe Wheeler (UK Talent Lead), Mika Mansilla (Founder Associate), and Jordan Pellikan (VP Ops).

Key responsibilities

  • Full cycle: Own searches end to end from sourcing, outbound, screening, interview coordination, calibration, and closing (recent examples: Head of InfoSec, Head of Creative, Senior Media Buyer, Affiliate Lead).

  • Sourcing: Build repeatable sourcing engines for hard-to-fill roles. Run LinkedIn X-ray searches, build target-company lists, and do the outbound headhunting yourself. Our best hires won’t come inbound.

  • Processes: Constantly sharpen our hiring bars (seniority, industry fit, recency, builder pattern) consistently across every search you’re DRI for. Help improve interview processes across the org.

  • Hygiene: Keep pipelines, stages, and candidate communication clean and current in Ashby so nothing stalls and our time to hire continually improves.

  • Calibration: Flag pipeline risk early, bring calibration questions before they become misses, and constantly align with leaders across the org to improve our processes.

  • Closing: Manage candidate experience through to signed offer, including comp conversations.

KPIs

  • Time-to-fill on your owned searches, without sacrificing the bar

  • Sourced (outbound) candidates as a % of your total pipeline — we want you building your own pipeline, not living off inbound

  • Offer-accept rate on closed candidates

  • Ashby pipeline hygiene — stages and candidate status always current

Need to have

  • Excellence: You have 5+ years experience personally recruiting (sourcing, screening, managing, and closing) great candidates across difficult searches. You can point to hires that materially raised the talent bar of the teams they joined.

  • Hunter: You can turn a vague candidate profile into target companies, search strings and a high-quality outbound pipeline. You do not depend on inbound applicants or agencies to fill roles.

  • Senior hiring: You have successfully recruited senior leaders and understand how sourcing, assessing and closing them differs from junior hiring.

  • Judgment: You can distinguish exceptional people from candidates who simply have the right companies, titles or polish on their CV. You develop conviction quickly and can clearly articulate why someone does or does not meet the bar.

  • Range: You can move between very different searches without losing depth. You learn unfamiliar markets quickly enough to recruit credibly within them.

  • Multi-workstream: You can run several searches simultaneously while keeping sourcing quality, candidate communication, follow-ups and pipeline hygiene exceptionally tight.

  • Urgency: You push searches forward without waiting to be managed, surface problems early, and change approach quickly when a pipeline is not working.

  • High bar: You care more about making an exceptional hire than filling a seat, and you are comfortable challenging hiring managers when you do not believe a candidate meets org standards.

Nice to have

  • Startups/Scale-ups: You’ve recruited in a fast-moving startup or scale-up where priorities shift quickly, roles evolve mid-search, and there isn’t always an existing playbook.

  • Technical recruiting: You’ve successfully recruited for Engineering, AI, Data, Product or other technical roles and can credibly assess candidate quality beyond surface-level credentials.

  • Regulated industries: You’ve recruited in healthcare, financial services, or another highly regulated industry where candidate requirements and operating constraints are more complex.

  • AI-native: You actively use AI and automation to improve sourcing, research, outreach, screening, and recruiting operations.

  • Systems builder: You’ve helped build or materially improve recruiting processes, tooling, scorecards, sourcing systems, or interview loops rather than simply operating an existing process.

  • Network: You have an existing network of exceptional operators, builders and leaders you’d be excited to bring into AIOS.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

    🎯 "You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $100k-$200k/yr, incl equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team


Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

 

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London).

We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors.

You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers.

You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing.


Functions of the Role

  • Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices, developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility.

  • Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight, identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping.

  • Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure, creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments.

  • Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift.

  • Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers, providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield.

  • Build scalable characterisation processes, establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams.

  • Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology, bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales.

  • We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation.


Experience - Essentials


  • Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline.

  • 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment.

  • Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows.

  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing.

  • Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution.

  • A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in:

  • Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping.

  • Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems.

  • Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis.

  • Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation.

  • Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary and share options scheme

  • Contributory pension scheme

  • Group private medical insurance scheme

  • Life Assurance

  • Cycle-to-work Scheme

Endear - Product Designer
jobs.description:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

  4. Final leadership conversation

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$129K

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Education and learning support

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Poskytovanie technickej podpory používateľom pri riešení bežných problémov s hardvérom, softvérom a podnikovými aplikáciami. Evidencia, klasifikácia a riešenie používateľských požiadaviek a incidentov prostredníctvom tiketovacieho systému HALO. Inštalácia, konfigurácia a príprava pracovných staníc, notebookov, tlačiarní, mobilných telefónov a ďalších koncových zariadení. Podpora používateľov pri práci s Microsoft 365 a štandardnými kancelárskymi aplikáciami. Správa používateľských účtov, hesiel a prístupových oprávnení podľa interných postupov. Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. Dodržiavanie pravidiel informačnej bezpečnosti a podieľanie sa na ochrane firemných dát a IT prostriedkov. Plnenie ďalších úloh v oblasti IT podpory podľa pokynov nadriadeného alebo potrieb spoločnosti.
Výhody:13, 14 mzda po odpracovaní 6 mesiacov, mesačné prémie, príspevok na dochádzanie do práce, kredit na občerstvenie, príspevok na stravu nad rámec zákona.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.title: Odborní pracovníci v oblasti predaja poistenia
jobs.employer: KOMUNÁLNA poisťovňa, a.s. Vienna Insurance Group
jobs.description:
Máte skúsenosti s prácou s klientom alebo predajom a chcete v tom napredovať? Alebo ste ešte finančné poradenstvo neskúsili? Podporíme Vaše schopnosti a zručnosti a pomôžeme Vám zlepšiť svoj finančný rozhľad a predajné aktivity. Dáme Vám príležitosť stať sa regionálnym obchodným zástupcom. Vaše pracovné úlohy na uvedenej pracovnej pozícii budú: Aktívne vyhľadávanie klientov a následná starostlivosť o nich. Poistné poradenstvo a vypracovávanie návrhov na poistenie podľa potrieb klienta. Príprava, uzatváranie poistných zmlúv životného a neživotného poistenia v príslušnom regióne obchodného miesta. Starostlivosť o zverené klientske portfólio. Sprostredkovanie predaja vybraných bankových produktov.
Výhody:Stabilná a zaujímavá práca v najsilnejšej poisťovacej skupine na Slovensku Vienna Insurance Group. 6-mesačný program podpory nových regionálnych obchodných zástupcov s garanciou minimálneho príjmu a provízie bez obmedzenia. Systém vzdelávania, odborných školení a tréningov. Flexibilný pracovný čas. Príspevok na DDS III. pilier. Finančné odmeny pri pracovnom a životnom jubileu. Ak Vás ponuka zaujala, pošlite nám Váš štruktúrovaný životopis. Kontaktovať budeme len vybraných uchádzačov, ktorí spĺňajú požiadavky danej pozície. Všetky informácie o spracúvaní osobných údajov nájdete na https: www.kpas.sk stranka ochrana-osobnych-udajov.

jobs.title: Pomocníci v kuchyni
jobs.description:
Umývate riad a udržiavate čistotu v kuchyni, aby ste sa naučili dôležitosti hygieny a organizácie. Pripravujete suroviny, čistenie a krájanie zeleniny, čím sa zlepšíte v kuchynských zručnostiach. Upratujete kuchyňu a zabezpečujete, že je vždy pripravená na ďalšie varenie. Dodržiavate hygienické a bezpečnostné predpisy (HACCP), takže sa naučíte, ako sa starať o bezpečnosť potravín. Po riadnom zaškolení sa samostatne staráte o prípravu raňajok, čo vám dáva možnosť ukázať svoje zručnosti. V prípade potreby a po zaučení zastupujete šéfkuchára. Pracovný čas je flexibilný, aby vyhovoval potrebám nášho tímu a zohľadňoval vašu pohodu. Typická pracovná doba je delená a to od 7:00 hod do 12:00 hod následne 16:00 hod až 21:00 hod (závisí od vyťaženia), pričom sa prispôsobuje aktuálnej prevádzke.
Výhody:Vychutnaj si chutné a kvalitné jedlá v hotelovej reštaurácii za výhodné ceny. V prípade vzdialeného bydliska nad 30 km od hotela poskytujeme ubytovanie 1 € noc. Využívaj všetky hotelové služby – fitness, bazén, sauna, infrasauna – úplne zdarma, aj pre svojich rodinných príslušníkov. Pracuj v mladom a dynamickom kolektíve, kde sa budeš môcť ďalej rozvíjať. Uži si prácu v úspešnej reštaurácii, ktorá je známa svojou kvalitou a štýlovým prostredím. Ak máš záujem, pošli svoj životopis alebo nás kontaktuj osobne v Hoteli GOLFER , Kremnica. Tešíme sa na nového kolegu alebo kolegyňu, ktorý á bude s nami tvoriť príjemnú atmosféru pre našich hostí aj celý tím!

jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Consultant
jobs.description:
Our client is a European HR software company that is expanding rapidly in Germany, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 they 𝐰𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐭𝐨 𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐰 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 them.

Their mission is simple: they design intuitive solutions that automate HR and administrative processes, giving thousands of companies across Europe more time and energy for what really matters : their people and their business.

Your role

In order to continue their expansion in this market, they are looking for a Senior HRIS Customer Success Consultant to join our growing team in Germany.

Your missions will evolve as you acquire seniority, but here are the main tasks you will do on a daily basis:

𝐂𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐧𝐛𝐨𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 (𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐣𝐞𝐜𝐭 𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐢𝐦𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧)
- Roll out the solutions for a wide variety of customers in often complex and high-stakes environments (SME as well as Large Accounts).
- Gain the trust of local companies in Germany as well as key accounts and their subsidiaries abroad.
- Gather the customer's initial needs and suggest an appropriate response.
- Adapt the software to the customer’s local context in Germany.
- Train the administrators to use the software in total autonomy.
- Ensure the Go-live and the follow-up during the first weeks of use.
- Demonstrate flexibility and agility throughout the implementation in the event of unforeseen circumstances and technical challenges.

𝐅𝐨𝐥𝐥𝐨𝐰-𝐮𝐩 𝐨𝐟 𝐊𝐞𝐲 𝐀𝐜𝐜𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐭𝐬 (𝐬𝐮𝐩𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭, 𝐚𝐜𝐜𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐭 𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭)
- Keep a close eye on the satisfaction of your most important customers.
- Support these customers in case of level 2 issues.
- Carry out post-implementation check-ups.
- Identify and generate new cross sell or upsell opportunities to grow the company's reach to your German customers (lead generation).
- Be proactive in presenting new products that may address a customer's past issues.

𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐢𝐛𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐨𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐳𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐮𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐢𝐦𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐒 𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐢𝐧 the company
- Adapt their offer and strengthen the market-fit of their solutions for the German market.
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of the business in Germany by going beyond your main tasks.
- Follow and participate in some projects from the pre-sales phase, supporting the sales team.

Requirements

Sounds a bit like you, doesn't it?

You’re the right fit if you:
❏ You have prior experience in a project management role (at least 4-5 years).
❏ You have a Tech / SaaS affinity. You have successfully led end-to-end software implementation projects, coordinating internal teams and client stakeholders across all phases.
❏ You don’t need prior HR knowledge, but it would be a plus.
❏ A willingness to be a key player in this adventure, contributing to the German market's growth.
❏ Looking for a dynamic work environment with varied missions requiring versatility and organization.
❏ Comfortable and eager to work with both local businesses and key accounts (C-Level).
❏ You speak German at a native level and you have a strong command of English.
❏ Clear and structured oral and written communication.
❏ Taste for human contact and pedagogy.
❏ An aptitude for solving practical and sometimes technical problems.
❏ A sense of service and a taste for things well done.

And now, their recruitment process (in German and in English):

𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏: Screening interview with HR (30')
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟐: Interview with the Customer Success Manager (60')
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟑: Case study + quick chat with team members
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟒: Final Talk (45'): meet more of the team and see what the company is all about

Benefits

🚆 Deutschlandticket – 75% of your subscription covered.
🏋️‍♀️ Wellpass subscription – discounted access to sports, fitness and activities you actually enjoy.
🐾 Their office is pet-friendly! Feel free to bring your furry friends to work.
🏠 Remote-friendly work policy– remote work possible after onboarding, either occasional or hybrid. To make working from home comfortable, the company provides the right equipment.

Their 𝐜𝐮𝐥𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞

At our client's company, they have just one rule: work seriously, but don’t take yourself too seriously. They value transparency, autonomy, high standards, and a free spirit so everyone can give their best while staying true to themselves.

And because work should also be fun, their year is full of events: several company seminars, a team-building activity per team, a start-up weekend, a welcome drink every month for new hires, and introductory lunches for newcomers. They love coming together, sharing, and celebrating… So, are you ready to join them?

- poskytování zdravotní péče v ambulanci i v přirozeném prostředí klientů,

jobs.description:
We are Isarsoft

We make every camera count
At ​Isarsoft ​we develop video analytics software ​to make transportation and cities more efficient, inclusive and secure. ​We stand for data protection and responsible processing of sensitive data. Being ​on the forefront of innovation we work together in interdisciplinary teams in a positive, fun and energetic atmosphere.

Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do. ​Founded in 2019 ​​we have ​grown organically winning large customers ​and partners delivering compelling, reliable, high-performance software. We are proud of being a privately held company with family atmosphere focusing on long-term relations to our customers and team members.


Your mission

  • Support Customer Success: Assist in engaging with customers to understand their technical needs and use cases for Isarsoft Perception.

  • Bridge Tech & Requirements: Work alongside our engineering team to help translate customer feedback into actionable product requirements.

  • Hands-on Technical Support: Partner with sales and engineering teams during technical workshops, product demos, and onboarding.

  • Product Improvement: Help investigate new feature opportunities based on real user data and customer feedback.

  • Enrolled student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field (ideally with at least 2 semesters remaining).

  • First practical experience (through projects, internships, or courses) in SQL, Python, and working with APIs/SDKs.

  • Strong communication skills and a problem-solving mindset with a focus on helping users.

  • Fluency in both English and German (min. C1 level required).

  • Ability to work up to 20 hours/week during the semester (flexible during semester breaks).


Additional assets

  • Familiarity with Docker or Linux environments.

  • Basic understanding of Computer Vision or AI applications.

  • Prior experience in a startup or fast-paced tech environment

  • Modern development workflow proficiency, including the confident and reliable use of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor).

  • Strong foundation in version control systems (Git) and hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines


Benefits

  • An experienced, highly motivated and international team to learn and grow
  • A high-impact work environment with flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes
  • Have the flexibility to work from anywhere: A great office in Munich, from home or the English-Garden
  • Free lunch, coffee and drinks at our office 
Sounds good? We are just getting started. Let's build a great company together.


Hiring Process

We are committed to a transparent and fair hiring process. We aim for concluding the interview process in no longer than 2 weeks.

The following three stages are typical for any position at Isarsoft.

  • Video Interview with HR
  • Technical Deep Dive 
We deeply believe that a great product only can be build by a great team. That's why sharing our values, being a team-player and having a energetic attitude is as important as bringing the right technical skills.

Etsimme nyt asiakkaallemme Tiskaajaa Turun keskustassa olevaan ravintolaan. Kyseessä vakituinen paikka. Tunteja noin 90h/3 viikkoa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu astioiden tiskausta, keittiön siisteydestä huolehtimista, sekä muita avustavia keittiötehtäviä tarpeen mukaan. Aikaisempi kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä katsotaan eduksi. Työn ohjaus ja itse työnteko tapahtuu suomeksi eli hakijalta vaaditaan sujuvaa suomenkielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.

Odotamme sinulta:

* Oma-aloitteista ja reipasta työotetta
* Kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että tiimissä.
* Hygieniapassia

Työ alkaa heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä eli laitathan pikaisesti hakemusta tulemaan osoitteessa: www.worker.fi. Suoritamme haastatteluja jo hakuaikana.

HAE TÄTÄ TYÖTÄ!

Lähetä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Töitä voi olla tarjolla nopealla aikataululla, joten jätä hakemuksesi pian! Voit myös lähettää meille avoimen hakemuksen ja kertoa, millaista työtä etsit. Lisää tietoa tästä työstä saa arkisin 8-16, Jouni Elonen p. 050 321 7968 tai jouni.elonen@worker.fi

MIKSI TÖIHIN WORKERILLE?

Worker on kotimainen henkilöstöpalvelualan konkari, joka yhdistää työnhakijat ja työpaikat tehokkaasti. Workerin kautta löydät työ- ja koulutusmahdollisuuksia nopeasti ja vaivattomasti. Me etsimme jatkuvasti uusia osaajia ympäri Suomea!

Reiluus on meille sääntö, ei poikkeus. Arvostamme aidosti työntekijöitämme ja maksamme TESin mukaista tai sitä parempaa palkkaa, joka tulee aina ajallaan. Toimitamme laadukkaat työvarusteet, tarjoamme etuja työntekijöillemme ja tuemme kaikissa työelämän ja elämän kiemuroissa.

Aiomme tulevaisuudessakin olla luotettava työnantaja yli tuhannelle työntekijällemme ja toimimme rekrytoijana ja työsuhteessa työnantajana aina arvojemme mukaan – joustavasti, luotettavasti ja oikeudenmukaisesti.

jobs.title: Housekeeper
jobs.description:
**We Are Looking for Several Housekeepers in Kuopio**

Are you interested in working in an international and people-oriented environment that offers opportunities to learn, develop, and grow? We would love to have you on our team!

N-Clean was recognized as Finland's most people-oriented workplace in the HUMAN POWER 2024 competition. This prestigious award reflects our values: trust, appreciation, and commitment to shared goals. We are now looking for new team members who share our values and want to be part of a responsible and people-focused work community.

Your place of work at the beginning of your employment will be a hotel, where work is carried out from Monday to Sunday, primarily during morning shifts. In this role, you will work at our customer site and be responsible for the cleanliness of hotel rooms as well as other customer service tasks related to cleaning services. You will work responsibly, follow safety and quality standards, and take care of your work environment. At N-Clean, we work responsibly as part of a reliable team.

We offer a permanent part-time employment contract of 5 to 30 hours per week. Work will begin as soon as possible once a suitable candidate is found, or no later than December 1, 2026. Salary is determined in accordance with the Collective Agreement for Property Services Employees and depends on your duties. The trainee salary is €11.33/hour, after which the salary ranges from €12.59/hour to €13.22/hour depending on the position. In addition, we offer a responsible employer that ensures fair employment conditions, a safe working environment, and employee well-being.

Success in this role requires a positive attitude, willingness to learn, and the ability to work as a reliable and conscientious team player. We also expect a desire to contribute to an equal and respectful work community. A customer-oriented approach and the ability to create a positive atmosphere in the workplace are important qualities. We are committed to fair working conditions, safety, and employee well-being. Previous experience in the cleaning services industry is required, and relevant education in the field is considered an advantage.

A strong command of Finnish is not required if your English skills are fluent. In this case, basic Finnish language skills are sufficient. We value a diverse work community where different language and cultural backgrounds are seen as a strength. If you are not a Finnish citizen, you must already hold a valid work permit when applying for this position.

**Equality and Responsibility**

Every employee is important to us. We treat everyone equally and with respect regardless of their background, and we do not tolerate discrimination in any form. We operate responsibly and transparently while ensuring a safe and supportive work community.

**Submit Your Application as Soon as Possible, but No Later Than September 21, 2026**

Your application and CV are an important part of our recruitment process, and a carefully completed application will help you progress in the process. Competition for jobs is high, and last year we received more than 12,500 applications across all our positions.

Please tell us as clearly as possible in your application when you are available to work and a little about yourself, such as your previous work experience, education, or hobbies. If you proceed in our recruitment process and start working with us, this information will help us identify your strengths and match you with the most suitable workplace and team.

We contact all applicants during the recruitment process, and our goal is to respond within two weeks of receiving an application. You will receive updates on the progress of your application by email.

Applicants who advance to the interview stage will be invited to our unique recruitment event, which was recognized as the third most people-oriented workplace initiative in Finland at the HumanPower Gala organized by Hälsa and the Finland Chamber of Commerce at the end of 2025.

The invitation will be sent by email, so please remember to check both your inbox and spam folder. Participation must be confirmed separately.

**The event will be held in Kuopio on Wednesday, October 21, from 2:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. We recruit exclusively through the recruitment event.**

Regular plant care in industrial settings should be performed according to a structured maintenance schedule that varies by system type and operational demands. Critical systems require daily monitoring, while comprehensive maintenance typically occurs weekly to monthly. The frequency depends on equipment complexity, operating conditions, and regulatory requirements. Effective plant care combines preventive maintenance, routine inspections, and system optimization to ensure reliable operations. What does regular plant care actually involve?
Regular plant care encompasses comprehensive maintenance activities, including preventive maintenance, routine inspections, equipment servicing, and system optimization. This approach focuses on identifying and addressing potential issues before they cause operational disruptions or safety concerns.
The fundamental difference between reactive and proactive maintenance approaches defines successful plant care strategies. Reactive maintenance responds to equipment failures after they occur, often resulting in costly downtime and emergency repairs. Proactive plant care involves scheduled maintenance activities, continuous monitoring, and systematic inspections that prevent failures before they happen.

jobs.title: Postdoc AI in psychiatry
jobs.description:
In this position you will develop AI models to improve the lives of patients with psychiatric disorders. Interested? Apply now! In this project, you will develop predictive AI models that support clinically actionable outcomes for psychiatric disorders such as depression and schizophrenia. Working closely with (neuro)scientists and clinicians, you will translate cutting-edge AI methods into solutions for real-world clinical challenges. Your research will span a broad range of modelstopics, including deep learning, causal machine learning, distributed learning, unsupervised learning, foundation models, natural language processing, and explainable AI. A key challenge is that psychiatric research often relies on relatively small datasets, that while biomedical data are limited, and that data are subject to strict privacy requirements. You will work with a rich variety of data sources, including clinical data, (unstructured) electronic health records, MRI, time-series data (such as EEG, functional MRI, speech, and video), omics data, and mobile sensing. Amsterdam UMC offers access to extensive large datasets for model development and diagnostics, while also providing a unique opportunity to develop AI models for actionable problems for methods that remain effective in the small-data settings that are common in psychiatric research. You will develop innovative AI tools to improve the diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment of psychiatric disorders such as depression and schizophrenia. You will initiate and lead AI research projects in close collaboration with clinicians and researchers, combining cutting-edge AI methods with pressing clinical challenges. In addition to conducting your own research, you will (co-)supervise PhD candidates and initiate research projects for AI _tudents, helping to foster the next generation of researchers. You will also (co-)lead the department’s data science interest group, contribute to regional collaborations on data sharing, and actively

acquire funding to expand and sustain this line of research. You have a (nearly completed) PhD in AI and a strong scientific track record; You have experience with biomedical data analysis, image analysis, time-series analysis and/or unstructured data; You have excellent communication skills and command of written and oral English. Basic command of Dutch is preferred; You enjoy working in a multidisciplinary environment together with clinicians and are dedicated to developing clinical applications for psychiatry. One-year contract with possible extension for one more year. Further extension is dependent on additional funding. Classification in salary scale 10 or 11: € 3.724 to € 6.825 gross for full-time employment (depending on education and experience). If you travel by foot, bicycle, or car, a mileage allowance of €0.21 per km applies (up to a maximum of 40 km one way by car). Do you prefer walking or cycling? Over Vending@Work
Vending@Work (V@W) is opgericht in 1994 te Groningen en begon destijds met het plaatsen van zogeheten honestyboxen bij bedrijven en instellingen. Het concept was gebaseerd op de eerlijkheid van de mens. Consumenten konden betalen met een gulden voor elk artikel dat zij uit de box haalden, maar konden dit ook niet doen. Vooral bij grotere organisaties hield dit concept niet lang stand, zodat in 1998 werd besloten tot het plaatsen en exploiteren van frisdrank-, snack- en versautomaten. Vandaag de dag bedient V@W vanuit drie distributiecentra (Groningen, Nieuwegein en Nijmegen ) circa 5.000 automaten in Nederland. Daarnaast verzorgt V@W in meerdere school- en bedrijfskantines de catering. Met de inzet van circa 250 medewerkers is V@W daarmee één van de grootste landelijke spelers in de markt van vending.
Voor onze vestiging in Groningen zijn wij op zoek naar een plaatser / medewerker Technische Dienst in de buitendienst.
Over de functie
In deze functie ga je zelfstandig op pad met de bestelbus om storingen te verhelpen aan automaten bij onze opdrachtgevers. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het (gebruiksklaar) plaatsen en ophalen van de automaten. Ook voer je technisch onderhoud uit zodat de automaten perfect blijven functioneren. Verder ben je telefonische vraagbaak voor onze operators bij storingen.

jobs.title: Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs
jobs.description:
Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.


Tasks and Responsabilities

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.
  • Engage actively in innovation within the area(s) of knowledge to update teaching and learning methodologies and educational technology in collaboration with the Educational Technology team and industry professionals.
  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
  • Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus. 
  • Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. 
  • Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities.
  • Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy.
  • Collaborate with Dean of Institutional Effectiveness to ensure program quality and compliance with all regulations and accreditation requirements. 
  • Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success.
  • Collaborate with Employability team and devise and implement measures and initiatives to boost students’ employability and career success. 
  • Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings.
  • Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.
  • Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director.


Your Profile

  • An earned Doctorate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy or related field from an accredited institution or close to completion.
  • Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience.
  • Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff.
  • Passion and commitment to student support and success.
  • Knowledge and experience in distant leaning and online instruction.
  • Knowledge of the American and/or French higher education systems is a plus.
  • Either native English speaker or proficiency level of English competency
  • Local language (French, German, Spanish), desirable
Competencies

jobs.title: Palveluesihenkilö
jobs.description:
**Tule meille palveluesihenkilöksi Kuopioon**

Haluatko johtaa omaa tiimiäsi ja vastata palvelun sujuvuudesta asiakaskohteessa? Meillä työ tehdään vastuullisesti osana luotettavaa tiimiä. Etsimme energistä ja vastuullista esihenkilöä, joka nauttii ihmisten johtamisesta ja arjen organisoinnista sekä haluaa rakentaa arvostavaa ja toimivaa työyhteisöä.

Tehtävässä vastaat kohteesi päivittäisestä toiminnasta, palveluliiketoiminnan johtamisesta ja kehittämisestä, henkilöstöjohtamisesta sekä asiakasyhteistyöstä kansainvälisessä ja ihmisläheisessä ympäristössä. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät käytännön arjen johtaminen, palvelun sujuva ja laadukas toteuttaminen yhdessä tiimin kanssa, ttoiminnan kehittäminen ja taloudellinen vastuu sekä muutosten vieminen käytäntöön ja työskentely arvojemme mukaisesti.

Tehtävä sopii sinulle, olitpa jo kokenut esihenkilö puhtausalalta tai uutta suuntaa urallasi etsivä alanvaihtaja.

**Työtehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa**

- kohteen toiminnan, laadun ja asiakastyytyväisyyden johtaminen

- henkilöstön johtaminen, rekrytointi, perehdyttäminen, työvuorosuunnittelu ja työkyvyn tukeminen

- asiakassuhteiden johtaminen ja kehittäminen, lisämyynnin edistäminen sekä uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistaminen

- kohteen talouden, budjetin ja resurssien seuranta sekä kannattavuuden kehittäminen

- toiminnan tavoitteellinen kehittäminen, riskien tunnistaminen ja turvallisen työympäristön varmistaminen

- raportointi keskeisistä tunnusluvuista ja palvelun sujuvuudesta

- osallistuminen tarvittaessa suorittavaan siivoustyöhön


**Odotamme sinulta**

- soveltuvaa koulutusta ja kokemusta kiinteistö- tai palvelualalta sekä kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä tai tiimin ohjaamisesta

- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä kykyä motivoida, kehittää ja valmentaa tiimiä sekä johtaa tiimiä oikeudenmukaisesti ja johdonmukaisesti

- asiakaslähtöistä ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta

- kykyä suunnitella ja kehittää toimintaa kustannustehokkaasti sekä johtaa muutoksia arjessa

- valmiutta vastata oman kohteesi toiminnasta ja tuloksesta

- riittäviä digitaalisia taitoja työvälineiden ja järjestelmien käyttöön

- positiivista, vastuullista ja tavoitteellista asennetta sekä liiketoimintalähtöistä ajattelua

- sujuvaa suullista sekä kirjallista suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

- ajokorttia


**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- toistaiseksi voimassa olevan työsuhteen, 37,5 tuntia viikossa

- työpäivät arkiaamuisin, toivomme tarvittaessa joustavuutta työskennellä erilaisissa vuoroissa

- kilpailukykyisen palkan, noin 2881-3293€ €/kk kokemuksestasi riippuen

- työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä tai viimeistään

- kattavan perehdytyksen uudistetulla Onboarding-polullamme sekä N-Clean Academyssä ja henkilökohtaisen tuen työn aloitukseen

- mahdollisuuden kehittyä esihenkilötehtävissä ja rakentaa urapolkuasi osana kasvavaa organisaatiota

- kansainvälisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön

- turvallisen ja arvostavan työympäristön

- reilut työehdot, turvallisen työympäristön ja hyvinvoinnista huolehtimisen


**Yhdenvertaisuus ja vastuullisuus** Meille jokainen työntekijä on tärkeä. Johdamme työyhteisöä yhdenvertaisesti ja kohtelemme kaikkia kunnioittavasti – emme hyväksy syrjintää missään muodossa. Toimimme vastuullisesti ja huolehdimme turvallisesta ja hyvinvoivasta työympäristöstä.

**Miksi meille kannattaa tulla töihin**

Meille tärkeintä on, että viihdyt työssäsi ja tunnet tekeväsi merkityksellistä työtä. Panostamme pitkäjänteisesti työntekijäkokemukseen ja arjen sujuvuuteen – ja se näkyy myös tuloksissa: työntekijöidemme eNPS on huipputasolla, 55.

Tämä näkyy arjessamme hyvänä ilmapiirinä, arvostuksena ja yhdessä tekemisenä. Olemme myös saaneet tunnustusta työstämme:

- Vuonna 2024 meidät valittiin Suomen ihmisläheisimmäksi työpaikaksi

- Vuonna 2025 sijoituimme samassa kategoriassa kolmannelle sijalle

- Vuonna 2025 saavutimme 3. sijan Suomen ihmisläheisin työelämäteko -kategoriassa


**Hae huipputiimiin!**

**Lähetä hakemuksesi palkkatoiveineen viimeistään 6.10.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa palvelupäällikko Anne Rouvinen puhlimitse 040 5488 520 25.9.2026 klo 12.-14.00 ja 18.9.2026 klo 13.-15.00.**

Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, ja paikka voidaan täyttää ennen hakuajan päättymistä.

Otamme hakemuksia vastaan ainoastaan nettisivujemme hakulomakkeen kautta.

Tiimisi odottaa jo sinua!

  • HubSpot-Einführungen von A bis Z: Du verantwortest die Konzeption und Implementierung von Sales Hub, Marketing Hub und Service Hub – von der Anforderungsaufnahme über das Setup bis zum Go-live und Hypercare.
  • Integration & Systemarchitektur: Du bindest HubSpot an bestehende Systemlandschaften an (ERP, BI, Telefonie, Webshops etc.) – via nativer Integrationen, Middleware oder API – und sorgst für saubere Datenflüsse und hohe Datenqualität.

Qualifikation

Was Du mitbringst:

  • Nachweisbare, mehrjährige HubSpot-Erfahrung – Du hast bereits mehrere Einführungsprojekte von Sales, Marketing und/oder Service Hub verantwortet, idealerweise auf Agentur-/Beratungsseite oder als interne/r HubSpot-Verantwortliche/r mit Projektleitungserfahrung.
  • Tiefes Plattform-Know-how: Custom Objects, Workflows, Sequenzen, Lead Scoring, Reporting, Berechtigungskonzepte und Datenmodellierung sind für Dich Alltag. Aktuelle HubSpot-Zertifizierungen sind ein starkes Plus.

  • Sprachliche Kompetenz: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und verfügst zumindest über fundierte Englischkenntnisse.

Wichtig: Diese Position richtet sich ausdrücklich an erfahrene HubSpot-Profis. Eine Einarbeitung in die Plattform ist nicht vorgesehen – Du solltest vom ersten Tag an eigenständig Projekte übernehmen können.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Wir glauben an die Vorteile von Flexibilität und bieten Dir die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten, während wir persönliche Treffen für kreative Prozesse schätzen.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our award-winning Data Science team at a pivotal moment. Carwow operates a two-sided marketplace — connecting car buyers and sellers at scale — and data science sits at the heart of how we make that marketplace smarter, faster, and more valuable for everyone in it. In fact, we recently won GenAI initiative of the Year at the British Data Awards.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role working centrally across the business. You'll partner with teams spanning Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations — developing and deploying ML and AI solutions that drive outcomes across both sides of our marketplace. The problems you'll work on are genuinely varied: pricing models, propensity and demand signals that sharpen marketing spend, personalised recommendations for our web product and CRM, and LLM-powered solutions for operational challenges like document verification.

You'll translate ambiguous business problems into structured, production-ready solutions — and you'll be expected to deliver them end-to-end, from first principles through to being deployment-ready and beyond.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • End-to-End ML & AI Delivery: Lead data science initiatives from problem framing through to deployment, monitoring, and iteration — delivering the full production lifecycle. With no dedicated ML engineering function, you'll be responsible for ensuring your solutions are robust, scalable, and performing in the real world long after they ship.

  • GenAI & LLM Application: Design and build LLM-powered solutions where they create genuine business value — document processing, intelligent search, content understanding, and beyond. Apply them alongside classical ML with clear judgement about where each approach earns its place.

  • Commercial Impact: Connect your work directly to business outcomes. Whether you're building a model to improve marketing efficiency, a pricing signal to sharpen commercial decisions, or a recommendation engine to increase conversion — you understand the business lever you're pulling and design your solutions accordingly.

  • Prototyping & Experimentation: Move fast to test ideas before committing to full-scale development. Define rigorous success metrics upfront, validate honestly, and know when to double down and when to walk away.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations stakeholders to understand problems deeply before reaching for a solution. Translate findings into clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Standards & Craft: Contribute to shared best practices, documentation, and ways of working that raise the bar for the data science function — and help more junior team members grow alongside you. Drive continued adoption of AI capabilities to drive efficiencies, automation and constantly leverage new capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

Please note: We know that no candidate will be the perfect match for all we've listed in this posting, so we’d encourage you to apply if you feel you're close to the brief but not an exact match. Ideally you’ll have

  • Commercial Mindset: You think about business impact first. You understand how your models connect to revenue, efficiency, or customer outcomes — and you use that to prioritise, scope, and communicate your work.

  • Stakeholder Partnership: Proven ability to work with commercial, marketing, and product stakeholders — translating business problems into well-scoped solutions and communicating technical solutions, challenges and outcomes clearly at all levels.

  • Sound Judgement: You navigate the tooling landscape with clear eyes — knowing when classical ML is right, when GenAI unlocks something new, and when a simpler solution is the more honest answer. Strong instincts for scalability, reliability, and explainability.

  • [Bonus] Marketplace or Two-Sided Platform Experience: Understanding of supply/demand dynamics and how data science creates leverage in a marketplace context.

TEHCNICAL SKILLSET

  • Proven ML Experience: A strong track record of building, deploying, and maintaining ML models in Python in a production environment — not just notebooks. You've owned models after they ship and know how to keep them healthy.

  • Full-Lifecycle Delivery (MLOps): Comfortable delivering the end-to-end production lifecycle — model training, versioning, monitoring, and champion/challenger experimentation — without relying on a dedicated ML engineering team to carry that responsibility.

  • GenAI & LLM Expertise: Hands-on experience building LLM-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You understand how to apply, evaluate, and extend these tools — and you're honest about where they fall short.

  • Technical Depth: Solid experience in a cloud ML environment with software engineering principles — version control, code reviews, unit testing, and familiarity with containerisation.

  • Quantitative Rigour: Strong foundation in statistical evaluation and experiment design. You can define and defend success metrics, and you know when a model is degrading and what to do about it.

  • [Bonus] Experience with VertexAI

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES

  • Languages: Python, SQL

  • Data & Transformation: dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery

  • Visualisation & BI: Looker

  • Engineering & MLOps: Docker, GitHub

  • Workflow & Orchestration: Vertex AI Pipelines (GCP), Kubeflow

  • LLMs & GenAI: Gemini API, Claude API

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Step 1: People Team Screening Call (30 min)

  • Step 2: Hiring Manager Call: Experience (45 min)

  • Step 3: Technical Task: covering both Modelling & Production with Presentation (60 min + Task)

  • Step 4: Values Interview (45 min)

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Vitality Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

    • 28 days annual leave

    • 1 day for your wedding

    • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

    • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.

Onze klant beheerst als toonaangevend wegenbouwer alle aspecten van de wegenbouw.

Ook in de haven en de petrochemie zijn we sterk vertegenwoordigd.

Met onze vier asfaltcentrales, een participatie van 50% in Ascovil (Villers-Le-Bouillet) en vier betoncentrales zijn we een van de belangrijkste producenten van asfalt en wegenisbeton.
