jobs.title: Director, GTM Partnerships, SME & growth
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the role...

As Partnerships Director, France & Spain, you will lead and develop a team of four partnership managers:

  • Two Accounting Partnerships Managers

  • One Venture Capital Partnerships Manager

  • One Travel & E-commerce Partnerships Manager

You will own the partnerships strategy and commercial performance across both markets, building a channel-led growth engine that generates qualified introductions, partner-sourced pipeline and net-new business for Airwallex.

This is a strategic, hands-on player-coach role. You will set direction, develop the team and build the operating model, while personally sourcing, negotiating, activating and growing strategic partnerships.

The role is focused on commercial partnerships and lead generation—not technical integrations. The initial priority is to build the Accounting and Travel & E-commerce channels across France and Spain. The broader scope includes Payments and Venture Capital and may evolve with business priorities.

The role is based in either France or Spain, with a minimum of three days per week in the relevant Airwallex office.

What you’ll do...

  • Own the France and Spain partnerships strategy, aligned with the SME & Growth GTM.

  • Set partner ICPs, commercial priorities, account plans, pipeline expectations and operating standards across the team.

  • Lead, coach and develop the four partnership managers.

  • Personally source and progress a portfolio of strategic partnerships in at least one priority vertical.

  • Build repeatable referral, reseller, co-selling and partner-led outbound motions across Accounting, Travel, Payments, E-commerce and VC.

  • Ensure signed partnerships become active commercial channels, not passive logos.

  • Work with Sales on account mapping, lead routing, qualification, follow-up and conversion of partner-sourced opportunities.

  • Track active partners, referrals, opportunities, sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion, time to first referral and revenue contribution.

  • Test partner segments and commercial motions; scale what creates quality pipeline and stop what does not.

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, RevOps, Product, Solutions, Risk and Compliance to remove friction from the partner journey.

What you’ll bring...

  • 8+ years in partnerships, channel sales, indirect sales, partner sales, strategic business development or a comparable commercial role.

  • A successful 0-to-1 partnership motion or vertical launch in Accounting or Travel & E-commerce, with measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Strong channel-led execution and a personal track record of partner-sourced referrals, pipeline, opportunities or revenue.

  • Commercial experience across at least two of these verticals: Accounting, Travel, Payments, E-commerce or Venture Capital.

  • A deep, activatable network in at least one priority vertical, with access to senior decision-makers.

  • Strong strategic judgement and hands-on execution: you can define the strategy and personally open the first doors, lead key meetings and progress strategic partnerships.

  • Experience designing partner ICPs, activation motions, attribution and channel performance management.

  • Experience leading, coaching or developing partnership professionals is preferred. Formal people-management experience is valuable, but not the only indicator of leadership potential.

  • Experience in accounting, payments, fintech, ERP, financial software or another competitive B2B environment.

  • Professional English plus native or bilingual French or Spanish. Native or bilingual proficiency in the other local language is a strong advantage, but not required.

  • Comfortable with CRM, funnel metrics, partner economics and basic business cases.

Who you are...

  • Strategic and hands-on: you can set direction while staying close to partners, pipeline and commercial details.

jobs.title: DPO & Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
🌀 The Company

Filigran, founded in October 2022, stands out in the cybertech ecosystem for its commitment to revolutionizing cyber threat management with a proactive approach. Its mission is to develop innovative open-source solutions designed to anticipate cyber threats, identify security gaps, and strengthen organizational security posture.

Filigran solutions are now trusted by over 6,000 public and private organizations worldwide.

🎯 The Role

We’re looking for a DPO & Compliance Officer to design and implement Filigran’s practical, scalable compliance program.

You will be Filigran’s formal Data Protection Officer, ensuring strong privacy governance across our products, operations and international footprint. You will also lead the day-to-day design and delivery of broader compliance workstreams, including AI governance, cybersecurity regulation, operational resilience, export controls and sanctions.

You will work closely with the General Counsel, CEO, CISO, People, Product, Engineering and Sales teams, helping Filigran meet regulatory expectations in a business-minded attitude.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Act as Filigran’s Data Protection Officer and primary point of contact for supervisory authorities, including the CNIL, and for data subjects.

  • Design and operate Filigran’s privacy program, including ROPAs, DPIAs, privacy by design, retention, data-subject rights, breach assessment and international data transfers.

  • Lead the design and operational implementation of compliance controls across AI governance, NIS2, operational resilience, export controls and economic sanctions, under the General Counsel’s leadership.

  • Maintain a proportionate compliance framework, including policies, risk mapping, monitoring plans, internal controls and clear reporting.

  • Partner with Security to translate regulatory requirements into practical, business-enabling policies and controls that work for a fast-growing cybersecurity company.

  • Partner with Security, Product and Engineering to embed privacy, AI and regulatory requirements into product development, vendor management and customer assurance.

  • Monitor regulatory developments across the EU, UK, US and other relevant markets, and provide clear recommendations to the General Counsel and executive team.

  • Support enterprise sales and procurement by responding to privacy, AI governance and compliance requirements.

  • Leverage AI tools and methodologies to boost productivity and impact

  • Contribute to building AI capabilities into internal workflows

🤝 Who You’ll Work With

You will have a split reporting line:

  • For your statutory DPO responsibilities, you will report directly to the CEO. You will have the independence and access to senior management required to carry out those responsibilities.

  • For all other compliance responsibilities, you will report to the General Counsel, who retains ultimate accountability for Filigran’s wider compliance programme and material compliance decisions.

You will work closely with the General Counsel, CISO, Security, Product, Engineering, Sales, People and Finance teams. You will lead delivery across the programme while knowing when to escalate decisions and draw on internal or external specialists.

🧬 Profile We’re Looking For

  • 7 to 10 years’ experience as a DPO, data privacy lead or compliance officer, ideally in a fast-growing technology or SaaS company.

  • Demonstrable expert knowledge of data protection law and practice. A recognized DPO certification or IAPP qualification, such as CIPP/E, is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with a company-wide implementation of the EU AI Act.

  • Deep, hands-on command of GDPR and UK GDPR, including ROPAs, DPIAs, breach management, data-subject rights and international transfers.

  • Demonstrable ownership of at least two adjacent regulatory programmes, such as AI governance, cybersecurity regulation, operational resilience, export controls or economic sanctions.

  • Able to lead unfamiliar workstreams with sound judgement and appropriate specialist internal or external support.

  • Comfortable translating complex legal and regulatory requirements into proportionate controls that work operationally.

  • Able to build strong relationships and credibility with technical, commercial and executive stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment.

  • Autonomy, ownership and team spirit.

  • Strong interest in AI and its applications in the privacy & compliance function

  • Comfortable working with and leveraging AI-powered tools (LLMs, automation, copilots, etc.) to improve workflows and productivity

  • Bonus: experience in cybersecurity, threat intelligence or a technical B2B SaaS environment; fluency in English and French.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We’re a fast-growing, global, and fully remote company building open-source cybersecurity solutions, increasingly powered by AI, to help defense teams anticipate threats and act faster.

⭐ What we believe

We believe we do work that matters, uniting defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient & collaborative.

💻 How we work

We do work that matters by combining strong engineering standards with emerging technologies, including AI, to move faster and smarter.

🧭 What guides us

We make our work matter by building a culture grounded in our CORE values of Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility, and Equity. The principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people, and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive pay + equity - everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first, flexible, and balanced - work that fits your life

  • Your setup, your choice - pick the gear that works for you

  • Twice-a-year gatherings - we meet in person for regional and global offsites to connect, collaborate, and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion - from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of our people make our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity, and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from, or how you identify.

  • Data & Metrics: Establish TA metrics and dashboards (time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, quality-of-hire, pipeline conversion, diversity metrics) and use data to drive decisions and report to the executive team and board.

  • Experience operating in a mid-size, fast-growing company environment
  • Hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves approach balanced with strategic, big-picture thinking.

  • Deep knowledge of modern sourcing strategies, employer branding, and recruiting technology (AI Recruiter Agents, ATS, CRM).
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to influence and partner with senior executives.

jobs.title: Huishoudhulp thuiszorg - regio Lummen (deeltijds)
jobs.description:
Familiehulp ondersteunt mensen in hun dagelijks leven, met aandacht voor zorg, welzijn, huishouden en schoonmaak.

 

Als huishoudhulp / poetshulp in de thuiszorg ondersteun je mensen met een zorgbehoefte.

Je helpt hen voornamelijk met huishoudelijke taken zodat zij comfortabel thuis kunnen blijven wonen.

De klant is altijd thuis als jij er bent en je werkt samen met collega's huishoudhulpen en verzorgenden in een zorgteam.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Het schoonmaken en poetsen van de woningen.
  • Af en toe de was en strijk .
  • Een luisterend oor en aandacht voor het welzijn van je klant.
  • Het signaleren van noden of veranderingen aan je collega's wanneer dat nodig is.
  • Geen ervaring of diploma nodig.
  • Je hebt een hart voor mensen en haalt voldoening uit huishoudelijke hulp, poetsen en schoonmaken bij klanten thuis.
  • Je houdt van sociaal contact, maar werkt ook graag zelfstandig.
  • Je werkt stipt en overlegt vlot met je klant en het zorgteam.
  • Je bent betrouwbaar en hebt respect voor de privacy van je klanten.

  • Je beschikt over eigen vervoer.

In sommige regio's is ander aangepast vervoer handig om bij de klanten te geraken, zeker als je voltijds werkt.

jobs.title: Ambulancier Niet-Dringend Patiëntenvervoer - regio Turnhout
jobs.description:
Word jij onze nieuwe ambulancier?

Medical Transport Services is een snelgroeiend en professioneel bedrijf gespecialiseerd in niet-dringend patiëntenvervoer. Dagelijks vervoeren wij patiënten van en naar ziekenhuizen, woonzorgcentra, revalidatiecentra, dialysecentra en medische consultaties.

Voor onze standplaats in Turnhout zoeken wij enthousiaste ambulanciers die mee het verschil willen maken voor onze patiënten.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Veilig en comfortabel vervoeren van patiënten.
  • Begeleiden van patiënten tijdens het volledige transport.
  • Correct omgaan met medische hulpmiddelen.
  • Zorg dragen voor ambulance en materiaal.
  • Professioneel samenwerken met collega's, ziekenhuizen en zorginstellingen.
  • Elke patiënt op een respectvolle en vriendelijke manier behandelen.

Over Medical Transport Services

Medical Transport Services verzorgt dagelijks duizenden ritten voor ziekenhuizen, woonzorgcentra, huisartsenwachtposten, mutualiteiten en andere zorgpartners.

Wij staan bekend om onze professionele aanpak, kwalitatieve dienstverlening en respectvolle omgang met patiënten én medewerkers.

Wie zoeken wij?

Je bent:

  • in het bezit van een diploma Ambulancier Niet-Dringend Patiëntenvervoer én het vereiste visum/erkenning;

of

  • momenteel ingeschreven voor de opleiding Ambulancier Niet-Dringend Patiëntenvervoer of berid je hiervoor in te schrijven

Volg je momenteel de opleiding?

Dan ben je eveneens welkom om te solliciteren.

Tijdens jouw opleiding kan je bij ons al aan de slag als chauffeur patiëntenvervoer voor rolstoelafhankelijke patiënten. Zo doe je meteen praktijkervaring op binnen ons bedrijf. Zodra je jouw diploma en visum behaalt, stroom je door naar de functie van ambulancier.

Daarnaast:

  • beschik je over rijbewijs B;
  • ben je sociaal, vriendelijk en stressbestendig;
  • werk je graag zelfstandig én in team;
  • heb je een verzorgd voorkomen;
  • spreek en schrijf je vlot Nederlands.

jobs.title: Studentenbegeleider psychosociale en financiële dienstverlening - Campussen Antwerpen (50%)
jobs.description:
Hier gebeurt het. Met meer dan 2000 medewerkers en meer dan 22.000 studenten is Thomas More de grootste hogeschool van Vlaanderen, een warme, internationale en bruisende community met optimale leerkansen voor elk talent. Om onze visie 'met lef toonaangevend' verder te realiseren zijn wij op zoek naar mensen met Lef, Enthousiasme, Focus en Vertrouwen. Geïnspireerd door deze vier waarden bieden wij je een uitdagende job binnen een dynamische onderwijsomgeving waarin vernieuwing en samenwerking cruciaal zijn, en waarin je als TM-ambassadeur bijdraagt aan een aangename werkomgeving voor iedereen.

Inhoud van de opdracht:

  • Kortdurende eerstelijnsbegeleiding van studenten op psychosociaal vlak.
  • Doorverwijzing naar tweedelijnshulpverlening.
  • Eerste hulp bij crisissituaties en doorverwijzing.
  • Verstrekken van financiële hulpverlening.
  • Je draait mee in het team studentenvoorzieningen o.l.v. het diensthoofd studentenvoorzieningen.
  • Je hebt een bachelordiploma in de humane wetenschappen.
  • Je bezit kennis van de methodische/oplossingsgerichte hulpverlening en kan deze toepassen.
  • Je hebt ervaring in psychosociale eerstelijnshulpverlening.
  • Je hebt kennis van de sociale kaart om gericht door te verwijzen.
  • Je kan omgaan met moeilijkheden van studenten met een open blik.
  • Je biedt financiële dienstverlening aan.
  • Je bent communicatief en sociaal vaardig.
  • Je werkt discreet en nauwgezet met persoonlijke dossiers.
  • Je bent flexibel (avond- en weekendwerk schrikt je niet af).
  • Je bent een enthousiast en dynamisch persoon met een innovatieve ingesteldheid die zelfstandig en in team kan functioneren.
  • Je bent leergierig.
  • Je kan dienstverlening in het Engels aanbieden.
  • Je hebt een uitgesproken interesse voor studenten en het hoger onderwijs.
  • Je beantwoordt aan het profiel van de Thomas More-medewerker (https://thomasmore.be/nl/hogeschool-met-lefv).

La figura seguirà la commessa e il cantiere quotidianamente: pianificazione montaggi, coordinamento risorse, relazione con il cliente e controllo di tempi/costi, garantendo l'esecuzione efficace dei lavori. Obiettivo del ruolo e responsabilità principali: Assicurare che ogni commessa venga gestita con rispetto di tempi, contratti e consegne, mantenendo un presidio operativo sul cantiere e guidando squadre e fornitori con metodo, disciplina e orientamento al risultato. In particolare: Pianificazione delle commesse: organizzare il susseguirsi dei cantieri sul lungo periodo, in base alle scadenze contrattuali, durata dei cantieri, ecc. Pianificazione montaggi prefabbricati: programmare le attività dall'avvio del cantiere al termine del montaggio. Product Owner - Communications Channels & AI
jobs.description:
Role: Product Owner – Communication Channels & AI

Location: Manchester

Hours: Monday-Friday 8:45am-5:15pm

Package: £80k OTE 

As Product Owner - Technical Products, your role is to own and continuously improve PHMG's Technical product portfolio, ensuring Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE deliver measurable client value, operational quality and long-term commercial growth. 

You are accountable for translating client needs, technology capability, partner opportunities and commercial priorities into scalable products and service models that strengthen adoption, retention and PHMG's competitive position. 

Through H2 2026, you will lead the evolution of the technical product portfolio by bringing together product performance, platform capability, roadmap execution, client outcomes, commercial discipline, operational readiness and cross-functional alignment into one coherent product improvement agenda. 

Key Objectives 

Core Accountability 

  • Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.
  • Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.
  • Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.
  • Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.
  • Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.

 

Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap 

  • Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.
  • Prioritise AI Receptionist growth across both horizontal capability and the vertical use cases where PHMG has the strongest right to win.
  • Create a clear approach for CCE in the existing base, reducing under-utilisation and turning technical review, onboarding and value evidence into retention levers.
  • Partner with the Creative Product Owner so the full product set feels coherent to clients and to the teams selling and servicing it.

Client Experience, Adoption & Value Evidence 

  • Define the client experience for Technical products across onboarding, configuration, in-life usage, renewal and offboarding.
  • Clarify how clients access, configure and understand product value through the portal, including call flows, AI Receptionist behaviour, CCE setup and usage analytics.
  • Ensure CS has the standards, data and language needed to evidence value, drive adoption and manage client expectations confidently.
  • Identify where clients slow, stall or disengage, and build product or service-model interventions that protect retention.

Commercial Performance & Partner Discipline 

  • Own the commercial logic of the Technical portfolio, including pricing, CAC, cost-to-serve, gross margin, revenue performance and investment cases.
  • Operationalise the GoTo resell model with clear pricing, service, process and margin controls while protecting the partner relationship.
  • Use data to assess where Technical products create incremental value, where they cannibalise existing activity and where the model needs to change.
  • Make active trade-offs between speed, quality, margin, client experience and platform investment.

Operational Delivery & Launch Readiness 

  • Work with Technical Production and Tech to define standards, SLAs, runbooks and support models for each product and release.
  • Ensure new capabilities do not go live until operational readiness, client communications, CS briefings and support routes are clear.
  • Create tight governance for launch decisions, technical dependencies, client escalations, recurring provisioning issues and partner constraints.
  • Keep accountability clear between Product, Tech and Product Operations so issues are solved at the right level rather than absorbed by CS.

Insight, Reporting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Maintain a reliable view of product performance across adoption, usage, NPS, retention, revenue, margin, service issues and operational friction.
  • Build structured feedback loops with CS, Client Insights, Sales, Tech and Technical Production to identify product problems worth solving.
  • Turn recurring client or operational issues into permanent product, process, reporting or service-model improvements.
  • Use performance data to make early decisions before product issues become retention, margin or client-experience risks.

 

About PHMG:

Established in 1998, PHMG has grown from a Manchester-founded creative business into the world's leading audio branding agency. Today, we partner with almost 40,000 clients across more than 50 countries, including global brands such as Coca-Cola, Samsung, Adidas and Audi, alongside ambitious SMEs in virtually every sector. Innovation fuels everything we do. From day one, we set out to redefine audio branding by harmonising creativity, technology and measurable results. That mindset continues to shape our evolution as we expand beyond sound into a broader suite of client communication services. In 2025, PHMG entered a defining new chapter as an employee-owned business. Ownership now sits with the people who power our creativity, performance and growth. It strengthens our independence, sharpens our long-term focus and ensures success is shared. We are proud recipients of the King's Award for Enterprise, recognised for innovation, growth and performance excellence. Today, more than 800 colleagues across six global offices collaborate to deliver work that blends artistry with commercial impact. Joining PHMG means becoming part of a people-powered, future-focused company that values creativity, champions diversity and invests in professional growth. Sound good?

jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Embedded Software Engineer to join our Platform team supporting Spacecraft Operations. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in supporting other disciplines by focusing on the embedded software aspects of our satellite systems. The Platform team interfaces directly with many engineering groups to conduct R&D, design, manufacturing, and operations activities, ultimately ensuring all current and future spacecraft systems satisfy their mission.

Ideal candidates will embrace the commercialization of nanosatellite systems and adapt to low-cost, fast-paced systems design, development, and implementation methodologies that set Spire apart from our competition. In this fast-paced environment, the design to launch cycle is measured in weeks and months, not years!

 

What You'll Do as a Senior Embedded Software Engineer:

  • Design, implement and test, deploy and maintain embedded firmware
  • Collaborate with other engineering functions on scoping, architecture and system design
  • Resolve on-orbit and on-ground issues related to embedded systems
  • Implement, optimize and maintain various serial protocols
  • Design and develop interface tools to improve abstraction between the embedded system and other satellite components 
  • Debug and resolve complex embedded systems issues in a timely manner
  • Write and maintain technical documentation

 

Key Skills: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
  • Mastery of Embedded C programming language
  • Proficiency with scripting languages like Python and Bash
  • Extensive experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS), specifically FreeRTOS
  • Familiarity with serial protocols and implementations
  • Strong problem-solving skills, particularly in debugging embedded systems
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git)
  • Experience developing on Linux (Ubuntu)
  • A base level of mathematical knowledge (engineering mathematic or similar)
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities

 

Preferred Skills: 

  • Experience with space systems or satellite technology
  • Familiarity working to coding standards and using static analysis tools
  • Experience writing Rust for resource constrained environments (embedded Linux)
  • Experience with embedded Linux
  • Knowledge of control systems and algorithms

 

Tools and Technologies:

  • FreeRTOS for real-time operating system implementation
  • GNU ARM Embedded Toolchain for code compilation
  • GDB for debugging, complemented by extensive use of serial and/or CAN debugging
  • Experience with debugging techniques for systems without JTAG access, particularly for remote issue resolution
  • Familiarity with manual testing procedures for embedded interface code
  • Experience working with Arm Cortex Microcontrollers
  • Version control using Git

 

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.

jobs.title: Regional Account Relationship Manager – IFA Distribution (Scotland & Northern Ireland)
jobs.description:
What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.

A feel for our culture

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

Does this sound like you?

Flagstone is the UK's leading cash platform with £19bn in AuA and a mandate to reach £50bn by 2028. The IFA and wealth manager channel is one of the most significant growth opportunities in front of the business with over 1,400 registered IFA firms on the platform, strong existing relationships to deepen, and a large addressable market of independent advisers who have yet to engage with us at all.

The ARM role combines proactive business development with ongoing relationship management. You will be identifying and engaging IFA firms in Scotland and Northern Ireland, introducing the Flagstone proposition, training advisers on how to use the platform, and building the trusted, consistent relationships that turn a registered firm into an active referral partner.

What You'll Be Doing

Proactive Partner Engagement & Development

  • Own your territory of IFA firms and wealth managers, taking personal responsibility for the breadth and depth of engagement and the referral activity it generates

  • Spend the substantial majority of your time in the field visiting adviser firms, attending regional industry events, and building face-to-face relationships that create consistent, long-term referral partners

  • Proactively identify and approach IFA firms not yet working with Flagstone, introducing the proposition and beginning the relationship development process from first meeting to active referral

  • Work to deepen engagement with registered firms that are not yet actively referring, understanding what is holding them back and taking targeted action to unlock their activity

  • Grow the volume and value of referrals from existing active partners by helping them identify more clients who could benefit from Flagstone

Proposition Training & Education

  • Deliver clear, confident, and compelling presentations of the Flagstone proposition to IFA firms individually and in group settings

  • Train advisers on the Flagstone referral portal and onboarding process, reducing friction and building confidence so that making a referral feels straightforward

  • Keep partner firms up to date with product developments and platform enhancements

Conversation. It’s the thread between our product and our people. The tool that enables us to forge relationships through compassion and expertise. To find the connection between our differences. It keeps us close together across borders and backgrounds and helps us create our shared vision.

Rasa means tight-knit. We get to the point and have the courage to ask ‘why?’. Because through relentless experimentation, passion, and vision, we’re transforming the way people interact with organizations through AI.

That’s Rasa. That’s our message.

Join us and add yours.

SUMMARY

We’re looking for a Partner Manager to join our Go-to-Market team. The person’s charter will be to expand our alliances and partner program, demonstrating clear revenue influence (pipeline created through the channel) and strong influence in closed business (i.e. through directly selling through the channel or having a partner source/or strongly influence our closed deal.) You will be reporting to the Director of Partnerships.

Full-time - 100% remote - Location: UK, Germany

  • This is a remote position, but we cannot hire anybody outside of the UK, Germany for this position.

  • Rasa can assist with work authorization (visa sponsorship) for candidates located in Germany only.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

As a Partner Manager at Rasa, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating adoption of the developer platform for enterprise AI agents. You will be the strategic centre of our partner ecosystem, moving beyond traditional channel management to build high-trust, revenue-generating alliances with leading System Integrators, digital consulting firms and technology partners.

You will act as the "connective tissue" between our partners and Rasa's internal teams. This means collaborating closely with Sales to co-sell and close complex enterprise deals, working with Marketing to drive joint thought leadership, and liaising with Product to ensure partner feedback shapes our open framework. Success in this role means not just hitting revenue targets, but cultivating a thriving community of experts who trust Rasa as the standard for building enterprise AI agents.

  • Identify, recruit, and onboard strategic partners (SIs, Consultancies, Tech Alliances) that align with Rasa’s enterprise mission, specifically focusing on firms capable of deploying complex, high-value AI transformations.

  • Own a partner-sourced revenue target; drive net-new pipeline by executing joint business plans, co-selling with internal Account Executives, and facilitating partner-led implementations.

  • Ensure partners are technically and commercially proficient in Rasa’s latest innovations.

  • Design and execute GTM campaigns—including webinars, case studies, and events—that showcase joint value propositions and generate qualified leads.

  • Serve as the internal voice of the partner; collaborate with Product to relay market feedback and with Customer Success to ensure partner-led projects meet Rasa’s high standards for deployment quality.

  • Maintain rigorous data hygiene in our SFDC system, tracking partners, enablement, certifications, deal registration, and pipeline health to forecast business growth accurately.

ABOUT YOU

You are a strategic business builder who thrives at the intersection of technology and relationships. You understand that in the world of enterprise AI, success isn't just about selling a product—it's about building a trusted ecosystem that delivers value. You have a "hunter" mentality for finding new opportunities and a "farmer" mindset for nurturing them into long-term revenue streams.

You don't just "manage" partners; you empower them. You are as comfortable discussing GTM strategy with a Practice Lead at a Global SI as you are navigating a technical conversation about LLMs with a solution architect. You are resilient, data-driven, and excited by the rapid pace of the Generative AI landscape.

We are looking for a candidate who brings:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in Channel Sales, Partner Management, or Business Development within the B2B SaaS or Enterprise Software space. Experience specifically in the AI, Data, or Developer Tool landscape is a major plus.

  • You have a history of carrying and exceeding partner-sourced revenue quotas. You understand the mechanics of co-selling and know how to drive pipeline from "hello" to "closed-won."

  • You can articulate the value of Conversational AI and LLMs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • You are an exceptional communicator who can build credibility with C-level executives and influence stakeholders without direct authority. You write clear, compelling emails and deliver presentations that inspire action.

  • You can look at a partner’s business model and identify exactly where Rasa fits in. You are creative in structuring deals and initiatives that create "win-win-win" scenarios for Rasa, the Partner, and the End Customer.

  • You thrive in a high-growth, fast-changing startup environment. You are self-motivated, organized, and willing to roll up your sleeves to get the job done, whether that means fixing a contract or organizing a webinar.

Please keep in mind that we are describing the background that would best fit the role. Even if you don’t meet all the requirements, yet you are confident that you are up for the task, we absolutely want to get to know you!

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US

  • Flexible hours and a dedicated remote budget

  • A stipend for professional development & 6 paid education days to help you grow within your role

  • 26 days of PTO + paid sick leave + paid public holidays

  • A Macbook, and other tech to help you do your job

  • We have regular remote team events, as well as an annual company-wide offsite

  • Vitality Health (UK only)

  • Equity options

You can find more information about our benefits per location here: Rasa Perks & Benefits

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

You can find answers to FAQs from candidates about this role specifically on our Partner Manager - FAQ

ABOUT US

Rasa is the developer platform for enterprise AI agents. Rasa helps the world's most regulated companies, in financial services, healthcare, telco, and insurance, build, run, and improve AI agents that handle real customer and employee work at scale. Rasa is open-source at its core and built for deployment in the environments regulated enterprises actually require: on-premises, private cloud, and air-gapped. Rasa is privately held with funding from StepStone, PayPal, Accel, Andreessen Horowitz, Basis Set Ventures, and others. The company was founded in 2016 and is remote-first with a global presence.

En cas d'absence du maître d'hôtel prise de commande le chef de rang fait le service à table et débarrassé aidé par des commis.

• Relations avec la clientèle
• Mise en place
• Accueil et accompagnement du client
• Prise de commande et service
• Encadrer le travail des commis

• mettre en place les consoles de service,

• vérifier le bon déroulement du service,

• éditer l'addition,
• réaliser l'encaissement,
• débarrasser les tables.

• Adopter les gestes et postures permettant de travailler en toute sécurité

Savoir Etre

What we look for

• Advanced Excel; experience with SAP finance modules and Reporting tools.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; other languages an asset.

• Comfortable operating independently, handling ambiguous situations and escalating appropriately.
• Behavioral skills and competencies: growth mindset, change agent, process-oriented, detail focused, pressure management, team work, decision quality and uphold KPMG firm standars.
• Professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CPA, CFA or equivalent) and experience in professional services or the Big Four environment as an asset.

jobs.title: Directeur amélioration continue (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0

• Zone Industrielle P.E.D, BP 38, Rodange, Luxembourg, Luxembourg Employees work in a hybrid mode
• Full-time
• Compensation: EUR 116,340 - EUR 186,144 - yearly

Job Description

Are you ready to architect the future of Advanced Manufacturing?
At the Materials Group (MG), we are not just optimizing operations, we are redefining them. We are seeking a visionary and dynamic Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0  to lead our central Enterprise Lean System (ELS) function.
This is a high-impact, regional executive role designed for an operational architect who can bridge the gap between world-class, foundational Lean Six Sigma methodologies and cutting-edge Industry 4.0 technologies (AI, Predictive Analytics, and Cognitive Automation). Based in our Rodange facility, you will hold the keys to regional standardization, capability building, and digital supply chain transformation across Europe.

The Challenge & The Vision

As the Director of Central ELS, you will play two pivotal roles: the Guardian of Standards and the Pioneer of Innovation.
You will lead a high-performing central team to drive continuous improvement, establishing a high-margin production environment. Concurrently, you will orchestrate the transition from manual Lean frameworks to an AI-driven "Lighthouse Factory" footprint, leveraging predictive models, virtual environments, and connected systems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guardian of Operational & Supply Chain Standards

• Act as the regional "Center as Guardian," serving as the sole architect of operational standards in the Regional Playbook.
• Govern all core manufacturing work standards (5S, Standard Work Audits, Daily Tier Meetings, Kaizen, SMED, TPM, and OEE Tracking/Loss Analysis).
• Establish robust supply chain standards, covering Production Planning Logic, Inventory Buffer Protocols, Freight Spend Governance, and S&OP Integration.
• Govern and standardize Data Science & AI models across the region.

2. Capability Builder & Training Academy Leader

• Standardize regional workforce mindsets and skillsets through a centralized regional training engine.
• Maintain the end-to-end certification pathway for Yellow, Green, and Black Belt mastery, alongside modern Digital Literacy pathways.
• Design functionally deep training curricula and scale execution through "Train-the-Trainer" initiatives with local site leaders.

3. Orchestrator of Strategy Deployment

• Lead the Yearly Strategic Deployment process ensuring 100% functional alignment between Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and IT.
• Utilize the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and key performance metrics to establish regional breakthrough targets.
• Facilitate the collaborative "Catchball" process to negotiate and lock departmental action plans.
• Manage the monthly governance framework for PDCA reviews at executive and functional levels.

4. Pioneer of ELS 4.0 & Digital Twin Innovation

• Drive the shift to automated, AI-driven operations, implementing predictive models that empower local sites to preempt issues.
• Lead shopfloor IoT integration, ensuring machines feed real-time performance data directly into core IT systems.
• Deploy a Regional Control Tower live-dashboard to visualize the entire end-to-end supply chain.
• Deploy advanced solutions for AI-Driven Predictive Quality, Maintenance, Cognitive Automation, and dynamic 3D Digital Twin simulations.

5. Champion of the Hub & Spoke Model

• Serve as the central regional filter and amplifier for operational innovation.
• Capture best-in-class local site innovations directly from the Gemba, codifying validated successes into the "Gold Standard" regional playbook for network-wide deployment.

6. High-Performing Team Leader

• Cultivate an inspiring team culture rooted in high performance, psychological safety, and radical accountability.
• Mentor and coach a dedicated central team, providing clear career development pathways and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

Qualifications

Who You Are

• The Expert: You possess extensive experience leading Lean, Six Sigma, and Continuous Improvement functions on a regional or global scale.
• The Digital Native: You have a proven track record of implementing Industry 4.0 solutions (IoT, Predictive Maintenance, AI, or Digital Twins) within a manufacturing environment.
• The Architect: You excel at designing, documenting, and scaling operational systems and standards from scratch.
• The Communicator: You are an expert at navigating Hoshin Kanri / Strategic Deployment, bringing diverse stakeholders (from the shopfloor to the C-suite) along on the transformation journey.
• The People Developer: You love building capability, leading academies, and mentoring future operational leaders.

• Location: We welcome candidates residing near any of our major manufacturing hubs in Luxembourg, France, the UK, Germany, or Belgium.

Additional Information

Why join Avery Dennison:  We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. Founded on creating real-world impact to enable a better future, we strive to provide an open, collaborative culture where diversity of thought is encouraged and respected. Hear from our employees about what it's like working at Avery Dennison. Learn more at www.averydennison.com.At Avery Dennison, we work with the biggest brands in the FMCG, apparel, automotive, and pharma industries. Our Rodange Site Avery Dennison Luxembourg Sàrl location, founded in 1989, is a collaborative and dynamic environment that supports our Label and Packaging Materials Group division and employs approximately 540 talented individuals. Key functions at this site include Operations, Customer Service, central teams and various support functions, offering diverse career paths and opportunities for growth.

Equal Opportunity Employer:  Avery Dennison is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected status. If you are unable to use our online application process due to a disability, please contact us to request an accommodation at Requestaccomodation@eu.averydennison.com. In the EMEA region, we foster an inclusive culture through active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) like Elevate, Unite, and our Mental Health group. Please visit our DE&I page to learn more about our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach.

Pay Transparency Statement:  The salary range for this position is 116340 - 186144 EUR / year.

The hiring base salary range above represents what Avery Dennison reasonably expects to pay for this position as of the date of this posting. Actual salaries will vary within the range, and in some circumstances may be above or below the range, based on various factors including but not limited to a candidate's relevant skills, experience, education and training, and location, as well as the job scope and complexity, responsibilities, and regular and/or necessary travel required for the position, which may change depending on the candidate pool. Avery Dennison reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

jobs.title: GIO - Application Administrator / Support Engineer (m/f)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Application Administrator / Support Engineer to take ownership of our business systems and provide second-level support to users across the organization. You will configure and maintain business applications, resolve escalated support issues, manage user access, build reports and automations, and ensure our tools run smoothly as we grow.


This role offers growth opportunities with hands-on experience in system integrations, automation, and technical operations. You will start as a power user and develop into a technical administrator who builds workflows and connects systems.


Responsibilities
Second-Level Support :

    Handle escalated support tickets requiring deeper technical investigation.

    Diagnose and resolve complex application issues across business systems.

    Communicate solutions clearly to users in French, English, and German.

    Document recurring issues and create knowledge base articles.

    Identify patterns in support requests and address root causes.

User & Access Management :

    Manage user accounts, permissions, and roles across all business applications.

    Own onboarding and offboarding processes for system access.

    Implement and maintain security policies and access controls.

System Configuration :

    Configure applications to match business processes and workflows.

    Build and maintain custom fields, objects, and automation rules.

    Set up and maintain integrations between systems.

Data & Reporting :

    Create and maintain reports and dashboards that support decision-making.

    Ensure data quality and consistency across platforms.

    Handle data imports, exports, and migrations.

Teamwork :

    Gather requirements from stakeholders and translate them into system configurations.

    Train team members on system features and best practices.

    Write clear documentation for configurations and procedures.

    Proactively suggest improvements to tools and processes.



Profile

What Matters Most :

    Genuine curiosity: you enjoy figuring out how systems work.

    Problem-solving mindset: you dig until you find the root cause, not just the quick fix.

    Fast learner: comfortable picking up new tools and platforms independently.

    Clear communicator who can explain technical concepts to non-technical users.

Required Skills :

    Professional working proficiency in French, English, and German (or Luxembourgish).

    Ability to troubleshoot issues methodically and document solutions.

    Basic understanding of how applications store and organize data.

    Strong written communication skills for support responses and documentation.

Nice to Have :

    Experience administering Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar platforms.

    Basic scripting or automation knowledge/interest (JavaScript, Python, or no-code tools like Zapier/Make).

    Familiarity with APIs or system integrations.

    Background in IT support, helpdesk, or technical support.

Soft Skills

    Strong sense of ownership for system reliability and user satisfaction.

    Clear and helpful communication style.

    Self-management skills: ability to prioritize tickets and projects independently.

    Collaborative mindset and willingness to assist team members.

    Proactive approach to identifying and fixing recurring problems.

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) Manager Risk & Finance disposant d'une solide expertise en gestion des risques et en finance, ainsi que d'une forte appétence pour le développement commercial et le management d'équipes.

Vos missions principales :

En tant que Manager, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de nos activités et l'accompagnement de nos clients du secteur financier.
À ce titre, vous serez amené(e) à :

• Développer et consolider un portefeuille de clients au sein des secteurs bancaires, assurance et fonds d'investissement.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités commerciales et contribuer activement à la croissance du cabinet.
• Piloter des missions de conseil en gestion des risques financiers, prudentiels et opérationnels.
• Accompagner les clients dans leurs problématiques de finance, de réglementation et de transformation.
• Encadrer, animer et faire monter en compétences des équipes de consultants et d'analystes.
• Assurer le suivi des missions, la qualité des livrables et la satisfaction des clients.
• Participer aux réponses aux appels d'offres et à la construction des offres de services.
• Contribuer à la réflexion stratégique et au développement des activités de Finegan Luxembourg.
• Assurer une veille réglementaire et sectorielle afin d'accompagner les clients dans l'évolution de leurs dispositifs de gestion des risques et de conformité.

Profil recherché :

• Diplôme de niveau Master en Finance, Statistiques, Mathématiques appliquées, Économie ou domaine équivalent.
• Expérience confirmée en gestion des risques et finance acquise au sein d'un cabinet de conseil, d'une banque, d'une compagnie d'assurance ou d'un gestionnaire d'actifs.
• Expérience significative dans la conduite de projets et l'accompagnement de transformations réglementaires.
• Solide expérience en management d'équipe et en encadrement de consultants.
• Forte sensibilité commerciale et goût pour le développement de relations clients durables.
• Excellente compréhension des enjeux actuels du secteur financier luxembourgeois et européen.

Compétences techniques

Gestion des risques

• Modélisation et validation des paramètres réglementaires (PD, LGD, EAD).
• Maîtrise des dispositifs de gestion des risques de crédit, de marché et opérationne
• Connaissance approfondie des méthodologies quantitatives appliquées au risque.
• Maîtrise des processus ICAAP, stress testing et dispositifs prudentiels.

Réglementation bancaire et prudentielle

• Bâle III / Bâle IV.
• CRD / CRR.
• Dispositifs de conformité et de gouvernance des risques.
• Réglementations applicables aux établissements bancaires, compagnies d'assurance et fonds d'investissement.

Finance

• Finance d'entreprise.
• Analyse financière.
• Valorisation et évaluation d'actifs.
• Normes IFRS appliquées aux instruments financiers.

Data & Outils Quantitatifs

• SAS.
• R.
• Python.
• MATLAB.
• Outils de modélisation et d'analyse statistique.

Compétences comportementales

• Leadership et capacité à fédérer les équipes.
• Excellent sens de la communication et de la relation client.
• Forte capacité d'analyse et de synthèse.
• Esprit entrepreneurial et orientation résultats.
• Autonomie et proactivité.
• Rigueur et sens de l'organisation.
• Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements exigeants et en constante évolution.
• Aptitude à gérer simultanément plusieurs projets stratégiques.

Compétences linguistiques

• Français, lu, écrit et parlé.
• Anglais, lu, écrit et parlé.

Pourquoi rejoindre Finegan Luxembourg ?

• Intervenir sur des projets stratégiques à forte valeur ajoutée.
• Évoluer dans un environnement stimulant au contact d'experts reconnus.
• Rejoindre un cabinet à taille humaine privilégiant proximité, excellence et développement professionnel.
• Participer activement aux transformations des principaux acteurs de la place financière luxembourgeoise.

jobs.title: Research Scientist in Mathematical and Physics based modeling of Generative AI (m/f)
jobs.description:
Research Scientist in Mathematical and Physics based modeling of Generative AI

(Valid from 08/09/2026 to 23/02/2027)

Language: English (UK)
Location: Luxembourg
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: SEDAN
Job Number: UOL08342
Contract Type: Permanent
Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week
Expected Start Date: 01/08/2026

Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Open Position
Job Level: level 1
  
About the SnT

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.

The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.

The successful candidate will become a member of the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust within the Interdisciplinary Research in SEDAN Team under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Radu State at the University of Luxembourg.

Your role:

• Support further developing and expanding the SEDAN team, its research, and role in shaping interdisciplinary research, in modeling of Generative AI
• Shape and supervise research direction at the intersection of AI and Mathematics, including Physics based paradigms
• Lead and contribute to the development and management of national and international projects in SEDAN, including proposal preparation, reporting, and coordination with external partners
• Foster collaborations across disciplines - in particular between Fintech and AI with private and public stakeholders in Luxembourg and abroad
• Contribute to teaching activities at the Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD levels in topics such as AI and machine learning
• Provide daily and content supervision of PhD candidates and support doctoral and postdoctoral training; e.g., research seminars, reading groups, workshops, and conferences
• Represent SnT and SEDAN in academic and public venues, strengthening the visibility of AI research in Luxembourg and abroad

Your profile:

• PhD in Physics, Mathematics or Computer Science
• At least five years of postdoctoral or equivalent experience in applied and fundamental research and technology transfer to the industry
• Research related to theoretical foundations of Generative AI
• Recent research experience with LLM, RAG systems, and/or agentic systems
• Proven experience with Ethical AI and EU AI act
• A strong recent publication record in top-tier AI conferences
• Proven experience in funding acquisition, project management, and coordination of national projects as well as industry collaboration
• Proven experience in teaching and supervising MSc, PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and management of small groups

Language requirements: The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable
• Research statement and research plan for the next five years, including proposed research projects in the framework of the theme and mission of the profile

All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.

General information:

• Contract Type: Permanent
• Work Hours: Full Time 40.0 Hours per Week
• Location: Kirchberg Campus
• Internal Title: Research scientist
• Job Reference: UOL08342

Gender equality:

The University of Luxembourg embraces inclusion, diversity and gender equality as essential for academic excellence. We are fully committed to removing discriminatory barriers in recruitment and career progression and to advance gender balance among academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

Manager de proximité et expert(e) de la Business Analysis, vous savez fédérer une équipe, faire progresser les pratiques et instaurer une dynamique d'amélioration continue. Vous êtes capable de remettre en question les approches existantes de manière constructive, de créer des synergies entre les équipes et de positionner la Business Analysis comme un véritable levier de performance et de qualité pour l'entreprise.

Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

Alexandra Pöppl

jobs.title: Projektassistenz Photovoltaik / Kaufmännische Projektassistenz (m/w/d) (Projektassistent/in)
jobs.description:

in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit.

Unterstützung bei der Planung und Projektierung von Photovoltaikanlagen

Beratung und Verkauf

- Unterstützung unserer Kunden bei Fragen zu Produkten und Einsatzmöglichkeiten


Ihr Profil

- Abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder technische Berufsausbildung von Vorteil, z. B. als Kaufmann/-frau für Büromanagement, Industriekaufmann/-frau, Kaufmann/-frau im Einzelhandel oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

- Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben zwischen Projektierung, Organisation, Kundenbetreuung und Vertrieb

jobs.title: Heilerziehungspfleger, Erzieher (m/w/d/kA) für die Kinderarche St. Christophorus (Erzieher/in)
jobs.description:
Unser Unternehmen

Die Arche gGmbH ist ein überregionaler und gleichzeitig dezentral organisierter Arbeitgeber mit über 750 Mitarbeitenden und ist Mitglied der Diakonie Bayern und Sachsen. Die Arche gGmbH bietet eine Vielzahl von Leistungen in den Bereichen Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, Behindertenhilfe, Berufshilfe und Seniorenhilfe in Bayern und Sachsen an.

Ihr Arbeitsplatz

Für unsere heilpädagogisch therapeutische Einrichtung zur Intensivpflege für Kinder – und Jugendliche, suchen wir ab sofort Unterstützung im Bereich der Pädagogik.

Die Kinder leben in familiären Gruppen, sie werden von medizinischem und pädagogischem Fachpersonal 24 h betreut.

Im Dezember zieht die Einrichtung von Hirschaid nach Forchheim um.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Durchführung von pädagogischen und heilpädagogischen Förderangeboten (Einzelförderung/Gruppenangebote)
- Beobachtung und Dokumentation
- Erstellung von Förderplänen
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Pflegepersonal, Therapeuten, Ärzten sowie Medizintechnikern
- Feste im Jahreskreis planen und durchführen.

Das bringen Sie mit

- Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zum Heilerziehungspfleger oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Empathie und Freude an der Arbeit mit schwerkranken Kindern und Jugendlichen
- Teamfähigkeit und Bereitschaft zu Wochenenddiensten
- Motivation zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
- Kreativität

Das bieten wir Ihnen

- Ein stabiles, kompetentes u. familiäres Team
- Geregelte Arbeitszeiten (kein Schichtdienst)
- Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem erfahrenen Team
- Möglichkeit ein Job Rad zu leasen
- Jahresurlaub von 30 Tagen, zusätzliche Feiertage: Buß- und Bettag sowie 24. oder 31. Dezember
- Jährliches Familienbudget
- zusätzliche Altersvorsorge

Das ist noch nicht alles – eine vollständige Liste aller Leistungen finden Sie auf der Seite Wir als Arbeitgeber (https://www.archeggmbh.de/mitarbeiten-in-der-arche/wir-als-arbeitgeber) .

Gehalt

Die Vergütung erfolgt nach AVR Bayern (https://www.diakonie-bayern.de/mitarbeiten/arbeitsvertragsrichtlinien-diakonie-bayern) .

Diese Dokumente benötigen Sie

- erweitertes Führungszeugnis

jobs.title: Erzieher/in (Erzieher/in)
jobs.description:
Du machst jeden Tag einen Unterschied – im Leben von Kindern, Jugendlichen oder Menschen, die Unterstützung brauchen.

Genau das ist es, wofür du brennst. Und genau dafür suchen wir dich!

Als inhabergeführter Personaldienstleister mit langjähriger Erfahrung kennen wir den sozialen Sektor in- und auswendig.

Wir wissen, worauf es dir wirklich ankommt: ein Job, der zu dir passt, ein Arbeitgeber, der zuhört, und eine Begleitung, die nicht mit der Vertragsunterschrift endet.

Wir begleiten dich persönlich, ehrlich und auf Augenhöhe.

Erzieher (m/w/d) – Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und keine Probezeit

Das bieten wir dir:

- Attraktive, übertarifliche Vergütung, weil gute pädagogische Arbeit fair entlohnt werden sollte
- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und keine Probezeit von Anfang an, damit du wirklich ankommen kannst
- Fahrtkostenzuschuss oder vollständige Fahrkostenübernahme, damit der Weg zur Arbeit kein Thema ist
- Einsätze, die zu dir passen: Wir stimmen deinen Einsatzort auf deine Stärken, deine Wünsche und deine Lebenssituation ab
- Verschiedene Einrichtungen kennenlernen und dabei immer einen festen Arbeitgeber im Rücken haben
- Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, damit du fachlich wächst und nicht auf der Stelle trittst
- Betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung, zum Beispiel über Urban Sports Club, weil auch du mal abschalten musst
- Eine Empfehlungsprämie, wenn du jemanden kennst, der auch einen guten Job verdient
- Kurze Wege, offene Ohren und echte Beratung: Bei uns kennst du deine Ansprechperson und sie kennt dich

Was dich im Alltag erwartet:

- Du begleitest und förderst Kinder, Jugendliche oder Menschen mit Unterstützungsbedarf mit echtem Engagement und dem Blick fürs Individuelle, nicht nach Schema F, sondern so, wie jeder Mensch es verdient
- Pädagogische Angebote entwickelst du eigenständig, setzt sie um und reflektierst sie im Nachgang, von der ersten Idee bis zur Auswertung liegt alles in deinen Händen

jobs.title: Salesforce (CRM) Manager*in (d/w/m) (CRM-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Informationen

Jedes Kind hat das Recht auf eine Zukunft. In Deutschland und weltweit arbeiten wir als größte unabhängige Kinderrechtsorganisation mit aller Kraft dafür, dass Kinder gesund aufwachsen, lernen können und geschützt werden, auch in Krisenzeiten. In unseren Projekten beteiligen wir sie und setzen uns gemeinsam mit ihnen für ihre Zukunft ein.

Um unsere Arbeit gerechter und machtsensibler zu gestalten, möchten wir Raum für Perspektiven marginalisierter Personen schaffen. Wir sind auf dem Weg, uns verstärkt mit den Themen Diversität, Gerechtigkeit, Inklusion und Anti-Rassismus sowie den Diskriminierungspotenzialen in unseren eigenen Strukturen und Prozessen auseinanderzusetzen.

In unserem Team Data Strategy & Insights möchten wir die Position *Salesforce (CRM) Managerin (d/w/m)**in Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche) zum 01.11.2026 und zunächst befristet bis zum 30.11.2027 besetzen.

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Betreuung, Administration und Weiterentwicklung von Salesforce Nonprofit Success Pack und Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement
- Anforderungsanalyse, Stakeholderberatung und Entwicklung technischer Lösungskonzepte – ggf. mit Integrationspartner
- Konzeption und Umsetzung von Automatisierungen mit Salesforce Flow; bei Bedarf individuelle Lösungen mit Apex
- Entwicklung und Optimierung von Schnittstellen zwischen Salesforce, Marketing Cloud Engagement, Payment-Lösungen und Drittsystemen
- Sicherstellung nachhaltiger Systemarchitektur, nachvollziehbarer Datenmodelle sowie belastbarer Rollen-, Berechtigungs- und Sicherheitskonzepte
- Deployments, technische Tests, Fehleranalyse, Qualitätssicherung und Dokumentation; Fokus auf wartbaren, performanten und wiederverwendbaren Code
- Strukturierte Massendatenimporte und -exporte, Datenbereinigung, Datenmigration und Sicherung der Datenqualität
- Unterstützung von Fundraising und Management bei komplexen Auswertungen und verlässlichen Entscheidungsgrundlagen
- Lösungen für Spendenverarbeitung, Payment-Prozesse, Kampagnenmanagement und Spender*innenkommunikation
- Beobachtung relevanter Salesforce-Releases und Plattformentwicklungen; Bewertung und Ableitung von Empfehlungen
- Technische Beratung, Wissenstransfer und verständliche Dokumentation für Kolleg*innen
- Arbeit mit Copado für Release-Prozesse sowie Jira und Confluence für Anforderungsmanagement und Dokumentation; Kenntnisse wünschenswert

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen:

- abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium im Bereich Informatik, Witschaftsinformatikoder vergleichbare Qualifikationen/Erfahrungen
- mehrjährige undfundierte Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Salesforce-Lösungen, idealerweise im komplexen Organisations- oder Non-Profit-Umfeld
- Sichere Kenntnisse in Salesforce-Konfiguration, Datenmodellierung, Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepten sowie Salesforce Flow
- SQL-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit Metadata Deployment, z. B. Lightning Web Components; Apex-Kenntnisse wünschenswert
- Erfahrung mit API-Schnittstellen und Anbindung von Drittsystemen; Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement oder vergleichbare Marketing-Automation-Tools von Vorteil
- Sicherer Umgang mit großen Datenmengen, Datenimporten, -exporten, Migrationen, Dublettenbereinigung und Datenqualität
- Erfahrung mit FinDock oder vergleichbaren Payment-Lösungen, Guided Matching und Spendenverarbeitung von Vorteil
- Vertrautheit mit strukturierten Entwicklungs- und Release-Prozessen; Copado, Jira und Confluence als Plus
- Analyse komplexer Anforderungen, verständliche Vermittlung technischer Optionen und gemeinsame Priorisierung mit Fachbereichen
- Selbstständige, lösungsorientierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise; Überblick bei parallelen Anforderungen
- Klare Kommunikation mit technischen und nicht technischen Stakeholdern; konstruktive Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams und externen Partnern
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Identifikation mit den Werten Respekt, Verantwortung und Integrität; Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Salesforce-Zertifizierungen, z. B. Platform Developer I/II, Administrator oder Marketing Cloud Engagement Developer, von Vorteil

Unser Angebot

- flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung und bis zu 60% mobiles Arbeiten
- Bezahlung nach organisationsinternem Gehaltsmodell; das Startgehalt für diese Position liegt zwischen 4.600€ und 5.000€ (brutto Vollzeit bei 40h / Woche), je nach relevanter Berufserfahrung und Expertise
- professionelle Unterstützung und Maßnahmen zur Weiterentwicklung
- ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld und eine wertebasierte Organisationskultur
- viel Raum für Selbstständigkeit und Eigeninitiative
- 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr plus 1 Tag Sonderurlaub
- Auswahl eines zusätzlichen Benefits:
Edenred-Guthabenkarte, zusätzliche betriebliche Krankenversicherung, Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft bzw. 80% Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket Job
- auf Wunsch 20 % Beteiligung an der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
- volle Entgeltfortzahlung bei Erkrankung des Kindes
- betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement
- Familienraum sowie Ruhe- und Gebetsraum in unserem Büro
- Arbeitslaptop

Grundsätze unserer Arbeit

Wir unternehmen alles, um Kinder im Rahmen unserer Arbeit vor Gefahren zu schützen. Deshalb setzen wir die Bereitschaft voraus, nach den** **Child Safeguarding Standards von Save the Children zu handeln und benötigen bei einer Einstellung die Vorlage eines erweiterten Führungszeugnisses.

Wir arbeiten daran, nicht auf die gesamtgesellschaftlich bestehende strukturelle Diskriminierung einzuzahlen. Uns ist wichtig, Begegnungen zwischen Menschen zu fördern und sie sicher für alle zu gestalten. Wir ermutigen Menschen, die marginalisierten Gruppen zugehörig sind oder Diskriminierung erfahren haben, sich bei uns zu bewerben. Mehr Informationen finden Sie hier: Unsere Haltung

Um zu mehr Transparenz unserer Interessen gegenüber der Politik beizutragen, verpflichten wir uns und unsere Interessenvertreter*innen zur Eintragung in das beim Deutschen Bundestag geführte Lobbyregister.

jobs.title: Störungstechniker / Technischer Support (m/w/d) (Servicetechniker/in - IT)
jobs.description:
Alarmanlagen, Videoanlagen & IT – Leitstelle Potsdam

Eine Alarmanlage meldet eine technische Störung, eine Kamera liefert kein Bild oder ein Arbeitsplatzrechner funktioniert nicht richtig: Du gehst der Ursache auf den Grund und unterstützt bei der Lösung.

In unserer Leitstelle übernimmst du den technischen Erstsupport für Alarm- und Videoanlagen. Gleichzeitig unterstützt du unsere Mitarbeitenden bei alltäglichen IT-Problemen und richtest gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Administrator Rechner und Arbeitsplätze ein.

Du bearbeitest Standardfälle eigenständig innerhalb abgestimmter Abläufe. Bei komplexeren Problemen arbeitest du eng mit dem IT-Administrator und den zuständigen Technikern zusammen.

Aufgaben

• Technische Störungen aufnehmen und eingrenzen: Du klärst, was ausgefallen ist, welche Auswirkungen bestehen und welche Schritte bereits durchgeführt wurden.

• Erstsupport für Alarmanlagen: Du prüfst technische Störungsmeldungen, Erreichbarkeit und Verbindungen und unterstützt bei der Fehlerbehebung.

• Erstsupport für Videoanlagen: Du hilfst bei Problemen mit Kamerabildern, Übertragung, Zugriff und Verbindung.

• Unterstützung per Telefon und Fernzugriff: Du führst Kunden und Kollegen verständlich durch die erforderlichen Prüfschritte.

• Rechner und Arbeitsplätze einrichten: Gemeinsam mit dem IT-Administrator bereitest du Geräte, Software und Zubehör für den Einsatz vor.

• Alltägliche IT-Probleme lösen: Du kümmerst dich beispielsweise um Software-, Zugriffs-, Verbindungs- und Geräteprobleme.

• Komplexe Fälle sauber übergeben: Du dokumentierst Fehlerbild und bisherige Maßnahmen, damit der IT-Administrator oder ein zuständiger Techniker gezielt weiterarbeiten kann.

• Wiederkehrende Fehler nachvollziehbar machen: Du hältst Lösungen fest und hilfst dabei, Arbeitsabläufe und technische Anleitungen zu verbessern.

Qualifikation

• Technisches Verständnis und Freude daran, Fehler systematisch zu finden und zu beheben.

• Einen sicheren Umgang mit Computern, Software und technischen Geräten.

• Grundlagen zu Netzwerken und Verbindungen sowie Interesse an Alarm- und Videotechnik.

• Eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du prüfst Ursachen, statt wahllos Einstellungen zu verändern.

• Geduld und die Fähigkeit, technische Zusammenhänge verständlich auf Deutsch zu erklären.

• Zuverlässigkeit und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Kundendaten, Zugängen und sicherheitsrelevanten Systemen.

• Bereitschaft zur engen Zusammenarbeit mit Leitstelle, Technik und IT-Administrator.

• Ein einwandfreies Führungszeugnis.

Erfahrung im technischen Support, mit Sicherheitstechnik oder in der Arbeitsplatz-IT passt besonders gut zu dieser Aufgabe.

Benefits

Vollzeit · 32.000–36.000 € brutto pro Jahr.

Eine praktische technische Aufgabe direkt in unserer Leitstelle: Du unterstützt sowohl bei Störungen an Sicherheitstechnik als auch im täglichen IT-Betrieb. Dabei arbeitest du mit unserem IT-Administrator zusammen und bringst dich aktiv in die Fehlerbehebung ein.

Bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf und beschreibe kurz, welche Erfahrungen du mit Alarmanlagen, Videoanlagen oder IT-Support mitbringst.

Stadtritter GmbH · Großbeerenstraße 139a · 14482 Potsdam

jobs.title: Mitarbeitende im Vertriebsaußendienst (m/w/d) (Vertriebsberater/in)
jobs.description:
​​​VERKAUFEN LIEGT IHNEN IM BLUT? DANN IST ILLE IHRE CHANCE! Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten, die sich gewaschen haben.

Mitarbeitende im Vertriebsaußendienst (m/w/d) in Kiel

Familienunternehmen mit Herz und Verstand. Unser Erfolgsrezept seit über 60 Jahren: marktbestimmende Spitzenprodukte, ein dichtes internationales Vertriebs- und Logistiknetz sowie ein ausgezeichneter Service.

Verantwortung ist uns wichtig. Im Mittelpunkt steht der Mensch, ob als Mitarbeiter oder Geschäftspartner. Wir verstehen uns als starkes Team, das sich durch offene Kommunikation und flache Hierarchien stetig weiterentwickelt.

Nachhaltigkeit in Verbindung mit zukunftsorientierten Technologien und Prozessen sind seit Firmengründung im Jahr 1965 die Grundprinzipien unseres Handelns. Diesem Anspruch will Ille jeden Tag gerecht werden. Heute und auch in Zukunft.

Neue Aufgaben - Neue Chancen

Unsere Vertriebsmitarbeitenden im Außendienst (m/w/d) sind die Speerspitze unseres Unternehmens. Ihre Aufgabe besteht darin, neue Kunden zu identifizieren und für Ille zu gewinnen. Sie überzeugen Interessenten von unserem Servicekonzept und schließen Verträge ab. So tragen Sie zu der Erfolgsgeschichte unseres Unternehmens bei.

Ihr Profil

- Verkaufstalent und eine versierte Gesprächsführung zählen zu Ihren Stärken.
- Eigenständiges Arbeiten macht Ihnen Spaß und Sie können sich selbst motivieren.
- Der Kunde steht für Sie an erster Stelle und Sie verstehen es, Ihr Gegenüber mit Ihrer Begeisterung anzustecken.
- Sie sind Teamplayer und ein zuverlässiger Ansprechpartner für Kunden und Kollegen.

Noch unsicher? Alle Verkaufstalente sind bei uns herzlich willkommen. Eine vorherige Vertriebstätigkeit im Hygienebereich ist hilfreich, aber nicht erforderlich. Alles was Sie können müssen, lernen Sie bei uns.

Konnten wir Sie von Ille begeistern? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Das ist uns sehr wichtig

Neben den qualitativ hochwertigen Produkten legt das Unternehmen besonders viel Wert auf engagierte und verantwortungsbewusste Mitarbeitende, die zuverlässig im Team arbeiten. Wir haben einen sehr hohen Anspruch an unseren Kundenservice. Offenheit, Freundlichkeit und Geduld sollten daher zu Ihren Grundeigenschaften gehören.

Wir bieten Ihnen

- Eine intensive Förderung in Form von Coachings durch die Geschäftsführung und Vertriebsleiter bringt Sie schnell nach vorne.
- Unsere unternehmensinterne Vertriebs-App, mobile Endgeräte sowie modernes Marketingmaterial erleichtern Ihren Arbeitstag.
- Durch den Ihnen gewährten Kunden- und Objektschutz können Sie Ihr Netzwerk permanent erweitern.
- Profitieren Sie von überdurchschnittlichen Verdienstmöglichkeiten durch eine größtenteils provisionsabhängige Vergütung.
- Ergänzend dazu bieten wir Ihnen ein optimales Angebot an Sozialleistungen, wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge und private Krankenversicherung, sorgen für ein Rundum-Sorglos Paket.

So geht es weiter

Bewerben Sie sich direkt online, indem Sie unten auf den Button klicken. Nach Eingang Ihrer vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen, werden diese intern geprüft. Soweit unsererseits alles passt vereinbaren wir mit Ihnen einen Telefontermin für ein kurzes Interview. Anschließend lernen wir uns persönlich kennen und besprechen alle Einzelheiten.

Falls Sie sich in einem ungekündigten Arbeitsverhältnis befinden, sichern wir Ihnen natürlich höchste Vertraulichkeit zu.

So sieht Ihr Start bei Ille aus

In den ersten Wochen werden Sie von Ihrem Vertriebsleiter umfassend eingearbeitet und lernen alle relevanten Arbeitsinhalte kennen. Auch nach Ihrer Einarbeitung können Sie bei komplexen Themen jederzeit auf die Unterstützung Ihrer Kollegen zählen.

Ergänzt wird diese Phase durch eine spannende Einführungswoche in unserer Zentrale in Altenstadt. Sie lernen Ille als Unternehmen kennen und erfahren alles zu unseren Produkten und Arbeitsprozessen. Auch vertriebsspezifisch geht es ins Detail, damit Sie alles an Wissen und Informationen für einen gelungenen Start bei uns mitnehmen können.
