As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career.  From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect and ManageEngine), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.
- Ways of Working: - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
- Languages: •    Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.
As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/inklusion.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About Us
To solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is the place where you can thrive, challenge the status quo, make an impact, and grow alongside a team of innovators who share your passion for technology. Are you in?

jobs.title: Kokki (Asialainen Ravintola)
jobs.description:
**Työtehtävä**

Etsimme motivoitunutta ja ammattitaitoista **kokkia** aasialaiseen ravintolaamme. Ravintolamme tarjoaa thaimaalaisia, kiinalaisia ja intialaisia ruokia. Etsimme kokkia, jolla on kokemusta aasialaisesta keittiöstä ja joka pystyy työskentelemään tehokkaasti kiireisessä ravintolaympäristössä.

**Työtehtävät**

- Thaimaalaisten, kiinalaisten ja intialaisten ruokien valmistaminen ravintolan reseptien ja laatuvaatimusten mukaisesti.

- Raaka-aineiden, kuten vihannesten, lihan, kalan, äyriäisten, kastikkeiden, mausteiden ja marinadien valmistelu.

- Wokin, friteerauskeittimen, grillin ja muiden keittiölaitteiden käyttö.

- Ruokien nopea ja tehokas valmistaminen lounas- ja päivällisaikojen kiireisissä tilanteissa.

- Ruokien tasaisen laadun, maun, ulkonäön ja annoskokojen varmistaminen.

- Elintarvikehygieniasta ja turvallisesta ruoan käsittelystä huolehtiminen.

- Raaka-aineiden asianmukainen säilytys, käsittely ja päiväyskierto.

- Keittiön, työpisteiden ja keittiölaitteiden puhtaana ja järjestyksessä pitäminen.

- Raaka-aineiden menekin ja varastotilanteen seuraaminen sekä puutteista ilmoittaminen esimiehelle.

- Ruokahävikin vähentäminen ja raaka-aineiden tehokas hyödyntäminen.

- Yhteistyö muun keittiöhenkilökunnan ja ravintolan työntekijöiden kanssa.

- Ravintolan ja keittiön toimintatapojen sekä esimiehen ohjeiden noudattaminen.


**Odotamme hakijalta**

- Aikaisempaa työkokemusta kokin tehtävistä, mielellään aasialaisessa ravintolassa tai vastaavassa ammattikeittiössä.

- Hyvää osaamista aasialaisesta ruoasta, erityisesti thaimaalaisesta, kiinalaisesta ja/tai intialaisesta keittiöstä.

- Kykyä työskennellä nopeasti ja tehokkaasti kiireisessä työympäristössä.

- Elintarvikehygienian ja turvallisen ruoanvalmistuksen perustuntemusta.

- Kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana työryhmää.

- Hyviä organisointi- ja yhteistyötaitoja.

- Huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta.

- Valmiutta työskennellä iltaisin, viikonloppuisin ja tarvittaessa juhlapyhinä.

- On kyettävä työskentelemään aamuvuoroissa (alkaen klo 08.00) sekä ilta-/sulkemisvuoroissa (päättyen klo 22.00).


**Katsomme eduksi**

- Kokemuksen useamman aasialaisen keittiön valmistamisesta.

- Wok-ruokien valmistamisen kokemuksen.

- Kokemuksen kiireisestä ja paljon annoksia valmistavasta ravintolakeittiöstä.

- Suomen tai englannin kielen perustaidon.

- Aikaisemman kokemuksen kaupallisesta ammattikeittiöstä.


**Tarjoamme**

- Vakaan työpaikan kasvavassa aasialaisessa ravintolassa.

- Monikulttuurisen ja mukavan työympäristön.

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa ammattitaitoa ja ruoanvalmistustaitoja.

- Kokemukseen perustuvan kilpailukykyisen palkan sovellettavan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.

- Mahdollisuuden kokoaikaiseen tai osa-aikaiseen työhön ravintolan tarpeiden mukaan.


**Työympäristö**

Työ tapahtuu ammattikeittiössä, jossa työskentelyyn kuuluu pitkäaikaista seisomista, raaka-aineiden ja keittiötarvikkeiden nostamista sekä työskentelyä kiireisessä ja ajoittain kuumassa ympäristössä.

Etsimme henkilöä, joka on **luotettava, ahkera, huolellinen ja motivoitunut kokki** sekä halukas työskentelemään osana ravintolamme keittiötiimiä.

Administration und Finance Manager (m/w/d) Baugewerbe in Gramastetten

Administration und Finance Manager (m/w/d)

- Verantwortung für die gesamte Projektadministration und den operativen Bürobetrieb.
- Steuerung und Koordination externer Dienstleister, wie Steuerberater, Versicherungvertretern sowie administrativer Leistungen von Nachunternehmern.

- Unterstützung bei Audits sowie der Dokumentation relevanter Projektprozesse.
- Sicherstellung einer effizienten Informations- und Dokumentenverwaltung innerhalb der Projektorganisation.

Dein Profil

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung/Studium
- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Teamleiter im Bereich allgemeine Verwaltung / (Vorbereitende) Buchhaltung, gerne in Start-up-Umfeld bzw. in großen Bau-/Infrastruktur- oder EPC-Projekten
- Fundierte Kenntnisse österreichischer Verwaltungs-, Steuer- und Compliance-Anforderungen, mit Versicherungen sowie Vermietern
- Ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten sowie strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise.
- Hohe Zahlenaffinität und Erfahrung im Reporting, Excel ist ein Muss
- Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Koordinationsfähigkeiten.
- Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch und Englisch sind ein Muss, Spanisch oder Italienisch ist ein Plus

Du kommst nicht aus der Region? Kein Problem: Wir stellen Dir eine möblierte Wohnung in Arbeitsplatznähe zur Verfügung. 2 Heimreisen im Monat bekommst Du bezahlt, vor Ort steht Dir ein Auto zur Verfügung. Durch unseren Arbeitsrhythmus in Rotation hast Du alle 2 Wochen 4 Tage frei.

- Eine Schlüsselposition in einem international erfolgreichen EPC-Unternehmen
- Mitarbeit an strategisch bedeutenden Energieinfrastrukturprojekten
- Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
- Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum

Klingt das gut?

Dann bewirb Dich jetzt als Finance und Administration Manager bei SICIM.

jobs.title: Bestyrelsespost som næstformand
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at sætte retningen for et sted, der gør en reel forskel for børn- og unge?

NIMA – Børn & Ungehjem søger en næstformand til bestyrelsen.

 

Om NIMA

NIMA – Børn & Ungehjem er et godkendt børn- og ungehjem beliggende i Bramming (Nørlundvej 9, 6740 Bramming), godkendt efter Barnets Lov § 43, stk. 1, nr. 6. Vi er et mindre, specialiseret anbringelsessted for unge i alderen 13–18 (23) år, som har brug for ro, struktur og nærværende omsorg.

Vi er stiftet af to ledere med personlig erfaring som anbragte – og med mange års faglig erfaring fra døgninstitutionsområdet. Det giver os en unik forståelse for de unges situation, som vores pædagogiske tilgang i huset, bæger præg af.

Vores pædagogiske fundament bygger bl.a. på STORM-modellen, mentalisering, traumeorienteret tilgang og low arousal. Vi drives med høj normering, tydelig ledelse nærværende omsorg for de unges trivsel.

 

Bestyrelsens opgaver og forventede tidsforbrug

Bestyrelsen mødes 4 gange om året og har ansvar for at understøtte ledelsen strategisk og sikre forsvarlig drift. Der kan forekomme ekstraordinære møder ved behov.

Som næstformand vil du bl.a.:

·       Bidrage til bestyrelsens arbejde med strategi og organisatorisk udvikling

·       Understøtte ledelsen i at drive NIMA forsvarligt og fagligt stærkt.

·       Sikre at NIMA lever op til kravene fra Socialtilsyn Syd og Barnets Lov, o.m.

·       Bidrage med din faglige ekspertise – juridisk, strategisk eller socialpædagogisk.

 

Vi søger til næstformanden:

·       Faglig profil inden for jura.

·       Evne til at støtte formanden og træde til ved behov.

·       Interesse for drift og udvikling af specialiseret anbringelsessted.

 

Vi tilbyder

·       Lønnet bestyrelsespost.

·       En meningsfuld rolle i en organisation, der gør en konkret forskel.

·       Tæt samarbejde med en dedikeret og faglig ledelse.

·       Mulighed for at præge udviklingen af et ungt og ambitiøst sted.

 

Praktisk information.

Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt.

Ansøgningsfrist: Løbende – vi holder samtaler, efterhånden som vi modtager ansøgninger.

Sted: Nørlundvej 9, 6740 Bramming.

 

Ansøgning.

Send en kort motiveret ansøgning og dit CV til: info@opholdsstedetnima.dk

Spørgsmål til stillingen er velkomne – skriv til ovenstående adresse eller ring til ledelsen på:

Hanne på 61465619
Mike på 61504638

Læs mere om NIMA på: www.opholdsstedetnima.dk

Vi ser frem til at hører fra dig :)

jobs.title: Contract Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
1 Contract Manager (m/f/d) Job ID 520262

Siemens Mobility location in 1110 Vienna.
You will analyse, draft and evaluate customer and supplier contracts, identify relevant opportunities and risks during project management and advise the project teams competently on contract-related issues.

* In addition, you will support the creation, negotiation and enforcement of amendments vis-à-vis customers and suppliers, ensuring the documentation and prosecution of claims as part of claim management.
* You will analyze project deviations in terms of costs, deadlines and scope of services, carry out delay analyses and evaluate the causes and effects of schedule deviations.
* In doing so, you will identify, document and assert downtime, obstructions and productivity losses and support the project teams in preparing evidence to enforce additional costs and compensation claims.
* You will work closely with the areas of project management, commercial management, engineering, procurement and legal counsel and accompany negotiations as well as the out-of-court or judicial enforcement of claims.


Your qualifications - solid and relevant

* You have successfully completed a university degree in law or an economic/technical university degree with basic legal training.
* You have a special interest and in-depth knowledge of contract law and ideally have already gained 3-5 years of professional experience in contract management, claim management or project management in the context of complex infrastructure or rolling stock projects.
* You have a pronounced willingness to familiarize yourself with the technical details of infrastructure projects in order to form an effective interface between law and technology.
* You are very interested in using AI to increase the quality and efficiency of your work.
* Personally, you are characterized by a structured, analytical way of working, initiative, strong communication skills and enjoyment of interdisciplinary cooperation.
* You are willing to travel nationally and internationally.
* Since you work in an international project environment, you are fluent in both written and spoken German and English. Ideally, you also have excellent knowledge of Romanian or another Eastern European language.

What do we offer you?

* Internationality - We offer an attractive working environment in an innovative, globally active group with diverse and responsible tasks in an international environment
* Purpose - We are pioneers of mobility. With us, you are actively contributing to the transport turnaround and climate protection in a market of the future, because our transport solutions reduce CO2 emissions all over the world.
* Reconciling family and career - With flexible working hours and the possibility of working from home, we help you to concentrate fully on your career without losing sight of the demands of your family life.
* Attractive conditions - You will receive an attractive remuneration package within the framework of the Collective Agreement for the Electrical and Electronics Industry of Austria and other extras such as employee share programmes and company pension schemes.
* Further development - We offer you comprehensive training opportunities for your professional and personal development, both online and offline.
* Team - Become part of our highly committed and collaborative team.

What else do I need to know?We offer an attractive compensation package that reflects your qualifications and professional experience. The gross annual salary for this position, as defined by the applicable collective agreement, is at least EUR 65,041.34. Depending on your education and experience, a higher salary may be offered. As a large international corporation, Siemens also provides additional benefits and social perks.
How can I apply?If you are interested in this position, we look forward to receiving your detailed online application.

jobs.title: Designer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
What if eyewear could be lighter, smarter, more expressive - and simply better designed? At Silhouette Group, we believe great eyewear starts with a strong idea. Our three brands - Silhouette, evil eye and neubau - explore different ways of shaping the future of eyewear.

We are looking for a curious, creative and ambitious Eyewear Designer to join our international design team in our Headquarter in Linz. 1 Designer (m/w/d)

AUFGABEN UND VERANTWORTUNG

* Explore. Track emerging trends in fashion, design, materials, technology and culture - and turn insights into relevant design directions.

* Create. Develop concepts, moodboards, sketches and 2D/3D designs from the first idea to a tangible product.

* Shape. Work closely with Color Design, R&D, prototyping and construction to transform creative ideas into feasible, high-quality eyewear.

* Communicate. Tell the story behind your designs and inspire colleagues, marketing, sales and opticians.

* Contribute. Become part of the development of future collections across our three distinctive brands.

ANFORDERUNGEN

* A degree in Industrial Design, Product Design or a related field

* A strong portfolio demonstrating original thinking, conceptual strength, sensitivity to form and attention to detail

* The ability to develop ideas from concept and sketch through 2D/3D design to the physical product

* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite and 3D design tools such as Rhino, SolidWorks or equivalent

* A strong understanding of form, proportion, materials and manufacturing processes

* Genuine curiosity for new materials, technologies and production methods

* The confidence to question conventional approaches, explore new ideas and develop your own design point of view

* An independent, hands-on and solution-oriented way of working

* A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with design, engineering and manufacturing teams

* Experience in eyewear, product or industrial design is an advantage - but exceptional potential and a strong portfolio matter just as much

For this full-time position, we offer a minimum gross yearly salary of EUR 60,962.30 in accordance with the Austrian Collective Agreement for the Metal Industry. Depending on your qualifications and professional experience, we are happy to offer a higher salary.

At Silhouette, your ideas have the opportunity to become reality - from the first sketch to prototype and, ultimately, to a finished collection. With three brands and distinct design worlds, you will find a broad playground for creativity, ranging from precision and lightness to performance and contemporary expression. Design and technology go hand in hand. You will work closely with experts from R&D, prototyping and production, gaining first-hand insight into how exceptional eyewear is developed and manufactured. We offer an international and dynamic working environment with room to take ownership, contribute your ideas and grow both professionally and personally. Depending on your preferred location, the position can be based in Linz or Vienna, with flexible hybrid and home-office options. Beyond the role itself, you can look forward to a range of benefits, including team events, fitness offers, professional and personal development opportunities, a subsidized healthy company restaurant, modern office spaces and a unique global company culture. Ready to shape the future of eyewear with us? Upload your application and portfolio via our online career portal at silhouette-international.com/karriere. For any questions, please feel free to contact Katrin Kappelmüller at +43 732 3848-843.

Search and AI visibility don't stop at our own site. Where it moves the needle, you can build presence on platforms that shape both organic discovery and how LLMs perceive us: YouTube as a search engine in its own right and Reddit or LinkedIn strategies that feed brand authority and GEO. You decide which channels are worth the effort.

Run GEO growth experiments

Every month, you'll propose, launch, and test a mini project outside your day-to-day: a new channel, content format, tool, or tactic, with success criteria defined upfront and measured throughout.

Manage SEO

Your day-to-day work covers a wide range of SEO topics, from discovering new search terms and building links to updating existing content and conducting regular technical SEO audits.

Automate

You automate before you're asked to. Audits, keyword research, competitor tracking, and reporting run on scripts, AI agents, or workflows you built, not manual pulls from GSC, Ahrefs, or PostHog every week.

In your first 3 months, you've set baselines and launched your first experiments. As a Process Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomicprecision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries. Your roleinvolves developing new and advanced process formulations, defining equipment hardware tomeet processing requirements, evaluating test data, and coordinating design requirements toensure compatibility of processing methods. Your expertise and knowledge play a crucial roleour customers success, making an impact on the next generation of semiconductorbreakthroughs.

jobs.description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Paper.io 2, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on Paper.io2.

Role

Paper Party is the multiplayer mode of Paper.io 2. We are looking for a dedicated Game Designer to improve the modes we already have and create new ones from scratch.

All modes will keep the Paper universe, camera and controls. Beyond that, there is a lot of creative freedom. You will explore new rules, objectives, win conditions, pacing and team setups to create a broad range of fun and replayable multiplayer experiences.

You will:

  • Design and prototype new gameplay modes

  • Improve existing Paper Party modes

  • Define simple, readable rules for one-finger controls

  • Iterate quickly through testing, feedback and playtests

  • Balance accessibility, competition, pacing and replayability

  • Identify weak ideas early and confidently cut or reshape them

  • Work closely with the Paper.io 2 team to turn concepts into playable experiences

  • Document your designs clearly

  • Fine-tune modes directly in Unity whenever possible

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys moving quickly from an idea to a playable prototype, testing it and improving it.

Profile

  • 5+ years of experience in mobile F2P games, designing new games, gameplay modes or prototypes from scratch

  • Experience shipping player-facing content, ideally in mobile games

  • A strong understanding of multiplayer and competitive gameplay

  • A good sense of pacing, clarity and player motivation

  • A pragmatic and iterative approach: prototype, test, cut and retry

  • The ability to work independently and take full ownership

  • Strong English communication and collaboration skills

Nice to have

  • Strong Unity experience

  • Ability to prototype directly in the engine

  • Experience with mobile controls, multiplayer or party games

  • Experience working on live games or live content

jobs.title: Hooldustöötaja
jobs.description:
Otsime hooldustöötajaid, kes soovivad pakkuda hoolt ja tuge meie elanikele Kastre kodus, asukohaga Kastre külas Tartumaal.

Tööülesanded: Milline on sinu roll meie kodudes?
✨ Päeva rõõmuks ja toetuseks: Sa hooldad ja juhendad meie kliente, olles nende jaoks igapäevane tugi ja abiline. ✨ Hoolivus igas pisidetailis: Abistad kliente hügieenitoimingutel, aidates neil säilitada väärikust ja enesekindlust. ✨ Südamega igas hetkes: Toetad meie kliente söömisel ja riietumisel, muutes nende päeva lihtsamaks ja mugavamaks. ✨ Puhtus, mis loob turvatunde: Hoolitsed klientide tubade ja hügieeniruumide puhtuse eest, luues neile mõnusa ja hubase keskkonna. ✨ Tervise hoidmine igas sammus: Tagad hooldus- ja põetusvahendite puhtuse, et meie kliendid saaksid parimat võimalikku hoolt. Kui sinu südames on koht hoolivusele ja soov muuta kellegi päev paremaks, siis ootame sind oma kollektiivi!

Omalt poolt pakume: Meile on oluline, et tunneksid end väärtustatuna. Meie juures ootab sind:
✨ 30 päeva põhipuhkust, et sul oleks aega päriselt puhata. ✨ Sõidukompensatsioon tööle ja koju, kui kasutad isiklikku autot. ✨ Mugavad tööriided ja jalanõud meie poolt – sinu turvalisus on tähtis. ✨ Maitsev toitlustus tööpäeva jooksul. ✨ 30% kõrgem öötöö tasu. ✨ Ka öösiti ei jää sa üksi – tööl on alati kaks hooldustöötajat. ✨ Võimalus areneda – pakume erialaseid koolitusi ja oskuste täiendamist. Kui hoolivus, meeskonnavaim ja arenguvõimalused on sulle olulised, siis sobid meie tiimi suurepäraselt!

Muud nõuded: Oled ideaalne kandidaat, kui sind iseloomustavad:
kannatlikkus ja valmisolek kuulata; täpsus ja kohusetundlikkus igapäevastes tegevustes; hea suhtlemisoskus ja positiivne ellusuhtumine; meeskonnatöö oskus, aga ka iseseisev tegutsemine; füüsiline vastupidavus ja stressitaluvus; tähelepanelikkus ja vastutustunne abivajajate heaolu eest Mida ootame sinult? ✅ Soovitavalt hooldaja kutsetunnistus (või valmisolek õppida meie juures) ✅ Sõiduauto olemasolu on suur pluss ✅ Vähemalt põhiharidus ✅ Kehtiv tervisetõend ✅ Tööle valitud kandidaadil palume enne töölepingu sõlmimist esitada karistusregistri väljavõtte, vastavalt hooldekodus töötamise nõuetele.

jobs.title: Dak- en gevelwerker
jobs.description:
We zoeken iemand die fier wil zijn.

Fier op een dak dat tot in de details klopt.
Fier op een gevel waarvan je achteraf denkt: “Ja. Dat hebben wij bij Bulotte gemaakt.”
Fier op de collega’s.
En fier om ’s morgens in werkkledij van Bulotte bij een klant aan te komen.

We zoeken we niet noodzakelijk een ervaren dakwerker; het mag maar is geen must!

Bij Bulotte geloven we dat mentaliteit, de juiste werkethiek, de fierheid om deel uit te maken van dit team belangrijker is dan eventuele ervaring.

We zoeken vooral “ de juiste collega“.

Welkom bij Bulotte

Vanuit Temse werkt Bulotte aan daken en gevels in de ruime regio (Waasland en Klein-Brabant).

Hellende daken, platte daken, renovaties en herstellingen, gevelisolatie, crepi, kalei, steenstrips… Ons werk is veelzijdig, maar de standaard is altijd dezelfde:

Wat we doen, doen we goed (en goed is uitstekend!).

We willen dat een woning na onze passage niet alleen technisch in orde is maar ook mooi en verzorgd afgewerkt. Daarom telt elk detail.

En dat harde werk en die ambitie blijven niet onopgemerkt.

In 2026 werd Bulotte bekroond met de Gouden Baksteen en verkozen tot ‘Belofte van het Jaar 2026’. Een erkenning waar we als team bijzonder fier op zijn – en tegelijk een extra motivatie om de lat elke dag opnieuw hoog te leggen.

Want groeien is mooi. Erkenning krijgen ook. Maar voor ons begint het nog altijd bij hetzelfde: goed werk afleveren met een ploeg die daar samen fier op is.

En die ploeg willen we nu versterken.

Vakmanschap kun je leren.

Heb je ervaring als dakwerker of gevelwerker? Fantastisch.

Heb je ervaring in de bouw? Ook goed.

Heb je nog nooit één voet op een dak gezet en kom je uit een compleet andere sector?

Dan willen we je nog altijd graag leren kennen.

Want technieken kunnen we aanleren.

Wat we zoeken moet vooral “in” je zitten.

Je komt op tijd. Je doet wat je belooft. Je steekt de handen uit de mouwen en wacht niet tot iemand je voor de derde keer vertelt wat er moet gebeuren.

Je draagt zorg voor materiaal. Je ruimt op. Je werkt veilig.

En als iets niet mooi afgewerkt is dan zie je dat zelf ook én doe je er iets aan.

Kortom: je bent een beetje een pietje – of mietje – precies.

Respect voor je vak én voor de klant

Je werkt vaak bij mensen thuis.

Daarom vinden we het vanzelfsprekend dat je beleefd en respectvol bent, dat je verzorgd voor de dag komt en dat je de woning en omgeving van de klant behandelt zoals je dat bij jezelf thuis zou willen.

Een werf laat je proper, ordelijk en veilig achter.

Daarnaast heb je een uitstekende kennis van het Nederlands. Veel van onze klanten zijn Nederlandstalig en we verwachten dat je vlot met hen kunt communiceren, vragen kunt beantwoorden en afspraken goed begrijpt.

Wat moet je wél kunnen afvinken?

  • je werkt graag buiten;
  • je bent fysiek in goede conditie;
  • je hebt twee handige handen en wil bijleren;
  • je bent nauwkeurig en hebt oog voor detail;
  • je hebt een sterke werkethiek;
  • collega’s kunnen op je rekenen;
  • je bent beleefd en respectvol tegenover klanten en collega’s;
  • je spreekt uitstekend Nederlands;
  • je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het werk dat je aflevert;
  • je wilt fier zijn op het resultaat én op de ploeg waarmee je het realiseert.

Een rijbewijs B zien we heel graag. Een rijbewijs BE of C is een extra troef.

Een diploma in de bouw?
Niet noodzakelijk.

Jaren ervaring?
Ook niet noodzakelijk.

Goesting en de juiste ingesteldheid? Absoluut noodzakelijk.

jobs.title: Ervaren plaatser ramen & deuren
jobs.description:
Wie is M-DP?

M-DP is een sterk groeiende KMO uit Bornem, gespecialiseerd in ramen, deuren en buitenschrijnwerk. Van opmeting tot plaatsing: M-DP houdt het volledige traject in eigen handen.

Vandaag bestaat het team uit een 12-tal medewerkers waarvan heel wat collega’s al jarenlang aan boord zijn. Door de sterke groei van M-DP zoeken we een extra ervaren plaatser om de ploeg te versterken.

Wat ga je doen?

Je staat samen met je collega’s in voor het plaatsen en afwerken van ramen, deuren en zonwering bij klanten.

In het begin nemen we de tijd om je vertrouwd te maken met de manier van werken bij M-DP. Heb je die eenmaal onder de knie dan ga je, samen met een collega, zelfstandig de baan op.

Voor ons is je ervaring belangrijker dan het juiste diploma.

Design Engineer (Web & Brand)
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We're looking for a Design Engineer with strong visual taste to help drive our creative initiatives across web and brand. When it comes to design and code, we’re looking to work with experienced people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story—what we're building and why it matters—as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

What you'll do

 - You will be responsible for building complex and interactive UI web/app experiences

 - Build beautiful, responsive websites, landing pages, and internal tools

 - Implement creative animations and interactions in code

 - Explore visual design in Figma and translate it to web-native experiences

What we're looking for

 - Eye for good design

 - Strong frontend engineering skills

 - Experience building end-to-end websites and landing pages

 - Experience with React and TypeScript

 - Experience using agentic coding tools as part of the design process (from exploring ideas to building production-quality interactions)

 - A portfolio or Twitter profile showcasing a range of technical skills, a creative use of code, and prototyping skills

What we offer

 - Interesting and challenging work

 - Work life balance

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms (extended exercise)

 - Paid lunch and coffee during work days

 - Work remotely, no commuting to the office

 - Paid co-working space/desk at an office

 - Regular team events and offsites

 - 5 weeks paid vacation

 - 4 months paid parental leave

jobs.title: Taxi driver, Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa - Uber & Bolt
jobs.description:
We're looking for taxi drivers to work via Uber and Bolt in the capital region.

We offer a permanent, open-ended employment contract. You don't drive as a self-employed entrepreneur, you get all the benefits of a regular employment relationship.

Day, evening and night shifts are available, as well as a weekend-only schedule. Shifts are agreed with you, and your preferences are taken into account in scheduling.

Pay is commission-based and calculated from the VAT-free cash of each shift driven. Tips from customers go fully to the driver.

The fleet is new: Toyota Corolla Touring models from 2021 - 2023 are available for work.

The role requires a valid taxi driver's permit (taksinkuljettajan ajolupa). If you don't have the permit yet, we expect readiness to obtain it as soon as possible.

Please note that the taxi driver's exam is held only in Finnish or Swedish, so a sufficient command of Finnish or Swedish is a mandatory requirement for obtaining the permit and therefore also for this role. English or other languages do not replace this requirement. The second requirement is a category B driving licence held for at least one year (issued in Finland or another EU/EEA country).

Previous taxi experience is a plus but not required.

We also offer the option to drive via the Taksi Helsinki dispatch. Customer service in Finland is mainly in Finnish. Finnish is a requirement, not a wish.

Get in touch by message:

WhatsApp: +358 44 327 2222

Messenger: m.me/NordlinkCareers

jobs.description:
Ben jij een organisatorisch talent dat houdt van afwisseling? Schakel je moeiteloos tussen nauwkeurig computerwerk, fysieke logistiek in het magazijn en het adviseren van klanten in de toonzaal? Dan is deze unieke, veelzijdige sleutelfunctie binnen ons bedrijf jou op het lijf geschreven!

Wat ga je doen?
In deze allround functie ben jij de spilfiguur van onze organisatie. Jouw takenpakket is opgedeeld in drie grote pijlers:

1. Planning & Offertebeheer (Kantoor)

  • Je berekent nauwkeurige offertes voor chape en vloerisolatie.
  • Je maakt deze offertes professioneel op in ons ERP-systeem (DataM).
  • Je stelt de planning op en volgt deze nauwgezet op voor de uitvoering van chape, vloerisolatie, renovaties en de plaatsing van tegels.


2. Magazijn & Logistiek (Magazijn)

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het magazijn en het voorraadbeheer.
  • Je controleert de binnenkomende goederen en bereidt de uitleveringen aan onze klanten voor.
  • Je lost inkomende vrachtwagens (hiervoor is het vlot kunnen bedienen van een vorkheftruck een must).


3. Klantenadvies & Toonzaal (Winkel)

  • Je ontvangt en begeleidt klanten in onze toonzaal bij hun zoektocht naar de perfecte tegel.
  • Je vertaalt hun wensen in een correcte offerte.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de toonzaal er altijd piekfijn en geordend bijstaat (een plaats voor alles en alles netjes op z’n plaats).
  • Computergestuurd: Je bent zeer vaardig met computers en pikt softwarepakketten (zoals ons ERP-systeem) snel op.
  • Je bent bereid om af en toe met een heftruck te rijden en hiervoor een attest te behalen.
  • Communicatief: Je spreekt en schrijft vlot Nederlands. Kennis van andere talen is een mooie plus.
  • Klantgericht & Gestructureerd: Je bent het visitekaartje voor onze klanten en houdt van orde en netheid, zowel in het magazijn als in de toonzaal.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager (hands-on) - Alan Clinic
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤖 Who we are

Alan Clinic. A health companion and a digital clinic for everyone.

We're a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. The Clinic is two crews building one experience:

  • Mo. An intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. We kicked off in 2023 and launched Mo to all our French members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

  • Clinic Platform. The medical services behind the conversation: chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation, and care programs across primary care, mental health, and physiotherapy.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise (through chat, voice, or video) with AI agents working in tandem with real doctors and the health system. That's what we are building 🤖🏥.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

We're building a medical experience that works reliably, safely, and at scale. An AI agent, and the clinic behind it. You'll lead the engineering team and you'll keep building alongside them.

The crews work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. As their engineering leader, you own:

  • 💬 The team behind the most memorable chatting experience. Hiring, onboarding, honest feedback, and the mix of skills Mo needs as it grows. Talent density is yours to own.

  • ➕ The architecture for Mo's next chapters. More context, new skills, new countries. You guide the calls on our architecture and agentic framework, and you stay close enough to the code to make them well.

  • 🏥 The platform that turns conversations into care. Chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation at national scale, and the tooling doctors and therapists use every day. You drive alignment with the crews and medical teams on the other side, so members get from words to actions.

  • 🛡️ Operational excellence. Mo and teleconsultation are real-time services that have to be live 24/7. Latency, error rates, incident response, and an on-call rotation that doesn't burn people out.

If you're excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you. We're at the start of the journey. If you're curious, here is a paper we published recently.

⚡ Why this role is special

  • Dual impact: Shape both technical excellence and team growth - your engineers become better while building better products

  • Leadership growth: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery

  • Startup speed, Alan's platform. Mo operates with the focus of a startup, on top of Alan's infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise. Small team, huge reach.

  • Stakes that make the work matter. In medical AI, reliability and safety are the product. Every call you make on quality, architecture, and evaluation is a call about our members' health.

🔍 What we're looking for

We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

Leadership experience

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.

  • You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver.

Technical foundations

  • Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions.

  • First-hand experience shipping AI or LLM products to production is a big plus.

  • You're excited and eager to keep writing code. You still review it, and you still ship some yourself.

  • Comfortable with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools.

What we value

  • Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.

  • You develop people as much as you develop products.

  • Ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team.

Mission alignment

  • Healthcare technology and innovation excite you

  • You understand that great engineering teams are built on psychological safety and continuous learning

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply!

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Profitability

  • Build and improve the Alan Life and income protection reserving, monitoring and profitability steering methodology, computation and tooling (accounting, best estimate).

  • Explain profitability, identify its key drivers, market trends, and assess the implications for renewals, including pricing and guarantee adjustments.

  • Develop the tools and analytics needed to forecast the portfolio performance and margin at scale, connecting to Finance & Risk.

  • Connect the dots with Prevention initiatives, including the relationship between Prévoyance coverage and absenteeism prevention.

Pricing

  • Define and improve methodologies for both theoretical and experience pricing.

  • Adapt analyses to the specific characteristics of each business segment, including small amounts, high-severity claims, and newly launched segments.

  • Contribute to the portfolio renewal strategies, in close collaboration with internal teams (Strategy, Product, Sales, etc.) and external stakeholders (insurer, reinsurers).

Underwriting & product launch

  • Support underwriting teams throughout the year with technical analysis, guidelines, ad hoc methodologies, as well as automation initiatives.

  • Provide technical input to the launch of new products or geographies.

  • Contribute to the reinsurance plans definition and optimisation year on year, including partnership management.

Team Growth

  • Create processes and resources to strengthen the team’s ability to price and steer the Prevoyance portfolio.

  • Support the identification and hiring of new talents for the Insurance team.

  • Build internal knowledge of Prévoyance both for newcomers onboarding and stakeholders upskilling.

⭐️ Is it you we’re looking for? ⭐️

You would be a good fit if you:

  • Have experience in insurance, portfolio monitoring and pricing

  • Are comfortable about both going deep on technical aspects, and keep a high level vision on the strategy and execution priorities and pace

  • Have a scientific background (statistics, actuarial sciences) and are capable of understanding technical, data, regulatory, and business questions related to death & disability insurance/reinsurance

  • Are comfortable with coding (SQL, and ideally R / Python), but also leverage AI in both your daily work and on data assets.

  • Are analytical and structured, with a fact-based decision-making style

  • Are enthusiastic about teamwork, curious, learning, teaching, and stakeholder management

  • Are willing to deeply change the insurance industry and challenge the status quo

  • Have strong written communication skills, including with a broad range of stakeholders like underwriting, finance, strategy, risk, product, and local teams

  • Are fluent in English (Alan’s working language)

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in a similar role (RevOps, Sales Ops, or Sales Effectiveness);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives without hand-holding;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Have at least intermediate SQL queries reading skills. Being able to write and own queries autonomously is a nice to have.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have direct hands-on experience in Salesforce and/or Outreach (not just awareness or admin-level use)

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have full working proficiency in French and at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

jobs.title: Senior User Researcher
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The User Researcher role ⭐️

At Alan, research is not a checkpoint. It's a compass. Our User Research team sits at the intersection of product, design, and engineering, making sure every decision is grounded in what our members actually need, feel, and experience.

As a User Researcher at Alan, you will gather and prioritize the most important questions from across the company, and design the right research to answer them. That means running interviews, diary studies, surveys, and usability sessions throughout the full product cycle, not just at the end. You'll then turn those findings into insights that are clear, compelling, and genuinely useful to the teams who need them.

You'll work hand in hand with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers, and collaborate closely with our analytics and data science teams to tell a complete story about our product. You'll also help grow research culture across Alan, sharing your craft and mentoring teammates along the way.

At Alan, great research drives great product. If you love figuring out what people truly need and translating that into decisions that matter, this role is for you.

⭐️ If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit ⭐️

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have:

  • 4+ years of experience as a product/user researcher in a tech environment, with strong hands-on expertise in qualitative methods: interviews, diary studies, think-aloud usability testing, and direct observation

  • Solid quantitative research skills: you're comfortable with survey design, sampling, crosstabs, and core statistical concepts

  • Sharp critical thinking: you quickly identify what research is worth doing, scope it efficiently, and deliver insights that are focused and actionable

  • A strategic mindset: you know how to partner with product stakeholders, communicate the value of research, and tie your findings to concrete business impact

  • Compelling communication skills: you turn complex findings into clear narratives that resonate with any audience

  • Experience mentoring junior researchers or non-researchers, with the ability to give clear, actionable feedback that helps others grow

  • You're close to AI. Either you've built AI products, or you follow the space closely and have a clear view on where to leverage and how LLM systems behave in production.

  • You care about healthcare. Alan's mission has to genuinely matter to you. For us this is essential, not a nice-to-have.

  • English fluency, written and spoken

  • (As a plus) Fluency in French, Spanish, or another European language

For this role, we hire within the D-E level range.

🌍 How we work

  • Based in (or within commuting distance of) Paris, with the ability to work onsite twice per week.

Alan exists to end the wait.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Alan operates at the intersection of health insurance, prevention, and regulated data. The person in this role owns the security governance and risk posture of a company that handles sensitive health data for 1M+ members, operates under DORA and HDS certification requirements, and is regulated by the ACPR. They work in close partnership with Legal, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function. It's a highly collaborative role.

🛡️ Your mission: Governance, risk & compliance

Own and operate the ISO 27001 ISMS. You are the accountable owner of the Information Security Management System: scope definition, Statement of Applicability, internal audit programme, and management review. You've led at least one full certification or recertification cycle and know what breaks down in the months between audits.

Be the security expert on regulatory and privacy matters. Legal leads on DORA, HDS, RGPD, PGSSI-S, and regulatory relationships. Your role is to bring the technical and operational security substance: translating regulatory requirements into controls, flagging implementation gaps, and making sure the security programme is solid when the regulatory team negotiates with the ACPR or ANS.

Run risk as an ongoing programme, in partnership with the broader risk function. You lead security risk cartography using EBIOS RM and ensure it feeds into, and is informed by, the company-wide risk framework. You facilitate risk workshops, produce treatment plans, and bring the security lens to forums where non-security risks are also on the table. You know when a security risk is really a business risk.

Own the controls framework, but distribute ownership of controls themselves. You define the framework, set the standards, and track coverage, but the controls live with the teams who build and run the things they protect. You work closely with Infrastructure, Platform, and Engineering to ensure foundational building blocks (identity, network, secrets management, logging) are designed with security requirements built in from the start. You work alongside those teams as a partner.

Run audit cycles with rigour, in close partnership with Internal Audit. You manage the security audit programme and coordinate with certification bodies. You work with Internal Audit to align scopes, avoid duplication, and present a coherent picture of control effectiveness to the board. You've sat in joint audit planning sessions and know how to make that relationship work well.

Manage third-party risk. You run vendor security assessments and define contractual security requirements (security annexes, DPAs). You partner with our Risk team, which oversees third-party risk, and own the security dimension.

Bring the health sector context. You understand the ANS framework, CERT Santé requirements, and what it means to handle sensitive health data in day-to-day operations. You're a useful partner to Legal when the question is "what does this regulation actually require us to do technically?"

Own incident governance and support DORA reporting. You classify and escalate ICT incidents internally, own BCP and DRP governance, and provide the security substance for DORA incident reports.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

Compliance Framework: ISO 27001, DORA, HDS, NIS2. Multiple regulators, multiple countries, one coherent governance backbone. Build the system that lets Alan scale from 1M to many millions of members without rebuilding compliance every time.

Automated Audit & Evidence Engine: Replace manual evidence collection with scripted pipelines plugged directly into engineering systems. Turn audit cycles into a continuous capability instead of a quarterly rush.

Risk Cartography: Risk treated as an operational signal that feeds directly into business and engineering decisions, with EBIOS RM at the core.

You'll work closely with Legal, DPO, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function, and partner day-to-day with Infrastructure, Platform, Engineering, Product, and Operations. You're the bridge between regulatory complexity and operational simplicity.

⚡ Why this role is special

Direct Impact: You own the trust foundation that lets Alan handle health data for 1M+ members and operate in highly regulated markets. Your work is the precondition for everything else Alan does.

Complex Problems: 4 regulators across 4 countries, sensitive health data, and a regulatory landscape that keeps shifting (DORA, NIS2, AI Act), all to be modeled into a single, coherent control system.

Ownership & Growth: Board and executive exposure, real influence on company-wide risk decisions, and the autonomy to shape Alan's security culture across 800+ people.

🤝 What you will also do: Technical enablement

Automate compliance work wherever possible. You script evidence collection, automate control testing, and connect GRC tooling to engineering pipelines. You've used Python or similar to reduce the manual work of an audit cycle, and you actively look for the next process to streamline.

Configure and own GRC tooling. You can administer platforms like CISO Assistant, ServiceNow GRC, or Archer, designing workflows, building dashboards, and making them genuinely useful for the teams that feed them data.

Speak cloud governance fluently. You understand shared responsibility in HDS-qualified environments, know what CSPM tools surface and what they miss, and can reason about policy-as-code (OPA, SCP) without needing an engineer to translate.

Read architecture well enough to challenge it. You can review a proposed architecture, identify control gaps in identity, network segmentation, encryption, or logging, and push back credibly with engineers even though you're not one.

Interpret vulnerability data and drive prioritisation. You read scan outputs, work with engineering teams to prioritise remediation by business impact over CVSS score alone, and track resolution KPIs over time.

⭐️ Qualifications, mindset and soft skills

You translate risk into business language. You can brief a board or an audit committee and leave them genuinely informed. You know the difference between a finding that requires an emergency board call and one that belongs in a quarterly report.

You influence without authority. You align Legal, DPO, Risk, Engineering, Product, and Operations on security requirements without creating blockers or adversarial dynamics. People come to you early because you make their work easier.

You manage programmes with audit-grade rigor. You run structured, traceable roadmaps. You know where every commitment is, who owns it, and when it's due. You escalate proactively and don't let dependencies surprise you.

You build a genuine security culture. Your awareness programmes land because they're relevant to the people who take them. You foster proportionate risk ownership across the company, so teams make better day-to-day decisions.

You think in principles when frameworks shift. DORA is live. NIS2 transposition pace varies. The AI Act is arriving. When the regulatory landscape moves, you reason from first principles and adapt without waiting to be told what to do.

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France, Belgium or Spain.

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration

jobs.title: Stabiliteitsingenieur
jobs.description:
Als stabiliteitsingenieur beoordeel je concrete stabiliteitsvragen op het terrein. Je analyseert de situatie in situ, formuleert deskundig advies en geeft, waar nodig, duidelijke instructies over de maatregelen die noodzakelijk zijn om gebouwen of panden veilig te stellen.

Je ondersteunt de aanbestedende overheid met deskundig advies bij stabiliteitsproblemen in publieke gebouwen en private panden, waarbij veiligheid, onderbouwde besluitvorming en duidelijke communicatie centraal staan.

Voornaamste taken

  • Je voert plaatsbezoeken uit naar gebouwen of panden waar stabiliteitsproblemen of gevaarlijke situaties worden vastgesteld.
  • Je beoordeelt de situatie ter plaatse en analyseert de problematiek op een deskundige manier.
  • Je formuleert concrete adviezen over de noodzakelijke maatregelen om de veiligheid te garanderen.
  • Je maakt duidelijke verslagen van plaatsbezoeken, ondersteund met relevant beeldmateriaal.
  • Je ondersteunt de aanbestedende overheid bij dossiers in het kader van openbare veiligheid.
  • Je stelt, indien van toepassing, een omstandig verslag op in het kader van artikel 135 van de Gemeentewet.
  • Je kan bij noodsituaties advies verlenen aan of op vraag van de brandweer.
  • Je bent stabiliteitsingenieur en beschikt over de nodige technische expertise om stabiliteitsproblemen correct te beoordelen.
  • Je hebt ervaring met plaatsbezoeken, technische analyses en het formuleren van praktisch uitvoerbare adviezen.
  • Je communiceert helder en professioneel met de overheid, hulpdiensten en andere betrokken partijen.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en oplossingsgericht.
  • Je bent bereid om ter plaatse te gaan wanneer een concrete vraag of noodsituatie dit vereist.
  • Referenties: je kunt minimaal 1 referentie van gelijkaardige opdracht uitgevoerd in de voorbije 3 jaar voorleggen. Aan elke referentie wordt een attest van goede uitvoering toegevoegd evenals de tewerkstellingsperiode.

jobs.title: Projectleider bouw en renovatieprojecten
jobs.description:
Voor de ondersteuning van diverse bouw- en renovatieprojecten binnen gemeentes grenzend aan Oost-Vlaanderen en Antwerpen zoeken wij een ervaren projectleider. Je neemt projecten zelfstandig op of ondersteunt lopende dossiers, steeds in nauwe samenwerking met de opdrachtgever, ontwerpers, architecten, aannemers en interne diensten.

Als externe projectleider vertegenwoordig je de bouwheer bij bouw- en renovatiedossiers. Je bewaakt de voortgang, kwaliteit, timing en budgetten en zorgt ervoor dat projecten professioneel voorbereid, opgevolgd en afgerond worden. Je combineert bouwtechnische expertise met sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en een goed inzicht in overheidsopdrachten.

Voornaamste taken

  • Je analyseert de bestaande bouwkundige toestand en de planologische context van projecten.
  • Je stelt programma’s van eisen, ramingen, nota’s en technische voorschriften op.
  • Je begeleidt ontwerp- en uitvoeringsdossiers in samenwerking met ontwerpers, architecten en aannemers.
  • Je organiseert en neemt deel aan overlegmomenten en maakt duidelijke verslagen op.
  • Je ondersteunt de Dienst overheidsopdrachten bij lastenboeken, prijsonderzoeken, offertevraagstukken en gunningsverslagen.
  • Je volgt werken op als vertegenwoordiger van de bouwheer en adviseert over technische keuzes, wijzigingen, verrekeningen en opleveringen.
  • Je bewaakt budgetten, vorderingsstaten, technische fiches, proefverslagen en het dagboek der werken.
  • Je bereidt voorlopige en definitieve opleveringen voor en volgt openstaande punten tijdens de waarborgperiode op.
  • Je beschikt over een bachelor- of masterdiploma in een bouwkundige richting en/of relevante aantoonbare beroepservaring.
  • Je hebt ervaring met bouw- en renovatieprojecten, bij voorkeur binnen een publieke context.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met projectmanagement, werfopvolging, technische dossiers en budgetbewaking.
  • Je communiceert helder met opdrachtgevers, ontwerpers, aannemers en interne stakeholders.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en oplossingsgericht.
  • Kennis van de wetgeving overheidsopdrachten is een sterke troef.
  • Referenties: je kunt minimaal 1 referentie van gelijkaardige opdracht uitgevoerd in de voorbije 3 jaar voorleggen. Aan elke referentie wordt een attest van goede uitvoering toegevoegd evenals de tewerkstellingsperiode.

jobs.title: Technisch adviseur / stabiliteitsingenieur
jobs.description:
Als Technisch adviseur of stabiliteitsingenieur bied je deskundige ondersteuning aan de medewerkers van de afdeling. Je analyseert technische problemen, formuleert haalbare oplossingen en geeft advies binnen bouwdossiers, overheidsopdrachten, procedures, geschillen of situaties met mogelijke impact op de openbare veiligheid.

Voornaamste taken

  • Je analyseert bouwtechnische problemen en werkt onderbouwde adviezen of oplossingen uit.
  • Je adviseert over technische installaties, civiele bouwkunde en bouwkundige uitvoeringsvragen.
  • Je ondersteunt medewerkers bij complexe dossiers, procedures of geschillen.
  • Je leest ontwerplastenboeken na en adviseert over de kwaliteit en uitvoerbaarheid ervan.
  • Je beoordeelt stabiliteitsproblemen in gebouwen of panden, zowel op publieke als private eigendom.
  • Je voert plaatsbezoeken uit en maakt duidelijke verslagen met analyse, beeldmateriaal en concrete maatregelen.
  • Je formuleert, indien nodig, advies in het kader van openbare veiligheid en artikel 135 van de Gemeentewet.
  • Je bent beschikbaar voor dringende oproepen bij noodsituaties, ook buiten de normale kantooruren.
  • Je beschikt over sterke technische kennis binnen civiele bouwkunde, bouwtechniek en/of technische installaties.
  • Voor stabiliteitsadviezen beschik je over het profiel van stabiliteitsingenieur.
  • Je kan je snel inwerken in technische vraagstukken en vertaalt je bevindingen naar helder, bruikbaar advies.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met bouwdossiers en bij voorkeur ook met de wetgeving overheidsopdrachten.
  • Je communiceert professioneel met interne medewerkers, de aanbestedende overheid, hulpdiensten en andere betrokken partijen.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en oplossingsgericht.
  • Je bent bereid om, indien van toepassing, snel ter plaatse te gaan bij dringende situaties.
  • Referenties: je kunt minimaal 1 referentie van gelijkaardige opdracht uitgevoerd in de voorbije 3 jaar voorleggen. Aan elke referentie wordt een attest van goede uitvoering toegevoegd evenals de tewerkstellingsperiode.

jobs.title: Customer Service Medewerker
jobs.description:
Heb je een bachelor op zak en combineer je graag klantencontact met administratie en opvolging?

Dan is dit een mooie kans om jouw analytische en organisatorische skills in te zetten binnen een stabiele onderneming.
  • Bachelorfunctie met verantwoordelijkheid en afwisseling
  • Stabiele werkomgeving met een ervaren team
  • Sterke work-lifebalans met flexibele werkuren én extra verlofdagen

Wat ga je doen?
Als Customer Service Medewerker ben je een belangrijke schakel tussen klanten, sales, logistiek en interne diensten. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:
  • Verwerken van binnenkomende orders voor België en Luxemburg
  • Registreren en controleren van bestellingen binnen het ERP-systeem
  • Stockniveaus controleren en opvolgen
  • Orders administratief verwerken van A tot Z
  • Levertermijnen opvolgen en communiceren naar klanten
  • Dagelijks contact onderhouden met klanten, vertegenwoordigers en magazijn
  • Klantvragen professioneel beantwoorden via mail en telefoon
  • Prioriteiten stellen en verschillende dossiers tegelijk opvolgen
  • Actief meedenken bij vragen of problemen van klanten

Waar ga je werken?
Je komt terecht in een financieel gezond en stabiel productiebedrijf met een sterke reputatie binnen zijn sector. De organisatie combineert professionaliteit met een warme, familiale sfeer.Collega's werken nauw samen, successen worden gevierd en medewerkers krijgen de ruimte om initiatief te nemen. De cultuur is no-nonsense, mensgericht en gericht op lange termijn.Hier krijg je de kans om deel uit te maken van een ervaren team waar jouw bijdrage telt en waar een gezonde werk-privébalans geen loze belofte is.
  • Ervaring binnen customer service, commerciële binnendienst of orderverwerking
  • Uitstekende kennis Nederlands én Frans

jobs.title: Afkoppelingsdeskundige private percelen
jobs.description:
Als afkoppelingsdeskundige sta je in voor de opmaak, opvolging en kwaliteitsvolle afhandeling van afkoppelingsdossiers op perceelsniveau. Je brengt bestaande afwateringssituaties in kaart, werkt technische oplossingen uit en begeleidt eigenaars of bewoners doorheen het proces van correcte scheiding van afvalwater en hemelwater. Daarbij hou je rekening met de geldende regelgeving, de interne richtlijnen, VLAREM II, Aquaflanders en/of VLARIO, en de principes van goed vakmanschap.

Voornaamste taken

o Je voert voorstudies uit en verzamelt de nodige gegevens bij gemeenten, steden, kadasterdiensten en andere betrokken partijen.

o Je organiseert terreinbezoeken en maakt afspraken met eigenaars en bewoners.

o Je inventariseert bestaande afwateringssituaties, inclusief leidingen, lozingspunten, dakafvoeren, verhardingen, putten en mogelijke knelpunten.

o Je maakt per perceel een volledig afkoppelingsdossier op met grondplannen, fotoreportage, infofiche, meetstaat en kostenraming.

o Je werkt technische ontwerpen uit voor de scheiding van afvalwater en regenwater, met aandacht voor infiltratie, hergebruik, buffering en aansluitbaarheid op het openbaar domein.

o Je licht voorstellen toe aan eigenaars en begeleidt de ondertekening van uitvoeringsformulieren.

o Je volgt dossiers op via het online platform en houdt overzichtstabellen correct en actueel.

o Je ondersteunt tijdens de uitvoering, doet werftoezicht waar nodig en helpt bij het opmaken of controleren van as-builtplannen.

o Je werkt samen met opdrachtgevers, aannemers, keuringsorganismen en rioolbeheerders.

Bijkomende informatie:

o Mogelijke regio’s: Vlaams-Brabant- Oost- en West-Vlaanderen

o Parttime

o Je hebt technische affiniteit met riolering, afwatering, wegeniswerken, waterbeheer of infrastructuurprojecten.

o Je werkt nauwkeurig en kan technische situaties helder analyseren en vertalen naar praktische oplossingen.

o Je bent vertrouwd met plannen, meetstaten, terreinopmetingen en technische verslaggeving.

o Kennis van afkoppelingsstudies, VLAREM II, hemelwaterverordeningen, Aquaflanders, VLARIO- richtlijnen is een sterke troef.

o Je communiceert vlot met eigenaars, bewoners, opdrachtgevers en aannemers.

o Je denkt praktisch, vermijdt onnodige hinder en zoekt steeds naar de meest haalbare en kostenefficiënte oplossing.

o Je kan zelfstandig werken, maar functioneert ook goed binnen een projectteam.

o Je bent administratief sterk en volgt dossiers gestructureerd op

o Je kunt minstens 2 referenties met tevredenheidsattest voorleggen

jobs.title: Customer Support medewerker
jobs.description:
Als Customer Support Medewerker help je klanten verder met vragen over hun mobiliteits- en wagendossiers. Je combineert ticketafhandeling met telefonisch contact en zorgt ervoor dat elk dossier correct en professioneel wordt opgevolgd.
Omdat je te maken krijgt met complexe vragen, verschillende car policies en meerdere contactpersonen tegelijk, vraagt deze rol een goed analytisch inzicht.

Zo ziet je werkdag eruit:
  • Je werkt afwisselend met tickets en telefonie. Telefonische contacten verlopen in vaste tijdsblokken, waardoor je ook voldoende tijd hebt om je dossiers administratief netjes op te volgen. Concreet zijn er drie halve dagen in de voormiddag en twee halve dagen in de namiddag voorzien voor telefonie.
  • De ticketwerking vormt de kern van je job. Je bepaalt prioriteiten, houdt overzicht en volgt dossiers op tot ze volledig afgerond zijn.
  • Je behandelt vragen rond onder meer schadegevallen, herstellingen, leasingvoorwaarden en franchises. Dat zijn vaak geen standaardvragen: dossiers lopen over meerdere stappen, vragen afstemming met verschillende partijen en hebben een duidelijke opvolging nodig.
  • Daarnaast heb je regelmatig contact met leasemaatschappijen, hersteldiensten en makelaars, en stem je intern af met Finance en HR.
  • Je beheert meestal vier tot vijf klanten tegelijk, elk met een eigen car policy en specifieke afspraken. Dat vraagt structuur, flexibiliteit en een goed organisatorisch vermogen.
  • Niet elk gesprek is eenvoudig. Vooral bij schadegevallen of discussies kan het contact emotioneel of pittig zijn. Je blijft rustig, professioneel en duidelijk, ook wanneer klanten gefrustreerd of boos reageren. Je leert hoe je hier sterk in staat dankzij opleidingen rond assertiviteit en gesprekstechnieken.
Wie zoeken wij in deze functie als Customer support medewerker?
  • Pas afgestudeerd in een relevante Bachelor richting of eerste relevante werkervaring
  • Vlot in het aanleren van nieuwe IT-applicaties
  • Uitstekende kennis van Nederlands, zeer goede kennis van Frans en Engels
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en stressbestendig
  • Sociaal, communicatief en een echte teamplayer
  • Klantgericht en energiek

jobs.title: Flexi of Parttime Projectleider Renovatiewerken
jobs.description:
Als Projectleider Renovatie Woningbouw volg je renovatieprojecten van A tot Z op. Je bewaakt de planning, kwaliteit, veiligheid en budgetten in opdracht van de bouwheer en bent het aanspreekpunt voor aannemers en leveranciers. Je zorgt ervoor dat elke werf vlot, correct en professioneel verloopt.

Voornaamste taken

  • Je coördineert renovatiewerken in residentiële woningbouw in regio Brussel.
  • Je stuurt aannemers en leveranciers aan en volgt hun prestaties op.
  • Je bewaakt planning, budget, kwaliteit en veiligheid op de werf.
  • Je analyseert plannen, offertes en technische uitvoeringsdetails.
  • Je organiseert en volgt werfvergaderingen op.
  • Je signaleert problemen tijdig en denkt mee in praktische, haalbare oplossingen.

Bijkomende informatie

  • Deeltijds (2 dagen per week) of flexi of planning overeen te komen
  • Regio Brussel
  • Je hebt minimum 5 jaar ervaring als projectleider binnen de renovatiewereld.
  • Je kent de praktische realiteit van residentiële renovaties: afbraak, ruwbouw, technieken, afwerking en oplevering.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, gestructureerd en oplossingsgericht.
  • Je rapporteert naar de bouwheer waarmee je een directe lijn hebt
  • Je communiceert vlot met zowel klanten als uitvoerende partijen.

jobs.title: Grondwerker Nederland
jobs.description:
Werk je graag buiten en steek je graag de handen uit de mouwen?

Ben je een echte doener die graag in team werkt? Heb je geen schrik van fysiek werk en wil je meewerken aan uitdagende bouwprojecten? Dan is deze functie als grondwerker iets voor jou.

Jouw functie

Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat bouwterreinen volledig bouwrijp worden gemaakt voor woning- en appartementsbouw. Je werkt in een vaste ploeg van gemiddeld twee tot drie personen en ondersteunt de kraanmachinist bij diverse grondwerken.

Je takenpakket bestaat onder andere uit:

  • Uitvoeren van graaf- en grondwerken.

  • Plaatsen van rioleringen en uitvoeren van funderingswerken.

  • Ondersteunen van de kraanmachinist tijdens de werkzaamheden.

  • Mee zorgen voor een veilige, kwalitatieve en nette uitvoering van de werken.

  • Samenwerken binnen een hecht en gemotiveerd team.

Je werkt voornamelijk op werven in Nederland. Daarom verblijf je van maandag tot vrijdag in een hotel dicht bij de werf. De accommodatie wordt voor jou geregeld.

Jouw profiel

  • Een diploma is niet vereist; motivatie en inzet zijn voor ons het belangrijkst.

  • Je werkt graag buiten en bent niet bang voor fysiek werk.

  • Je volgt werkinstructies nauwkeurig op.

  • Je bent stipt, betrouwbaar en werkt graag in team.

  • Je hebt oog voor veiligheid en kwaliteit.

  • Ervaring met een minigraver is een pluspunt.

  • Je bent bereid om tijdens de werkweek in Nederland te verblijven.
