jobs.title: Sanitør til løsøre | Hjælp os med at passe på det, der betyder noget
jobs.description:
Det er ikke bare ting

Når en kunde bliver ramt af brand, vand eller en anden skade, kan hjemmets eller virksomhedens indbo også blive berørt.

Møbler, billeder, bøger, tøj og personlige ejendele kan ved første øjekast ligne almindelige ting – men for kunden kan de have stor både praktisk og personlig værdi.

Derfor kræver arbejdet med løsøre noget særligt.

Hos Ocab søger vi nu en sanitør, som har lyst til at arbejde med håndtering, rengøring og behandling af kundernes indbo og løsøre – både ude hos kunderne og på vores vaskelinje.

Om jobbet

Som sanitør til løsøre følger du kundens ejendele gennem forskellige dele af processen.

Det kan begynde ude på et skadested, hvor indbo skal sorteres, registreres, pakkes og transporteres. Andre dage arbejder du på vores vaskelinje med rengøring og behandling af løsøre, så mest muligt kan reddes og leveres tilbage til kunden.

Det kræver ikke bare praktisk sans. Det kræver også, at du arbejder systematisk, omhyggeligt og respektfuldt med de ting, du får mellem hænderne.

Dine arbejdsopgaver kan blandt andet være

  • Håndtering af indbo og løsøre efter brand-, vand- og andre skader

  • Sortering og registrering af kundernes ejendele

  • Pakning, mærkning og klargøring til transport og opbevaring

  • Rengøring og behandling af løsøre

  • Arbejde på vores vaskelinje

  • Flytning og håndtering af møbler og øvrigt indbo

  • Arbejde ude hos kunder i forbindelse med skadesager

  • Dokumentation af det udførte arbejde

  • Samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere gennem hele forløbet

Vi forestiller os, at du

Til denne stilling leder vi først og fremmest efter en person, der kan lide at gøre tingene grundigt og ordentligt.

Du forstår, at du arbejder med andre menneskers ejendele, og du behandler dem med den samme omhu, som du selv ville ønske.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Er omhyggelig og detaljeorienteret

  • Arbejder struktureret og har styr på de ting, du håndterer

  • Har lyst til både praktisk arbejde og mere systematiske opgaver

  • Trives med at arbejde på vores vaskelinje såvel som ude hos kunderne

  • Er i god fysisk form, da flytning og håndtering af indbo kan være en del af arbejdsdagen

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Trives med samarbejde og bidrager positivt til teamet

  • Møder kunderne ordentligt og med forståelse for den situation, de står i

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har kørekort (kategori B)

Erfaring fra skadeservice, rengøring, flyttebranchen, lager eller lignende praktisk arbejde kan være en fordel, men det vigtigste er din tilgang til arbejdet og din lyst til at lære.

Det er en forudsætning, at du kan fremvise en straffeattest.

Hvem er Ocab?

Ocab er en af Nordens førende virksomheder inden for skadeservice og industriservice. Vi hjælper hvert år tusindvis af kunder efter blandt andet brand-, vand- og klimaskader. Hos Ocab bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høj faglighed og engagerede kolleger. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, ordentlighed og en stærk holdånd.

Vi tilbyder

  • En varieret hverdag med både arbejde på vores vaskelinje og ude hos kunderne

  • Grundig oplæring og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling

  • Et arbejde, hvor omhu og kvalitet gør en reel forskel

  • Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger

  • Løn efter overenskomst

  • Pension og sundhedsordning

  • 37 timers arbejdsuge

  • Ingen obligatorisk deltagelse i vagtordningen

Arbejdssted: Ocab Farum, Rugmarken 36, 3520 Farum

Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt

Har du lyst til at blive en del af holdet?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@ocab.dk. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte driftsleder Casper Schiermer på tlf. +45 61 56 59 02.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Sanitør til skadeservice | Bliv en del af Ocab Holbæk
jobs.description:
En hverdag, hvor der er brug for dig

Når en kunde bliver ramt af en vand-, brand- eller skimmelskade, er en hurtig og professionel indsats vigtig. Hos Ocab rykker vi ud, begrænser skaden og hjælper kunden videre – og som sanitør bliver du en vigtig del af den indsats.

Til vores afdeling i Holbæk søger vi nu en sanitør, som trives med en aktiv og varieret arbejdsdag, tager ansvar og har lyst til at blive en del af et hold med dygtige kolleger.

Nogle dage følger planen. Andre dage gør den ikke. Det er en del af jobbet – og derfor skal du kunne bevare overblikket og være klar til at træde til, når der er brug for dig.


Om jobbet

Som sanitør hos Ocab arbejder du med mange forskellige typer skadeserviceopgaver hos både private, virksomheder og professionelle kunder.

Det er et praktisk og fysisk job. Du kan blandt andet komme til at flytte og håndtere kundernes indbo og løsøre, arbejde med nedrivning og sanering samt løse industriopgaver og opgaver i højden.

Du arbejder både selvstændigt og sammen med kolleger og projektledere. Uanset opgaven er målet det samme: at levere et professionelt stykke arbejde og møde kunden ordentligt i en situation, der ofte er både uventet og vanskelig.

Dine arbejdsopgaver kan blandt andet være

  • Blotlægning og nedrivning i forbindelse med vandskader

  • Skimmelsanering

  • Rengøring og sanering efter brandskader

  • Opsætning og tilsyn med affugtningsudstyr

  • Håndtering og flytning af indbo og løsøre

  • Asbestsanering

  • Sanering efter skadedyr

  • Oprydning og rengøring i forbindelse med socialsager

  • Industriopgaver

  • Dokumentation af opgaver fra start til slut

  • Tæt samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere

  • Deltagelse i vagtordning

Vi forestiller os, at du

Du behøver ikke komme med præcis den samme baggrund som dine kommende kolleger. Erfaring betyder noget, men vi lægger også stor vægt på din indstilling, ansvarlighed og måde at samarbejde med andre på.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra skadeservice eller en lignende branche – erfaring med skadeservice er en klar fordel

  • Har asbestbevis eller erfaring med asbestsanering – en fordel, men ikke et krav

  • Er i god fysisk form og trives med et aktivt arbejde, hvor løft og flytning kan være en del af arbejdsdagen

  • Er tryg ved at arbejde i højden, da nogle opgaver kan foregå på stiger, lifte eller arbejdsplatforme

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Er omhyggelig og kvalitetsbevidst

  • Trives med samarbejde og bidrager positivt til holdet

  • Er fleksibel og kan bevare overblikket, når dagens planer ændrer sig

  • Bor i rimelig afstand til vores afdeling i Holbæk

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har kørekort (kategori B)

Deltagelse i vagtordningen er en obligatorisk del af stillingen. Du skal derfor være indstillet på efter en fastlagt vagtplan at kunne træde til uden for normal arbejdstid, når en akut skade kræver vores hjælp.

Det er en forudsætning, at du kan fremvise en straffeattest.

Hvem er Ocab?

Ocab er en af Nordens førende virksomheder inden for skadeservice og industriservice. Vi hjælper hvert år tusindvis af kunder efter blandt andet brand-, vand- og klimaskader.

Hos Ocab bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høj faglighed og engagerede kolleger. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, ordentlighed og en stærk holdånd.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og varieret arbejdsdag

  • Grundig oplæring og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling

  • Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger

  • Et job med ansvar og stor variation i opgaverne

  • Løn efter overenskomst

  • Pension og sundhedsordning

  • 37 timers arbejdsuge

  • Normal arbejdstid mandag-fredag kl. 07.00-15.00

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Mission of the role

To ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll for multiple UK clients. The UK Payroll Executive will be responsible for managing payroll data, processing payroll transactions, supporting workplace pension auto-enrolment, responding to client queries, and ensuring all payroll activities are completed in line with UK labour laws, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and agreed client timelines.

The role requires strong attention to detail, client service, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple payrolls and deadlines efficiently while continuously looking for ways to improve workflows through technology, AI, and automation.

Key outcomes In the first 6â12 monthsOutcome 1: UK Payroll Knowledge & Process Proficiency

Develop a strong foundational understanding of UK payroll regulations and processes and confidently apply the appropriate rules when preparing and processing client payrolls.

Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month.

Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing

Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission.

Ensure 100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines, including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements.

Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy.

Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness

Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries.

Consistently achieve a CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day.

Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required.

Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement

Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues.

Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times.

Must-have experience

  • Minimum 1â2 years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience.
  • Experience working in a bureau, outsourced payroll environment, or shared services centre is preferred.
  • Experience managing multiple client payroll accounts is an advantage.
  • Working knowledge of UK payroll processes, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and workplace pension processes.
  • Experience with payroll software such as BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar is an advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working with data and payroll-related reporting and metrics.
  • Practical experience or strong interest in using AI tools, automation, and IT applications to improve daily workflows.

Must-have attributes

Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for assigned payrolls and client accounts, follows through on tasks without constant supervision, and proactively resolves issues or roadblocks.

Humility: Open to feedback, willing to learn, and comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and seeking support when required.

Structured Thinking: Able to organise multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and tasks in a clear and logical manner, while using sound judgement to prioritise competing requirements.

Data Driven & Attention to Detail: Comfortable working with numbers and payroll data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Able to identify discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies before they impact payroll processing or clients.

Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way: Able to communicate clearly and professionally when dealing with sensitive payroll issues, missing information, delays, or difficult client situations while maintaining a constructive client relationship.

AI & Tech Savvy: Energetic about adopting new software, AI tools, automation, and technology to make payroll processes more efficient and effective.

Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

TA Screen / One-way Video Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview to assess spoken and written communication, relevant UK payroll experience, motivation, and initial background.

Technical Round: A 30-minute interview and practical assessment with the Hiring Team to assess UK payroll knowledge, payroll processing experience, attention to detail, ability to work with payroll data, and understanding of UK payroll processes and deadlines.

Soft Skills Round: A 30-minute chat with a member of the leadership team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values, including ownership, humility, structured thinking, communication, and ability to handle challenging situations.

Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

jobs.title: Project Researcher (PhD. Student) or Postdoctoral Researcher, Electricity Markets and Flexibility (Electrical Engineering) - 2 positions
jobs.description:
The University of Vaasa is an inspiring and international community where we work together for a sustainable and responsible future. We combine expertise in business and technology in a unique way, tackling current challenges with determination and collaboration. As part of the Nordic regions largest energy technology hub, we promote sustainable business, energy, and society. We educate future professionals who will create a fairer and more sustainable world.

The University of Vaasa is seeking two motivated and talented Project Researchers or Postdoctoral Researcher to join the Research Council of Finland-funded Electricity Markets and Flexibility project.

The positions are full-time and fixed-term for three (3) years. The preferred starting date is flexible but agreed together as soon as possible. The positions are located in the School of Technology and Innovations and under electrical engineering discipline. The positions are located in Vaasa.

Background

The Electricity Markets and Flexibility project investigates how electricity markets must be designed, and how demand-side flexibility must be mobilised, for a power system dominated by variable renewable generation to remain reliable and affordable.

The project combines quantitative modelling of markets and the wider energy system with empirical analysis of how flexibility is created, priced, and traded by market participants. A central objective is to understand the interaction between market design choices and the total cost of the energy system, and to quantify the value of flexible demand, including the rapidly growing load from data centres, to system operation, investment, and consumers.

The project will produce new knowledge on electricity market design, system-level cost assessment, and demand-side flexibility, as well as new datasets, modelling methods, and blueprints. The results can be directly utilised in the scientific community, but also to improve decision-making in the public and private sectors.

The two positions are divided between two closely connected research themes. Decided theme is chosen depending on the profiles of the selected candidates.

Theme A: Electricity market design and the cost of the whole energy system

Research on this theme addresses the design of wholesale, balancing, reserve, and capacity markets under high shares of variable renewable generation; price formation, scarcity pricing, and locational signals; network charging and cost allocation; and sector coupling with heat and transport. The work involves system-level modelling of investment and operation to assess how alternative market designs affect the total cost of the energy system, security of supply, and the distribution of costs and benefits among market participants.

Theme B: Power system flexibility in data centres

Research on this theme addresses large data centres as controllable electricity loads. Topics include temporal and spatial shifting of computing workloads, the use of on-site energy storage and backup capacity, thermal flexibility and waste heat recovery, participation in wholesale, balancing, and reserve markets, grid connection and connection agreements, and the techno-economic and business case assessment of flexible operation. The work spans the modelling of data centre flexibility potential and its valuation from the perspectives of the operator, the system operator, and society.

https://www.univaasa.fi/en/about/organisation/schools/technology-and-innovations/

Your role

You will play a key role in the project team and actively participate in the implementation of different activities within the research project. The role emphasises the ability to conduct high-quality research and interact with different national and international stakeholders. Your work will contribute directly to project deliverables and high-quality academic publications.

Key responsibilities in the position:

- Contribute to the projects activities.
- Conduct independent and collaborative research within one of the projects research themes.
- Develop, apply, and document quantitative models and analyses of electricity markets, energy systems, or flexible demand.
- Collaborate with an interdisciplinary group of universities, research organisations, system operators, energy companies, technology providers, and data centre operators.
- Participate in data collection, analysis, and validation activities with industry stakeholders and policy makers.
- Lead and co-author high-quality scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals.
- Support teaching or supervision tasks when applicable (according to university guidelines).
- Present research at academic conferences and project meetings.
- Produce a doctoral dissertation based on the research carried out within the project.

The position may also include other tasks to be agreed upon separately. All tasks are agreed in more detail in the Annual Work Plan. The annual working time is 1612 hours.

Requirements

We expect the selected person to have the ability and motivation for doctoral studies and to complete a doctoral degree.

To be eligible for a full PhD student position, the candidate is required to participate in a separate application process which is arranged at least twice a year in order to be admitted and enrolled as a doctoral student at the University of Vaasa. For more information about eligibility and the application process, please visit the Graduate School's website: [Doctoral education | University of Vaasa (uwasa.fi)](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/education/doctoral-education)

Required:

- You have a masters degree or a PhD in a relevant field.
- Strong proven interest in the research area of the project.
- Demonstrated quantitative and analytical skills, including programming or modelling experience.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

jobs.description:
Serviceleder søges til Palmgren Erhvervsrengøring

Palmgren Erhvervsrengøring er i vækst, og derfor søger vi en engageret og struktureret serviceleder til vores aktiviteter i Jylland.

Som serviceleder får du ansvar for den daglige drift på en række af vores kunder og bliver et vigtigt bindeled mellem kunder, medarbejdere og administration. Stillingen vil udvikle sig i takt med vores vækst, og du får mulighed for at være med til at opbygge dit eget team samt udvikle og koordinere blandt andet vores flyverteam.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Daglig kontakt med medarbejdere og kunder

  • Kvalitetskontrol og opfølgning

  • Oplæring og instruktion af medarbejdere

  • Planlægning og koordinering ved sygdom, ferie og ændringer

  • Opstart af nye kunder og medarbejdere

  • Opbygning og udvikling af eget team

  • Koordinering af flyverteam og øvrige driftsopgaver

  • Sikring af at aftaler, rengøringsplaner og kvalitetskrav bliver fulgt

Vi søger dig, der er ansvarsbevidst, løsningsorienteret og god til mennesker. Du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt, bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag og have lyst til at tage ansvar i en virksomhed, hvor der sker meget.

Erfaring fra rengøringsbranchen eller serviceledelse er en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling, er handlekraftig og trives med ansvar.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Firmabil

  • Pension

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

  • En selvstændig og varieret hverdag

  • Mulighed for at opbygge og udvikle dit eget team

  • Spændende udfordringer i en virksomhed i vækst

  • Stor kontaktflade til både kunder og medarbejdere

  • Gode muligheder for ansvar og indflydelse på den daglige drift

Palmgren Erhvervsrengøring har kontorer i Odense, København og Aarhus og løser opgaver for erhvervskunder på tværs af landet. Dit arbejdsområde vil være Jylland

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
KØKKEN SOUSCHEF SØGES TIL SMASH BURGER APS – SYDHAVN

Smash Burger ApS søger en erfaren og engageret køkken souschef til vores restaurant i Sydhavnen.

Om restauranten

Smash Burger er en moderne burgerrestaurant med fokus på friske råvarer, god kvalitet og velsmagende mad. Vi tilbereder blandt andet smashburgere, chicken burgers, fries og andre klassiske fast-food retter. Restauranten har både almindelig restaurantdrift og takeaway, og der er derfor ofte et højt tempo, hvor effektivitet, kvalitet og godt samarbejde er vigtigt.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som køkken souschef vil du blandt andet:

  • Assistere køkkenchefen med den daglige drift og planlægning

  • Koordinere og fordele arbejdsopgaver blandt køkkenpersonalet

  • Tage ansvar for køkkenet, når køkkenchefen ikke er til stede

  • Deltage aktivt i madlavning, forberedelse og service

  • Sikre kvalitet og ensartethed i produktionen

  • Planlægge og følge op på mise en place og prep

  • Oplære og vejlede nye medarbejdere

  • Sikre et effektivt arbejdsflow under travle perioder

  • Kontrollere råvarer, lager og varemodtagelse

  • Sikre overholdelse af hygiejne- og fødevaresikkerhedsregler

  • Bidrage til at reducere madspild og optimere råvareforbruget

Vi søger dig, der

  • Har erfaring fra et professionelt køkken

  • Har erfaring som souschef, køkkenansvarlig eller i en tilsvarende funktion

  • Har erfaring med koordinering eller ledelse af køkkenpersonale

  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt

  • Kan bevare overblikket i et travlt køkken

  • Har fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og god hygiejne

  • Er stabil, ansvarsbevidst og fleksibel

  • Kan kommunikere på engelsk. Dansk er en fordel.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

  • En central rolle i den daglige køkkendrift

  • Ansvar og mulighed for indflydelse

  • Et dynamisk arbejdsmiljø med højt tempo

  • Tæt samarbejde med køkkenchef og øvrigt personale

  • Løn efter erfaring og kvalifikationer

  • Ansættelse på almindelige danske vilkår

jobs.title: QA and Test Lead
jobs.description:
One of Nordic Investin’s partner companies is looking for a QA and Test Lead, with Nordic Investin leading the recruitment process. You can create a quality strategy that teams understand, own and use when delivery pressure rises.

The partner is delivering a complex platform change across several systems and suppliers. You will lead test planning, coordinate evidence and make sure critical user journeys are verified from component level through business acceptance.

The team works across disciplines and expects quality to be shaped throughout discovery and delivery. You will have space to challenge assumptions, make evidence visible and improve how decisions are made.

How you will work

You will join multidisciplinary delivery rather than operate as a final approval step. The partner expects early questions, rapid feedback and clear evidence about what users and systems need. You will help teams decide what to test, measure or prototype before committing to an expensive direction.

As a senior colleague, you will own substantial outcomes and help others make stronger decisions. You are expected to recognise risk early, communicate it without drama and move work forward with practical alternatives. The role still includes hands on delivery; seniority here means broader judgement, not distance from the work.

What you will do

    

Define the overall test strategy and risk based scope.

    

Connect requirements and use cases with verifiable test coverage.

    

Coordinate environments, data, teams and external dependencies.

    

Lead defect triage and readiness reporting.

    

Guide automation priorities and non functional testing.

    

Communicate quality risk clearly to project and business leadership.

What you will bring

This agency-based role will work across multiple client accounts, translating business objectives, audience insights, and brand positioning into compelling creative strategies and culturally relevant content. Lead the conceptual, strategic, and visual direction of seasonal campaigns, evergreen content programs, product launches, brand initiatives, and ongoing client communications.

Establish and maintain a distinctive, consistent, and relevant visual identity for each client.

Influence the look, feel, tone, and overall creative expression of brand assets across regional, national, and global markets.

Translate strategic insights, marketing objectives, audience needs, and business goals into clear creative strategies and engaging content platforms.

Develop creative approaches that inspire, move, and connect with end users while authentically expressing each brand’s purpose, values, and point of view.

Set creative standards and provide direction across photography, video, graphic design, digital artwork, motion design, typography, copy integration, and branded experiences.

Stay current on emerging trends in culture, design, digital marketing, social media, technology, production, and the outdoor, lifestyle, and active industries.

Identify opportunities to evolve and strengthen client brands while maintaining consistency with established brand guidelines.

Concept Development:

Generate original ideas in response to creative briefs, strategic assignments, campaign objectives, and client needs.

Lead the development of creative concepts, campaign platforms, content series, product stories, and integrated brand experiences.

Create and oversee concept boards, mood boards, visual references, style guides, treatments, sketches, mockups, storyboards, and presentation materials.

Clearly communicate creative concepts, strategic rationale, intended audience impact, and production approach to clients and internal stakeholders.

Present, sell, and defend creative ideas with confidence, clarity, and sound strategic reasoning.

Develop custom content ideas and creative approaches for retail, ecommerce, wholesale, merchandising, sales, social, editorial, digital, and experiential channels.

Ensure creative ideas are scalable and adaptable across formats, markets, platforms, and stages of the customer journey.

Lead creative projects from concept development through pre-production, production, post-production, final delivery, and rollout.

Plan, strategize, and execute lifestyle and product photography and videography shoots.

Drive and direct global and regional campaign photo and video shoots, ensuring that the creative vision is consistently realized on set and through post-production.

Develop creative treatments, shot lists, storyboards, casting direction, location recommendations, styling direction, production schedules, and visual references.

Collaborate closely with photographers, directors, videographers, producers, stylists, set designers, editors, animators, retouchers, developers, and other production specialists.

Provide creative direction during casting, location scouting, pre-production meetings, shoots, editing sessions, color grading, retouching, sound design, animation, and final delivery.

Balance creative ambition with budget, schedule, logistics, production realities, client needs, and usage requirements.

Review and approve work at all stages to ensure quality, consistency, accuracy, and alignment with the approved creative direction.

Experience leading both in-house and external creative, production, and freelance teams.

As necessary, must be proficient shooting still imagery to lead or supplement campaigns, provide BTS imagery or conceptual imagery.

Team Leadership and Collaboration

Lead and manage in-house, freelance, outsourced, and partner creative teams across multiple client accounts.

Direct photographers, videographers, production teams, stylists, designers, developers, editors, agencies, and other external specialists.

Build and facilitate a highly motivated, collaborative, inclusive, and accountable creative environment.

Establish clear expectations, responsibilities, workflows, feedback processes, and quality standards for project teams.

Mentor and develop creative talent, supporting professional growth and encouraging new perspectives.

Assemble the right creative and production resources for each project based on scope, budget, timeline, and required expertise.

Manage contract and freelance production staff, including sourcing, briefing, scheduling, negotiating, onboarding, and evaluating external partners.

Foster strong relationships across creative, strategy, account management, production, marketing, digital, sales, merchandising, retail, and leadership teams.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure creative work is strategically aligned and operationally effective.

jobs.description:
DYGTIG HÅNDVÆRKER MED TØMRERBAGGRUND SØGES TIL EJENDOMSKONCERN

Er du en dygtig håndværker, der kan lide en alsidig arbejdsdag, hvor ikke to dage nødvendigvis er ens?

Vi søger en selvstændig og erfaren håndværker med tømrermæssig baggrund til vores ejendomskoncern.

Du bliver en del af vores interne drift og kommer til at arbejde på tværs af vores ejendomme med alt fra mindre reparationer til renoverings- og ombygningsopgaver.

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være:
Tømrer- og snedkeropgaver
Renovering og istandsættelse af lejemål
Montering og justering af døre, låse, lister mv.
Opsætning af vægge, lofter og andre mindre byggeopgaver
Mindre maler- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver
Reparationer og løbende vedligeholdelse på vores ejendomme
Diverse praktiske ad hoc-opgaver

Vi leder efter dig, der har hænderne skruet rigtigt på, kan se hvad der skal gøres og ikke er bange for at tage fat – også når opgaven ligger lidt uden for det traditionelle tømrerfag.

Vi forestiller os, at du:
• Har en håndværksmæssig baggrund – gerne som tømrer
• Har erfaring med renovering og vedligeholdelse
• Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver
• Er løsningsorienteret og går op i at levere et ordentligt stykke arbejde
• Er fleksibel og trives med mange forskellige typer opgaver
• Har kørekort B

Til gengæld tilbyder vi:
• En alsidig stilling med stor frihed under ansvar
• En hverdag uden traditionelt byggepladsræs
• Arbejde på koncernens egne ejendomme
• Varierende opgaver og mulighed for selv at planlægge meget af arbejdsdagen
• Gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone
• Løn efter kvalifikationer

Vi søger ikke nødvendigvis den, der har det flotteste CV – vi søger den, der kan sit håndværk, tager ansvar og får tingene gjort ordentligt.

Lyder det som noget for dig – eller kender du den helt rigtige?

Send os en kort ansøgning og lidt om din erfaring. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

jobs.title: Consultant Senior Cybersecurity Governance - Cloud & IT Resilience (H/F)
jobs.description:
act digital est un groupe international de conseil et d'ingénierie qui accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets de transformation numérique.

Présent dans 12 pays et fort de plus de 5 600 collaborateurs, nous mettons nos expertises au service de leurs enjeux en développement logiciel, cybersécurité, data, cloud et IA.

Notre ambition : devenir le partenaire technologique de confiance des entreprises les plus innovantes, en concevant et sécurisant des systèmes qui renforcent leur performance et leur résilience.

Rejoindre act digital France, c'est intégrer une organisation agile et engagée, qui fait avancer les projets avec ses clients pour transformer les idées en résultats concrets, avec pragmatisme et exigence.

Le poste :

Vous intégrerez, au sein de notre Pôle Cybersécurité, une équipe dédiée à l'accompagnement de nos clients sur des missions de gouvernance, de gestion des risques et de définition de cadres de référence SSI. Vous serez détaché(e) auprès d'un acteur majeur du secteur bancaire, au sein d'une organisation internationale en charge de définir et de faire évoluer les exigences cybersécurité applicables aux différentes entités du Groupe. Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un profil expérimenté en gouvernance cybersécurité, disposant de solides connaissances sur les sujets IT Continuity, IT Resilience, Backup & Restore et Cloud Security, capable de contribuer à la formalisation et à l'évolution des exigences et procédures Groupe.

Vos missions seront les suivantes :
- Contribuer à la rédaction, à la révision et à la structuration des exigences cybersécurité et procédures Groupe sur les sujets IT Continuity, IT Resilience, Backup & Restore et Cloud Security
- Accompagner les travaux de Cloud Security et contribuer à l'interprétation ainsi qu'à l'application des exigences de sécurité et de continuité dans les environnements Cloud
- Prendre en compte les différents modèles de services Cloud (IaaS, PaaS, CaaS et SaaS) ainsi que les modèles de responsabilités partagées entre le Groupe et les Cloud Service Providers
- Contribuer à la définition des exigences relatives aux enjeux de continuité, de résilience, de sauvegarde, de restauration, de due diligence et de réversibilité dans les environnements Cloud
- Participer aux travaux de gouvernance cybersécurité : analyse des besoins, formalisation des livrables, préparation des supports de décision et suivi des actions
- Animer et faciliter des workshops en anglais avec les différentes entités et fonctions du Groupe afin de cadrer les attendus, partager les livrables et recueillir les retours opérationnels
- Contribuer à l'alignement des exigences avec les cadres de référence cybersécurité, les bonnes pratiques de continuité et de résilience IT ainsi que les exigences réglementaires applicables

Profil recherché :

Quel profil pour ce poste :
- Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation Bac+5 (École d'ingénieur, Université ou équivalent) en informatique, cybersécurité ou gestion des risques
- Vous justifiez d'une expérience confirmée dans des fonctions de gouvernance cybersécurité, de définition d'exigences, de standards ou de procédures SSI
- Vous disposez d'une expérience significative sur les problématiques de continuité et de résilience des systèmes d'information, idéalement complétée par une connaissance des environnements Cloud
- Vous avez déjà évolué dans un environnement complexe et transverse, impliquant de nombreux interlocuteurs techniques, cybersécurité, risques et métiers
- Vous accordez de l'importance à la rigueur, à la qualité rédactionnelle et à la structuration des livrables
- Vous disposez d'une bonne capacité de synthèse, d'autonomie et êtes à l'aise dans l'animation de workshops avec des interlocuteurs internationaux

Quelles compétences/connaissances pour ce poste :
- Solides connaissances des problématiques IT Continuity, IT Resilience, PRA/PCA et des principes de continuité des systèmes d'information
- Bonne compréhension des stratégies de Backup & Restore, incluant les principes de sauvegarde, restauration, tests et exigences associées
- Connaissance des environnements Cloud et des modèles de services IaaS, PaaS, CaaS et SaaS
- Compréhension des modèles de responsabilités partagées entre les organisations et les Cloud Service Providers
- Expérience dans la rédaction d'exigences cybersécurité, standards, politiques et procédures SSI
- Connaissance des problématiques de sécurité, de continuité, de réversibilité et de gestion des risques dans les environnements Cloud
- Bonne compréhension des cadres de référence et bonnes pratiques cybersécurité
- Anglais courant impératif

jobs.description:
Job Title: HR Operations SpecialistÂ 

Type: Independent ContractorÂ 

Location: Remote | South Africa

About Us

The Law Offices of Sabrina Li, P.C. is a leading, full-service U.S. immigration law firm with offices in Los Angeles, Pasadena, Santa Ana, and Dallas, as well as international operations across Asia, Africa, and Central and South America. We are dedicated to helping individuals, families, and businesses navigate complex legal challenges with skill, compassion, and integrity.

We are proud to be recognized as a 2025 Inc. Best Workplaces honoree, a distinction that reflects our intentional investment in our people and workplace culture. Our firm prioritizes professional development, clear career pathways, and a culture of accountability and respectâcreating a workplace where high performers can build meaningful, long-term careers.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a tech-savvy, proactive HR professional with excellent communication skills to support our HR team across recruitment, onboarding, compliance, and training. You'll work alongside firm leadership to keep day-to-day HR operations running smoothly and help identify smarter, more efficient ways to manage HR processes using AI and automation.

If you enjoy variety in your work, thrive on process and organization, adapt quickly to new tools, and want to grow with a firm that invests in its people, this role is a great fit.

Key Responsibilities

HR Operations & Compliance

  • Support the employee onboarding process, helping new hires get set up and proficient with the firm's technology stack within their first week.
  • Assist with HR document, process, and compliance audits, and monitor completion of required documentation, certifications, training, and policy acknowledgements.
  • Follow up with employees and managers on outstanding compliance items.
  • Maintain accurate HR records within Rippling and other HR systems.

Recruitment & Talent Support

  • Support sourcing for open roles, including candidate outreach and headhunting for hard-to-fill positions when standard applicant pipelines fall short.
  • Help manage candidate pipelines and keep hiring managers updated on status.
  • Assist with background and reference checks and credential verification.
  • Participate in candidate interviews alongside hiring managers.

Training & Development

  • Help maintain and update the firm's training curriculum, onboarding materials, and learning resources.
  • Assist in creating SOPs, workflow documentation, process maps, and training materials as needed.
  • Support the development of assessments and knowledge checks to track training completion.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to streamline HR workflows through automation and AI-powered tools.
  • Help maintain workflows within monday.com and other operational platforms.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field (required).
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new tools, systems, and platforms (required).
  • Excellent written and spoken English with strong, proactive communication skills â comfortable flagging issues, asking questions, and following up without being prompted (required).
  • Proactive and self-directed, able to anticipate needs and take initiative in a fast-paced, fully remote environment (required).
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in HR operations for a U.S.-based company, including onboarding, compliance, or employee lifecycle support (required).
  • Experience using monday.com and HRIS platforms such as Rippling (required).
  • Experience creating clear documentation, SOPs, or process materials.
  • Comfortable using AI tools to support content creation, documentation, and process efficiency.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Preferred: recruitment or sourcing experience, including candidate outreach, vetting, and interviewing.
  • Preferred: experience with Canva or similar tools for training or communication materials.

Why Join Our Team?

  • Stable, remote opportunity to work with a well-established U.S.-based law firm that values continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.

jobs.title: UČITELJ/UČITELJICA BIOLOGIJE NA TALIJANSKOM JEZIKU
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10,105/10-ispr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ te čl. 7. Pravilnika o radu OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“, ravnateljica Osnovne škole-Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“ Rijeka, Mirka Čurbega 18, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjenje radnog mjesta 1 učitelj/učiteljica biologije na talijanskom jeziku na neodređeno i nepuno radno vrijeme (8 sati tjedno), uz uvjet probnog rada prema odredbama Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za službenike i namještenike u javnim službama TRAŽENI UVJETI:
  1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17 i 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN br. 6/19, 75/20):
- završen sveučilišni diplomski studij - potpuno vladanje talijanskim jezikom i pismom 2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.). Na oglašena radna mjesta mogu se javiti osobe oba spola, sukladno čl. 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/16, 69/17). Svi izrazi korišteni u natječaju odnose se na osobe oba spola. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti: - životopis (CV) sastavljen na hrvatskom i na talijanskom jeziku, - presliku diplome, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi, - dokaz o državljanstvu, - elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i - uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja. Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti neposredno ili poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole, te na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 10. rujna 2026. godine. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione e ai sensi dell'articolo 7 del Regolamento interno per l'assunzione del personale della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”, la direttrice della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò” di Fiume, Via Mirko Čurbeg 18, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per il posto di lavoro di 1 insegnante di biologia in lingua italiana a tempo indeterminato - orario incompleto (8 ore settimanali) con la condizione del periodo di prova secondo il Contratto collettivo essenziale per gli ufficiali negli enti pubblici CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: 1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20): - laurea - padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana 2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione: - dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana, - il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale, - la prova di cittadinanza, - il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e - l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso). La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 10 settembre 2026.

Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20): - laurea - padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana 2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 10 settembre 2026.

jobs.title: KONOBAR/ICA
jobs.description: Café Allegri - STENJEVEC Posjedujemo ugostiteljske objekte diljem Hrvatske, a koji su pozicionirani u sklopu supermarketa i radnim vremenom prilagođeni istima, te su ugodno i toplo uređeni. Velika pozornost pridaje se kvaliteti usluge i stručnosti osoblja s naglaskom na srdačnost! Visoku razinu kvalitete održavamo kontinuiranim ulaganjem u naše djelatnike, prostor i ponudu, što nam se višestruko vraća kroz zadovoljne djelatnike i stalne goste. Ukoliko i Vi želite postati dio našeg tima od 150 zadovoljnih djelatnika, javite se na naš natječaj! Ako i nemate radnog iskustva te bi Vam ovo bilo prvo zaposlenje, rado ćemo Vas uzeti u obzir kao potencijalnog kandidata, te Vam pomoći u stjecanju iskustva i usvajanju novih znanja i vještina! Za dodatne informacije o našoj ponudi i uvjetima rada možete se javiti na broj 099 4328260 ili posao@celka.hr. jobs.title: UČITELJ/UČITELJICA GEOGRAFIJE NA TALIJANSKOM JEZIKU
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10,105/10-ispr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ te čl. 7. Pravilnika o radu OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“, ravnateljica Osnovne škole-Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“ Rijeka, Mirka Čurbega 18, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjenje radnog mjesta 1 učitelj/učiteljica geografije na talijanskom jeziku na neodređeno i nepuno radno vrijeme (16 sati tjedno), uz uvjet probnog rada prema odredbama Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za službenike i namještenike u javnim službama TRAŽENI UVJETI:
  1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17 i 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN br. 6/19, 75/20):
- završen sveučilišni diplomski studij - potpuno vladanje talijanskim jezikom i pismom 2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.). Na oglašena radna mjesta mogu se javiti osobe oba spola, sukladno čl. 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/16, 69/17). Svi izrazi korišteni u natječaju odnose se na osobe oba spola. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti: - životopis (CV) sastavljen na hrvatskom i na talijanskom jeziku, - presliku diplome, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi, - dokaz o državljanstvu, - elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i - uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja. Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti neposredno ili poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati.
